_about: The essence compendium used by the NPC generator: 201 essences in four rarities, each with an affinity, and 365 confluences. A confluence comes from an exact recipe if one matches, otherwise from the three affinities sorted and joined with "+". affinities: what each covers, the awakening stone spells that fit it by spell level, and how its power tends to look.

replace: As an action, you can touch an object to learn whether it is magical and, if it is, which school of magic its aura belongs to.
As an action, you can touch an object to learn whether it is magical and, if it is, which school of magic it belongs to.

rule: To find a character's confluence, first look for their exact three essences in the recipe table. If there is no exact recipe, take the affinities of their three essences, put them in alphabetical order, and find that affinity trio in the trio table. Every possible set of three essences has an answer. Order of absorption doesn't matter, and the same affinity can appear two or three times.

Blood.covers: blood, vitality, predators, the hunt, hunger, vengeance, lineage
looks: crimson mist when they bleed
veins that glow red when they fight
a metallic scent in the air
wounds that close a little too quickly

Dark.covers: shadow, night, death and the dead, fear, secrets, silence
looks: shadow wisps trailing every strike
eyes that swallow lamplight
a shadow that moves a heartbeat late
a faint chill and dimmer light around them

Earth.covers: stone, metal, mountains, sand, deep places, patience, deep time
looks: skin with a faint granite grain
footsteps that sound heavier than they should
dust that settles when they stand still
small stones that roll toward them

Fire.covers: flame, heat, lightning, smoke, the forge, anger
looks: a blade that glows like a forge
embers drifting from their hair
skin warm to the touch
heat shimmer when they are angry

Life.covers: growth, plants, healing, renewal, home, food, the seasons
looks: green shoots that spring up where they kneel
a smell of cut grass and summer rain
wounds that knit with a faint green glow
flowers that turn to follow them

Light.covers: light, sun and stars, holiness, truth, mercy, hope, judgement
looks: a soft glow under the skin
a halo of motes when they heal
shadows that recoil from them
eyes like polished gold

Magic.covers: mana, arcane craft, runes, knowledge, fate, dreams, transformation
looks: blue-white motes orbiting their hands
a hum that sensitive people can feel
runes that flicker across their skin
enchanted items reacting when they pass

Might.covers: strength, weapons, armour, war, protection, courage, rule
looks: blows that land with a thunderclap
a frame that seems to take up more room
cracked stone where they plant their feet
a grip that dents metal

Sin.covers: vice, greed, pride, trade, deceit, disguise, bargains
looks: a voice that makes people recall their regrets
black veins spreading from their touch
whispers only the guilty hear
an aura that makes animals uneasy

Swift.covers: speed, agility, travel, ropes and traps, skill, chance
looks: afterimages when they dodge
restless, quick hands
a blur at the edge of vision
never seeming to be out of breath

Water.covers: water, the sea, rivers, ice, tides, swamps, salt
looks: droplets beading on their skin in dry air
movements that flow like a current
eyes the colour of deep water
the sound of rain when they cast

Wind.covers: air, storms, sky, birds, sound and song, messages, weather
looks: a breeze that follows them indoors
hair and cloak always in motion
the smell of rain before a storm
a faint whistle when they move fast

essences.name: Armour
essences.description: The essence of armour and the body that wears it. Bearers' skin toughens and rings faintly when struck, they grow comfortable under heavy weight, and their magic settles over them like plates of light.
essences.manifests: armourers' workshops and garrison armouries

grant.text: Proficiency with medium armour or with heavy armour.

essences.name: Axe
essences.description: The essence of the axe, as at home in the woodlot as on the battlefield. Bearers smell faintly of split pine, swing anything heavy with an easy rhythm, and their magic falls with a chopping force.
essences.manifests: logging camps and woodcutters' yards

grant.text: Proficiency with greataxes or with carpenter's tools.

essences.name: Bear
essences.description: The essence of the bear. Bearers grow broad and heavy-boned, sleep deeply and eat enormously, and a low rumble creeps into their laugh.
essences.manifests: old bear dens in mountain forests

grant.name: Powerful Build
grant.text: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag or lift.

essences.name: Blood
essences.description: The essence of blood and the life it carries. Bearers' veins glow faintly red when their heart races, they can hear their own pulse in a quiet room, and their magic leaves a coppery scent.
essences.manifests: arena fighting pits and old battlefields

grant.name: Blood Sense
grant.text: You know whether any creature you can see within 30 feet of you is below half its hit point maximum.

essences.name: Bow
essences.description: The essence of the bow and the long, patient shot. Bearers' eyes narrow to a hunter's focus, their breathing slows whenever they aim, and their spells fly in clean, straight streaks.
essences.manifests: archery ranges and fletchers' workshops

grant.text: Proficiency with longbows or with woodcarver's tools.

essences.name: Bread
essences.description: The essence of the hearth and the meal shared around it. Bearers always smell faintly of fresh bread, strangers relax in their company, and their magic glows like banked coals.
essences.manifests: busy inn kitchens and family hearths kept lit for generations

grant.text: Proficiency with cook's utensils or with brewer's supplies.

essences.name: Coin
essences.description: The essence of coin and commerce. Bearers can weigh a purse by eye, their voices take on a trader's easy patter, and their spells glint like spinning gold.
essences.manifests: market squares and counting-house vaults

grant.text: Proficiency in Persuasion, or one language of your choice.

essences.name: Dagger
essences.theme: Knives, close work and hidden blades
essences.description: The essence of the dagger. Bearers develop quick, deft fingers and a habit of keeping a blade within reach, and their magic arrives as a sudden glint at close quarters.
essences.manifests: thieves' dens and cutlers' workshops

grant.text: Proficiency in Sleight of Hand or Intimidation.

essences.name: Dark
essences.theme: Shadow, concealment and the unlit hour
essences.description: The essence of shadow and the hush of unlit places. Bearers' pupils widen until their eyes look almost black, lamplight seems to dim a little around them, and their magic trails smoky wisps of shade.
essences.manifests: sealed crypts and the deepest unlit mine shafts

grant.name: Dusksight
grant.text: You have darkvision out to 30 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.

essences.name: Duck
essences.description: The essence of the humble duck, unbothered and unsinkable. Water rolls off bearers as it does off feathers, they keep an oddly serene expression in a crisis, and a few of them quack faintly when startled.
essences.manifests: village millponds and reed marshes

grant.name: Buoyant
grant.text: You float effortlessly and cannot sink unless you choose to, and you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to swim.

essences.name: Earth
essences.description: The essence of stone and soil. Bearers gain a faint granite grain to their skin and a heavy, deliberate tread, and their magic arrives with the rumble of shifting ground.
essences.manifests: deep caverns and old quarry floors

grant.name: Rooted
grant.text: You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid being shoved or knocked prone.

essences.name: Fire
essences.description: The essence of living flame. Bearers run warm to the touch, ember glints flicker in their hair, and their spells crackle and smell of woodsmoke.
essences.manifests: volcanic vents and long-burning forge fires

grant.name: Kindle
grant.text: At will, as an action, you can light or snuff out a nonmagical flame no larger than a campfire within 10 feet of you.

essences.name: Fish
essences.description: The essence of the fish. Faint scales glint at bearers' wrists and neck, they feel more at ease in water than out of it, and gill-like slits flutter at their throat when they hold their breath.
essences.manifests: river spawning grounds and coral reefs

grant.name: Deep Lungs
grant.text: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes.

essences.name: Goat
essences.theme: Sure feet, stubbornness and high places
essences.description: The essence of the mountain goat. Bearers become nimble on broken ground and impossibly stubborn in an argument, and they will cheerfully eat food that others turn their noses up at.
essences.manifests: steep mountain crags and high summer pastures

grant.text: Proficiency in Athletics or Survival.

essences.name: Growth
essences.description: The essence of things that grow. Moss creeps over bearers' boots if they stand still too long, flowers open where they rest, and their spells smell of fresh-cut grass.
essences.manifests: ancient groves and overgrown temple gardens

grant.text: Proficiency in Nature or with a herbalism kit.

essences.name: Hammer
essences.description: The essence of the hammer, maker and breaker both. Bearers' hands grow callused and sure, sparks jump when they grip metal, and their magic lands like an anvil blow.
essences.manifests: busy smithies and foundry floors

grant.text: Proficiency with warhammers or with smith's tools.

essences.name: Horse
essences.theme: Endurance, travel and the open road
essences.description: The essence of the horse. Bearers grow long-legged and restless when cooped up, cover ground with an easy loping stride, and road animals seem to trust them on sight.
essences.manifests: busy coaching stables and wild horse plains

grant.name: Tireless Stride
grant.text: You can travel for up to 10 hours in a day before you must make saving throws for a forced march.

essences.name: Hunt
essences.description: The essence of the hunt. Bearers notice tracks and broken twigs without trying, their eyes catch the light like a cat's, and their quarry often feels watched long before they arrive.
essences.manifests: hunting lodges and well-used game trails

grant.text: Proficiency in Survival or with leatherworker's tools.

essences.name: Ice
essences.description: The essence of ice. Bearers' breath mists even on warm days, their touch is always cool, and frost feathers across nearby surfaces when they cast.
essences.manifests: glacier caves and frozen mountain lakes

grant.name: Winter-Blooded
grant.text: You automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold and frigid water.

essences.name: Ink
essences.theme: Writing, records and the careful hand
essences.description: The essence of ink and the written word. Bearers' fingertips stain permanently black, their handwriting turns elegant almost overnight, and their magic leaves faint letters hanging in the air.
essences.manifests: busy scriptoriums and record-house archives

grant.text: Proficiency with calligrapher's supplies or with a forgery kit.

essences.name: Iron
essences.description: The essence of iron and a will that does not bend. Bearers' skin takes on a dull metallic sheen, their voices pick up a faint ring, and their resolve hardens like quenched steel.
essences.manifests: iron mines and the ore yards of smelting works

grant.name: Unbending
grant.text: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

essences.name: Light
essences.description: The essence of light that reveals what was hidden. Bearers carry a soft glow beneath the skin in darkness, shadows seem to shy away from them, and their magic flares bright and clean.
essences.manifests: lighthouse lamp rooms and sunlit mountain shrines

grant.name: Inner Lamp
grant.text: At will, as a bonus action, you can make your hands or eyes shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, or end that light.

essences.name: Loom
essences.description: The essence of the loom and the cloth it makes. Bearers instinctively notice patterns, frayed edges and loose threads, their fingers keep up a restless working rhythm, and their magic forms in interlaced strands of light.
essences.manifests: weaving halls and busy textile mills

grant.text: Proficiency with weaver's tools or in Investigation.

essences.name: Might
essences.description: The essence of sheer physical power. Bearers' shoulders broaden and their grip grows crushing, their blows land with a dull thunderclap, and flagstones crack where they plant their feet.
essences.manifests: wrestling pits and heavy-lifting dockyards

grant.text: Proficiency in Athletics or Intimidation.

essences.name: Moon
essences.description: The essence of the moon. Bearers take on a pale silver sheen after dark, their moods seem to wax and wane with the month, and their magic glows with cool, colourless light.
essences.manifests: moonlit standing stones and still mountain tarns

grant.text: Proficiency with navigator's tools or in Insight.

essences.name: Mud
essences.description: The essence of mud, both the mire that clings and the clay that takes shape. Bearers always have a little dirt under their nails, grow oddly patient with slow work, and their magic lands with a wet, heavy squelch.
essences.manifests: river deltas and potters' clay pits

grant.text: Proficiency with potter's tools or with mason's tools.

essences.name: Owl
essences.theme: Night watching, wisdom and silent observation
essences.description: The essence of the owl. Bearers develop an unnerving stillness, turn their heads a little too far to look at things, and blink slowly when deep in thought.
essences.manifests: ruined towers and hollow forest oaks

grant.text: Proficiency in History or Insight.

essences.name: Plough
essences.theme: Farming, toil and the turning seasons
essences.description: The essence of the plough and the field. Bearers grow sunburnt and steady, wake before dawn without trying, and can judge good soil by its smell.
essences.manifests: long-tilled farmland and village threshing floors

grant.text: Proficiency in Animal Handling or Nature.

essences.name: Rat
essences.description: The essence of the rat, the survivor who lives on scraps. Bearers grow twitchy and alert, always seem to know where the food is kept, and rats never bother them.
essences.manifests: city sewers and grain warehouses

grant.name: Scavenger's Gut
grant.text: You can eat spoiled, raw or rotten food and drink stagnant water without ill effect. This does not protect you from poison or magical disease.

essences.name: Renewal
essences.description: The essence of renewal and fresh starts. Bearers' cuts close with a faint green shimmer, they wake from any rest looking refreshed, and their magic leaves behind the smell of rain.
essences.manifests: healing springs and temple infirmaries

grant.name: Quick Mending
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you spend a Hit Die to regain hit points, you regain the maximum amount for that die instead of rolling it.

essences.name: Rope
essences.description: The essence of rope, the lifeline of sailors and climbers. Bearers absently tie knots in whatever is at hand, have rough, strong hands, and their magic coils and snaps taut like rigging.
essences.manifests: busy harbour riggings and ropewalks

grant.text: Proficiency in Athletics or with vehicles (water).

essences.name: Salt
essences.description: The essence of salt, which preserves and purifies. Bearers' sweat dries in fine white crystals, their tongues grow keen to every flavour, and their magic carries a briny tang.
essences.manifests: salt flats and coastal evaporation pans

grant.name: Salt-Tongue
grant.text: By touching food or drink to your tongue, you learn whether it is spoiled or contains poison. A taste this small never exposes you to the poison.

essences.name: Sand
essences.description: The essence of sand, patient and endless. Bearers' skin takes on a sun-weathered tan, grains trickle from their clothes long after they leave the desert, and their magic hisses like a sliding dune.
essences.manifests: deep desert dunes and storm-scoured beaches

grant.text: Proficiency in Survival or with glassblower's tools.

essences.name: Shield
essences.description: The essence of the shield and the one who stands in front. Bearers instinctively place themselves between danger and their companions, and a faint translucent barrier flickers around them when they cast.
essences.manifests: city wall watch posts and old shield-wall battlefields

grant.text: Proficiency with shields or in Medicine.

essences.name: Smoke
essences.description: The essence of smoke. Bearers smell faintly of woodsmoke and incense, their outlines blur a little in dim light, and their spells leave grey wisps curling in the air.
essences.manifests: charcoal burners' camps and incense-heavy shrines

grant.text: Proficiency in Stealth or with alchemist's supplies.

essences.name: Snake
essences.description: The essence of the snake. Bearers' eyes take on a narrow, unblinking focus, their skin flakes away in fine sheets each season, and their voices soften into a persuasive hiss.
essences.manifests: snake pits in jungle ruins and sun-warmed rocky hillsides

grant.text: Proficiency in Deception or with a poisoner's kit.

essences.name: Spark
essences.description: The essence of the spark, the first flash of lightning and of inspiration. Bearers' hair lifts with static, small shocks jump from their fingertips to door handles, and they are prone to sudden bursts of insight.
essences.manifests: lightning-struck hilltops and busy tinkers' workshops

grant.text: Proficiency in Arcana or with tinker's tools.

essences.name: Spear
essences.theme: Reach, thrusting and holding the line
essences.description: The essence of the spear, the oldest weapon of hunters and soldiers alike. Bearers stand in a long, balanced stance, judge distances with uncanny precision, and their spells strike out in narrow, piercing lines.
essences.manifests: phalanx drill yards and spear-fishing reefs

grant.text: Proficiency with pikes or with tridents.

essences.name: Spider
essences.description: The essence of the spider. Bearers become unnervingly still while they wait, are at ease on high beams and narrow ledges, and their magic trails fine silver threads.
essences.manifests: cobwebbed cellars and abandoned mine galleries

grant.text: Proficiency in Stealth or Acrobatics.

essences.name: Staff
essences.description: The essence of the staff, both walking stick and channelling rod. Bearers move with a wanderer's steady balance, a staff hums when they spin it, and motes of light gather at its ends when they cast.
essences.manifests: mage academy practice halls and well-worn pilgrim roads

grant.name: Steady Stride
grant.text: While you are holding a staff or quarterstaff, you have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to keep your balance.

essences.name: Sun
essences.description: The essence of the sun. Bearers give off a gentle summer warmth, their eyes take on a burnished gold tint, and their spells shine like noon light.
essences.manifests: sunbaked mesas and hilltop sun temples

grant.text: Proficiency in Religion or Performance.

essences.name: Swarm
essences.description: The essence of the swarm, many small things acting as one. A faint buzzing hangs around bearers, tiny beetles sometimes crawl on their sleeves, and their magic scatters into flickering motes.
essences.manifests: apiaries and towering termite mounds

grant.name: Hive Sense
grant.text: You can sense the location of any insect nest, hive or swarm within 60 feet of you, and ordinary insects never bite or sting you.

essences.name: Swift
essences.description: The essence of speed. Bearers fidget whenever they are made to wait, leave faint afterimages when they move suddenly, and rarely seem out of breath.
essences.manifests: messenger relay posts and horse racing tracks

grant.name: Fleet
grant.text: Once per short rest, you can take the Dash action as a bonus action.

essences.name: Sword
essences.description: The essence of the sword. Bearers stand with a duellist's poise, any blade they hold hums faintly as it moves, and their magic carries a cold edge of light.
essences.manifests: duelling grounds and swordsmiths' workshops

grant.text: Proficiency with longswords or with rapiers.

essences.name: Trap
essences.description: The essence of the trap and the trapper's patience. Bearers make a habit of noting every exit and loose floorboard, and their magic sometimes leaves faint glowing tripwires that only they can see.
essences.manifests: trappers' cabins and trap-laden tomb corridors

grant.text: Proficiency with thieves' tools or with tinker's tools.

essences.name: Water
essences.description: The essence of water in all its patience. Bearers are rarely flustered, droplets bead on their skin even in dry air, and their magic sounds like distant rain.
essences.manifests: deep lakes and flooded sea caves

grant.name: Water-Finder
grant.text: You can sense the direction of fresh water within 300 feet of you and roughly how much there is, and by tasting a drop you know whether water is safe to drink.

essences.name: Whip
essences.theme: Reach, control and the drover's crack
essences.description: The essence of the whip and the drover who drives a herd. Bearers gain a sharp, carrying voice and a flick to their wrists, and their spells snap out with a crack like leather.
essences.manifests: caravan staging yards and cattle markets

grant.text: Proficiency with whips or with vehicles (land).

essences.name: Wind
essences.theme: Moving air, freedom and open skies
essences.description: The essence of restless air. A breeze seems to follow bearers indoors, their hair and cloaks are always stirring, and their spells arrive on a sudden gust.
essences.manifests: windswept mountain passes and clifftop watchtowers

grant.name: Weathervane
grant.text: You always know which way the wind is blowing, and you can accurately predict the weather where you are for the next 24 hours.

essences.name: Wing
essences.description: The essence of the wing. Bearers feel lighter on their feet, stray feathers drift down where they have stood, and spectral wings briefly flare behind them when they cast.
essences.manifests: seabird cliffs and high mountain eyries

grant.name: Featherfall
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you fall, you can descend at a rate of 60 feet per round and take no damage from that fall.

essences.name: Wolf
essences.description: The essence of the wolf. Bearers grow fiercely loyal to their companions, their eyes shine in the dark, and a low growl creeps into their voice when they are angered.
essences.manifests: wolf dens deep in winter forests

grant.text: Proficiency in Animal Handling or Perception.

essences.name: Adept
essences.description: Adept is the essence of practised skill, the knack of picking up any craft by watching it done. Bearers move with economical precision, and a faint shimmer runs along whatever tool they hold.
essences.manifests: fencing halls and busy guild workshops

grant.name: Quick Study
grant.text: After you spend 1 hour practising with a set of artisan's tools, a gaming set or a musical instrument you are not proficient with, you count as proficient with it until you finish a long rest. You can have only one such proficiency at a time.

essences.name: Animate
essences.description: Animate is the urge that stirs still things into motion, from puppets to corpses. Small objects twitch and turn as the bearer passes, and their magic shows as fine threads of light trailing from their fingertips.
essences.manifests: clockmakers' workshops and restless old graveyards

grant.name: Puppeteer's Thread
grant.text: As an action, you can make one Tiny nonmagical object within 10 feet of you that no one is wearing or carrying move up to 5 feet, roll over, or open or close if it has a simple lid or latch. The object can't attack or carry anything.

essences.name: Archive
essences.description: Archive is the gathered memory of everything that has been written down and kept. Bearers' thoughts become orderly and precise, and they can call up a page they once read as clearly as if it lay before them.
essences.manifests: great libraries and dusty record halls

grant.name: Perfect Recall
grant.text: You can recall, word for word, any text you have read in the past 30 days, along with any map, diagram or table it contained.

essences.name: Balance
essences.description: Balance embodies equilibrium in body and in deed. Bearers carry a settled calm and rarely shift their weight, and their magic shows as a pair of faint scales that steady before every spell.
essences.manifests: tightrope circus tents and monastery cliff paths

grant.name: Steady Footing
grant.text: You have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to keep your balance, and you can tell at a glance whether a floor, beam or set of scales is perfectly level.

essences.name: Bounty
essences.description: Bounty is the overflowing generosity of a good harvest. Seeds sprout and fruit ripens a little faster near the bearer, who carries the scent of ripe apples and finds it hard not to share.
essences.manifests: overladen orchards at harvest time

grant.name: Plenty
grant.text: When you forage for food and water, you find twice as much as you otherwise would.

essences.name: Crossroads
essences.theme: Choices, meetings and the way onward
essences.description: Crossroads is the moment of choosing where paths divide. Bearers are decisive and seldom lose their way, and dust swirls into little arrows at their feet when they hesitate.
essences.manifests: ancient crossroads and lonely waystones

grant.name: Wayfinder
grant.text: When you stand at a fork, crossroads or junction of roads or paths, you know which branch leads most directly to the nearest settlement.

essences.name: Dawn
essences.description: Dawn is the promise of each new morning, hope returning after a long night. Bearers wake easily and cheerfully, a warm sunrise glow lingers at their back, and birdsong sometimes sounds where there are no birds.
essences.manifests: east-facing hilltops at sunrise

grant.name: Morning Vigour
grant.text: When you finish a long rest between midnight and noon, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice your proficiency bonus. Any that remain fade at sunset.

essences.name: Debt
essences.description: Debt is the invisible thread that ties a borrower to a lender. Bearers keep careful accounts in their heads, and their magic shows as faint golden threads that seem to stretch toward whoever owes them.
essences.manifests: moneylenders' counting houses and debtors' prisons

grant.name: Debtor's Thread
grant.text: You always know the direction to any creature that owes you money or goods you lent it, as long as it is within 1 mile of you.

essences.name: Desolate
essences.description: Desolate is the stillness of places that life has left behind. Colour seems to drain slightly from the bearer's surroundings, plants droop as they pass, and they are calmest in empty, ruined places.
essences.manifests: dead villages and cracked salt flats

grant.name: Wasteland Wanderer
grant.text: You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made in deserts, badlands, blighted land and other barren places, and you can tell at a glance roughly how long a building or settlement has been abandoned.

essences.name: Dread
essences.description: Dread is the cold weight of fear before anything has happened. Bearers move with a hunted alertness, shadows seem to lengthen near them, and they can almost taste the fear of others.
essences.manifests: haunted houses and the edges of monster lairs

grant.name: Smell Fear
grant.text: You can smell fear. You know whether any creature within 30 feet of you is frightened or badly scared, even if it hides it well.

essences.name: Echo
essences.description: Echo is sound that comes back, the repetition of what has been heard before. Bearers' voices carry a faint double tone, and they unconsciously repeat the last words others say.
essences.manifests: deep canyons and great empty halls

grant.name: Mimicry
grant.text: You can mimic any sound you have heard, including voices, animal calls and the noise of tools. A creature that hears the imitation can tell it is false with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

essences.name: Empower
essences.description: Empower is the strength that flows from encouragement and shared purpose. Allies stand a little taller around the bearer, whose voice carries a resonance that makes a simple word of support land like a war cry.
essences.manifests: soldiers' training yards

grant.name: Word of Encouragement
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an ability check, you can use your reaction to add 1d4 to the roll.

essences.name: Envy
essences.description: Envy is the sharp longing for what someone else has. Bearers' eyes take a greenish tint and follow other people's successes closely, and they learn by watching, with a sour determination to do better.
essences.manifests: the gates of rich estates and rival guildhalls

grant.name: Covetous Eye
grant.text: Once per short rest, when a creature you can see succeeds on an ability check, you can gain advantage on the next check you make with the same skill or tool within the next minute.

essences.name: Feast
essences.description: Feast is the joy of a full table and good company. Bearers carry the faint smell of fresh bread and roast meat, and the meals they cook or share leave people warm, rested and in good spirits.
essences.manifests: banquet halls after great celebrations

grant.name: Hearty Meal
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you share a meal with up to six creatures during a short rest, each creature that eats and spends at least one Hit Die regains an extra 1d4 hit points.

essences.name: Ferment
essences.description: Ferment is the bubbling change that turns grain into ale and grapes into wine. Bearers have rosy cheeks and a yeasty warmth about them, and their magic fizzes and froths like a fresh-tapped cask.
essences.manifests: breweries, wine cellars and cheese caves

grant.name: Brewer's Touch
grant.text: By touch, you can speed fermentation: dough rises in minutes, and a cask of juice or mash becomes drinkable ale or wine in 8 hours instead of weeks. You also have advantage on saving throws against becoming drunk.

essences.name: Fury
essences.description: Fury is anger hot enough to bend iron. Bearers flush red when roused, their knuckles crack and pop, and their magic arrives with a low growl like a stoked forge.
essences.manifests: riot-torn streets and arena fighting pits

grant.name: Seething Strength
grant.text: Once per short rest, when you fail a Strength check, you can reroll it with a roar of frustration. You must use the new roll.

essences.name: Grief
essences.description: Grief is the ache that love leaves behind when someone is gone. Bearers have quiet, heavy eyes and a gentle patience with the dying, and a soft grey haze hangs about their magic like the smoke of a pyre.
essences.manifests: cemeteries after funerals and battlefield graves

grant.name: Mourner's Touch
grant.text: By touching a corpse for 1 minute, you learn roughly how long ago it died and whether it died from violence, sickness, poison or old age.

essences.name: Harbour
essences.description: Harbour is the safety of a port after a long voyage. Bearers smell faintly of salt and tar, walk with a sailor's easy roll, and always seem to know when a storm is coming.
essences.manifests: busy harbours and lighthouse quays

grant.name: Tide Sense
grant.text: You always know the state of the tide on any coast you stand on, and the depth of the water beneath any vessel you are aboard.

essences.name: Hearth
essences.description: Hearth is the warmth of home and the fire that families gather around. Bearers smell faintly of woodsmoke, their hands are always warm, and their magic glows like banked embers.
essences.manifests: old family homes beside fires kept lit for generations

grant.name: Homing Sense
grant.text: When you absorb this essence, choose one dwelling as your home; you can change it by living somewhere else for a month. You always know the direction and rough distance to your home.

essences.name: Herald
essences.description: Herald is the essence of news carried and announced. Bearers develop a clear, ringing voice and a tidy memory for what they are told, and their magic arrives with a faint sound of trumpets.
essences.manifests: town criers' platforms and messenger relay posts

grant.name: Ringing Voice
grant.text: When you raise your voice, it carries clearly up to 300 feet, even over a crowd or a battle, and you can repeat any message of up to 100 words exactly after hearing it once.

essences.name: Hermit
essences.description: Hermit is the strength found in being alone. Bearers grow quiet and self-contained, comfortable with long silences, and their magic is most vivid when no one else is watching.
essences.manifests: remote mountain caves and forest huts

grant.name: Solitary Rest
grant.text: When you finish a long rest with no other humanoid within 100 feet of you, you regain one additional spent Hit Die.

essences.name: Hunger
essences.description: Hunger is endless appetite, the drive to consume and take in. Bearers have a hollow look about the eyes and a faint pull on nearby magic, and they will eat almost anything without complaint.
essences.manifests: famine-struck villages and the lairs of gluttonous monsters

grant.name: Devour
grant.text: Once per short rest, when you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you regain hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

essences.name: Magic
essences.description: Magic is mana in its rawest, most adaptable form. Blue-white motes drift around the bearer's hands, and enchanted things feel faintly warm or buzzing to their touch.
essences.manifests: mana springs and the foundations of wizards' towers

grant.name: Mana Touch
grant.text: As an action, you can touch an object to learn whether it is magical and, if it is, which school of magic it belongs to.

essences.name: Market
essences.description: Market is the noisy energy of buying and selling. Bearers develop a quick, assessing glance and a merchant's patter, and a faint chink of coins sounds when they work magic.
essences.manifests: busy market squares and trade fairs

grant.name: Merchant's Eye
grant.text: By handling a nonmagical object for 1 minute, you learn its fair market value, and you can tell when someone is asking more than twice that price for it.

essences.name: Master
essences.description: Master is the essence of authority, the right and the will to direct others. Bearers stand straighter than those around them, and their voice holds a weight that makes people stop and listen.
essences.manifests: noble courts and garrison command tents

grant.name: Voice of Command
grant.text: You have advantage on Charisma checks made to give orders to hirelings, servants, crew or soldiers under your authority, or to restore order to a panicked crowd.

essences.name: Mercy
essences.description: Mercy is the choice to spare, to heal and to forgive. Bearers have a gentle touch and steady hands, and wounded creatures, even hostile ones, often grow calm when they kneel beside them.
essences.manifests: temple infirmaries and field hospitals

grant.name: Gentle Hands
grant.text: You automatically succeed on Wisdom (Medicine) checks made to stabilize a dying creature, and a creature you stabilize regains 1 hit point after 10 minutes rather than 1d4 hours.

essences.name: Mire
essences.description: Mire is the patient grip of bog and marsh, which holds on to whatever it takes. Bearers walk with a heavy, deliberate tread, their boots never quite dry, and their magic seeps out like dark water.
essences.manifests: deep bogs and fog-bound marshes

grant.name: Ground Sense
grant.text: You automatically notice quicksand, sinkholes, thin ice, rotten floorboards and other ground within 30 feet of you that would not bear your weight. This does not reveal deliberately hidden traps.

essences.name: Mirror
essences.description: Mirror is the reflection that shows exactly what stands before it, nothing more and nothing less. Bearers' eyes take on a faint silvery sheen, and they catch themselves studying reflections as if checking that the world is honest.
essences.manifests: still mountain tarns and mirror-makers' workshops

grant.name: True Reflection
grant.text: You have advantage on checks made to see through an illusion or a disguise while you are looking at its reflection in a mirror, still water or polished metal.

essences.name: Mirth
essences.description: Mirth is the bright, infectious joy of shared laughter. Bearers have laugh lines that deepen quickly and a grin that is hard not to return, and their magic sparkles like festival lanterns.
essences.manifests: taverns on festival nights and travelling circuses

grant.name: Crowd Pleaser
grant.text: You have advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks made to make an audience laugh, whether through jokes, pratfalls or clever mockery.

essences.name: Moult
essences.description: Moult is the shedding of an old skin so that something new can grow. Bearers' skin is smooth and faintly glossy, they slough dry flakes when stressed, and their magic peels away from them like a husk.
essences.manifests: serpent nests and the moulting grounds of giant insects

grant.name: Shed Skin
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you finish a short rest, you can shed a papery husk of skin and end the poisoned condition or one nonmagical disease affecting you.

essences.name: Oath
essences.description: Oath is the force of a sworn word. Bearers speak carefully and keep promises to the letter, and when they make a vow a faint ring of light briefly circles their wrist.
essences.manifests: knightly chapels and halls where sworn pacts are sealed

grant.name: Broken Vow
grant.text: You always know when a creature breaks a promise it made directly to you, though not where it is or how the promise was broken.

essences.name: Omen
essences.description: Omen is the shadow the future casts ahead of itself. Crows gather on rooftops near the bearer, a chill touches the air when they speak a warning, and now and then they glimpse a moment before it happens.
essences.manifests: crow-haunted belfries and soothsayers' tents

grant.name: Portent
grant.text: When you finish a long rest, roll a d20 and record the number. Once before your next long rest, you can replace the d20 roll for one ability check you make with the recorded number. You must decide before you roll.

essences.name: Patience
essences.description: Patience is the quiet strength of waiting and working without hurry. Bearers move slowly and deliberately, rarely raise their voice, and seem untroubled by delays that drive others mad.
essences.manifests: fishing piers and monastery meditation gardens

grant.name: Unhurried Hands
grant.text: When you spend at least 10 minutes on an ability check using a tool you are proficient with, you can treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

essences.name: Pilgrim
essences.description: Pilgrim is the devotion of the long road walked for something greater. Bearers have weathered faces and tireless legs, and they find small comfort in every wayside shrine.
essences.manifests: pilgrim roads and roadside shrines

grant.name: Long Road
grant.text: You have advantage on saving throws against exhaustion caused by travel, hunger, thirst, heat or cold.

essences.name: Potent
essences.description: Potent is power pushed past its usual bounds. A pressure builds in the air before the bearer acts, and their spells and blows flare brighter and land harder than they should.
essences.manifests: overflowing mana wells and sites of magical accidents

grant.name: Surge
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you roll damage for an attack or a spell, you can reroll any of the damage dice that rolled a 1 or 2. You must use the new rolls.

essences.name: Pride
essences.description: Pride is the refusal to bow, for good or ill. Bearers hold their chins high and their backs straight, dress with care, and find it physically hard to kneel to anyone.
essences.manifests: palace throne rooms and champions' halls

grant.name: Unbowed
grant.text: You have advantage on Wisdom checks and saving throws made to resist being taunted, goaded, shamed or intimidated.

essences.name: Quarry
essences.description: Quarry is the patient labour of cutting stone from the earth. Bearers gain thick, dusty calluses and a stonemason's eye, and their magic sounds like a chisel ringing on rock.
essences.manifests: working stone quarries and deep mine shafts

grant.name: Stonecutter's Ear
grant.text: By tapping on a stone wall, ceiling or floor for 1 minute, you can tell whether it is close to collapse and where its weakest point is.

essences.name: Rot
essences.theme: Decay, mould and return to soil
essences.description: Rot is the slow breaking down of dead things into new soil. Bearers carry a damp, earthy smell, pale mould sometimes freckles their skin, and their magic spreads like creeping fungus.
essences.manifests: rotting forest floors and fungal caverns

grant.name: Carrion Hardy
grant.text: You never catch nonmagical diseases from corpses, carrion, filth or rotting food, and you have advantage on saving throws against all other diseases.

essences.name: Rune
essences.description: Rune is magic given shape through writing and symbol. Faint script traces itself across the bearer's hands as they work, and their spells leave brief glowing glyphs hanging in the air.
essences.manifests: ancient runestones and enchanters' workshops

grant.name: Glyph Sight
grant.text: You can tell at a glance whether writing or a drawn symbol is magical, and you have advantage on checks made to find magical glyphs, runes and sigils, such as a glyph of warding.

essences.name: Rust
essences.description: Rust is the slow victory of time and damp over metal. Bearers leave orange flecks on iron they handle, carry a tang of wet metal on their breath, and their magic crawls outward in red-brown blooms.
essences.manifests: scrapyards and old battlefields strewn with rotting armour

grant.name: Flaking Touch
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a nonmagical metal object that no one is wearing or carrying, such as a chain, hinge, bar or lock, and make it rust. For the next hour, Strength checks made to break or force it have advantage.

essences.name: Secret
essences.description: Secret is the essence of what is hidden and kept. Bearers speak softly and smile knowingly, and they feel a tug of curiosity toward locked drawers and walls that sound hollow.
essences.manifests: hidden rooms and spy-haunted palace corridors

grant.name: Hidden Ways
grant.text: You have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Perception) checks made to find secret doors, hidden compartments and concealed panels.

essences.name: Shepherd
essences.description: Shepherd is the watchful care of those who guide and protect others. Bearers have a calm, low voice and a habit of counting heads, and animals drift toward them as if expecting to be led.
essences.manifests: upland sheep pastures and drovers' roads

grant.name: Flock Keeper
grant.text: You have advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks made to calm, herd or lead domestic animals.

essences.name: Sin
essences.description: Sin is the weight of wrongdoing and the corruption it spreads. People near the bearer find themselves recalling their regrets, and dark veins briefly spread across the bearer's skin when they use magic.
essences.manifests: prisons and the scenes of unpunished crimes

grant.name: Scent of Guilt
grant.text: You have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to tell whether a creature is hiding something it feels guilty about.

essences.name: Smuggler
essences.description: Smuggler is the knack for moving what others want stopped. Bearers develop quick hands and a forgettable smile, and the things they carry have a way of being overlooked.
essences.manifests: hidden coves and cellars beneath dockside taverns

grant.name: False Bottom
grant.text: You have advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to conceal an object on your person or among your baggage or cargo.

essences.name: Thaw
essences.description: Thaw is the turning point when winter loosens its grip. Bearers' hands are always warm and faintly damp, their breath never fogs in the cold, and ice drips wherever they linger.
essences.manifests: melting glaciers and snowfields in early spring

grant.name: Melting Touch
grant.text: By touching ice or snow you can melt up to a 1-foot cube of it each minute, and you can tell at a glance whether ice will bear your weight.

essences.name: Thorn
essences.description: Thorn is the defence of growing things that refuse to be trampled. Bearers have a prickly temper, their knuckles roughen like bark, and their magic sprouts in twisting barbed tendrils.
essences.manifests: bramble thickets and overgrown hedge mazes

grant.name: Bramble Walker
grant.text: Nonmagical brambles, thornbushes and dense undergrowth don't count as difficult terrain for you, and their thorns never harm you or snag your gear.

essences.name: Valour
essences.theme: Courage in the face of danger
essences.description: Valour is the courage to stand when others run. Bearers have steady eyes and an easy, confident stance, and their magic burns with a clear, unwavering light.
essences.manifests: fortress walls and knightly tourney grounds

grant.name: Rallying Cry
grant.text: Once per long rest, when an ally you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against being frightened, you can use your reaction to let it reroll the save.

essences.name: Vigil
essences.description: Vigil is the watch kept while others sleep. Bearers have steady, rarely blinking eyes and seldom yawn, and their magic glows like a single candle in a dark window.
essences.manifests: city watchtowers and candlelit wakes

grant.name: Unsleeping
grant.text: You don't need to sleep. Instead, you gain the benefits of a long rest by spending 6 hours in quiet watch, during which you remain conscious and aware of your surroundings.

essences.name: Void
essences.description: Void is the empty space between things, where nothing echoes and nothing remains. Sound dulls slightly around the bearer, and their reflection looks faintly hollow, as if something is missing behind the eyes.
essences.manifests: sealed vaults and soundless deep caverns

grant.name: Empty Mind
grant.text: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that would read your thoughts or force you to speak the truth, such as detect thoughts and zone of truth.

essences.name: Wager
essences.theme: Risk, chance and the gambler's nerve
essences.description: Wager is the thrill of staking everything on a single throw. Bearers have restless, coin-rolling fingers and a gambler's grin, and dice tumble in the light of their magic.
essences.manifests: gambling dens and horse-racing tracks

grant.name: Double or Nothing
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can give yourself advantage on an ability check. If you do, the next ability check you make within the following hour has disadvantage.

essences.name: Amber
essences.description: The essence of the sap that captures a moment forever. Bearers' eyes turn a warm honey-gold, their skin smells faintly of pine, and their spells glow with a thick, slow-moving light.
essences.manifests: ancient pine forests weeping resin

grant.name: Resin Seal
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a corpse, or a piece of food, plant matter or other dead organic material, no larger than Medium and coat it in a thin golden glaze. It doesn't decay for 10 days.

essences.name: Avatar
essences.theme: Embodiment of divine or primal power
essences.description: The essence of a god or a primal force made flesh. When a bearer acts with conviction, a larger, ghostly outline of themselves looms around them, and their voice carries two tones at once, one their own and one far deeper.
essences.manifests: the inner sanctums of forgotten temples

grant.name: Looming Form
grant.text: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can wreathe yourself in a towering spectral outline for 1 minute. For the duration, you count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the size of creatures you can grapple or shove.

essences.name: Basilisk
essences.theme: The stare that turns flesh to stone
essences.description: The essence of the reptile whose gaze petrifies. Bearers rarely blink, their eyes take on a dull green glitter, and a light grey crust like weathered stone forms over their knuckles and along their spine.
essences.manifests: statue-crowded caves in the badlands

grant.name: Stiffening Stare
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can fix your stare on a creature within 30 feet of you that can see you. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier) or have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn as its limbs stiffen like stone.

essences.name: Bell
essences.description: The essence of the bronze voice that calls the faithful and warns of fire. Bearers stand with a resonant stillness, their voice has a ringing clarity even when they whisper, and their spells sound a single clear note as they are cast.
essences.manifests: the cracked bells of drowned chapels

grant.name: Tolling Call
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can ring out a single deep bell note. Every creature you choose within 1 mile of you hears it clearly through walls and noise, and knows the direction it came from. Other creatures hear nothing.

essences.name: Brine
essences.theme: Preservation, purity and the sea's bitterness
essences.description: The essence of the crystal that keeps meat from rot and spirits at bay. Bearers carry a dry, briny smell, they unconsciously flick a pinch of salt over their shoulder before a journey, and their spells crackle with tiny white crystals.
essences.manifests: deep salt mines and brine springs

grant.name: Salt-Blooded
grant.text: You can safely drink seawater and brine as if it were fresh water, and food you carry on your person never spoils.

essences.name: Cataclysm
essences.theme: Disaster and devastation on a grand scale
essences.description: The essence of the earthquake, the avalanche and the city that falls in a single night. A bearer's anger makes cups rattle and dust sift from the rafters, storm clouds seem to gather when they brood, and they wake uneasy hours before the ground moves.
essences.manifests: earthquake rifts and the rubble of fallen cities

grant.name: Harbinger's Dread
grant.text: You feel natural disasters before they strike. You know at least 10 minutes in advance when an earthquake, cave-in, avalanche, flood, storm surge or volcanic eruption will affect the area within 1 mile of you, and roughly which direction the danger will come from.

essences.name: Chimera
essences.description: The essence of the creature made of lion, goat and serpent. A bearer's features become subtly mismatched, perhaps one slitted goat's eye or a tawny streak of mane, and their spells growl, bleat and hiss as they are cast.
essences.manifests: the ruined menageries of mad wizards

grant.name: Three Throats
grant.text: You can make up to three different sounds at once, such as speaking while also growling and bleating, and you can mimic the call of any beast you have heard. A creature that hears the mimicry can tell it is an imitation with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

essences.name: Chrysalis
essences.description: The essence of the cocoon where one form dissolves into another. Bearers sleep curled tightly, often wrapped to the crown of their head, and their magic shimmers with the wet, iridescent colours of a freshly unfolded wing.
essences.manifests: silk-hung hollows where giant moths pupate

grant.name: Remade by Morning
grant.text: When you finish a long rest, you can exchange one of your skill proficiencies for proficiency in a different skill. The change lasts until you finish your next long rest.

essences.name: Cipher
essences.description: The essence of the dark drop that holds a word. A bearer's fingertips are stained a permanent blue-black, the veins at their wrists show faintly dark, and their spells leave curling marks on the air like wet script.
essences.manifests: the ink-clouded grottos of giant squid

grant.name: Inkwell Fingers
grant.text: You can write with your fingertip on any surface, leaving ink that never smudges or runs. As a bonus action, you can touch writing you made this way to make it invisible, or visible again.

essences.name: Clockwork
essences.description: The essence of interlocking parts turning in perfect time. Bearers develop a faint ticking under their breath when they concentrate, their movements become neat and measured, and their spells assemble in the air as spinning brass-coloured rings.
essences.manifests: the workings of great tower clocks

grant.name: Mechanism Sense
grant.text: By placing your hand on a nonmagical mechanical device for 1 minute, such as a lock, a trap's housing, a mill or a clock, you learn what it is built to do, what powers it, and where its trigger, keyhole or release is. You don't learn how to disarm or open it.

essences.name: Crucible
essences.description: The essence of the vessel where metal is melted down and purified. Bearers run warm to the touch and grow hard to fluster under pressure, and their spells glow white-hot at the edges like molten metal pouring.
essences.manifests: the slag heaps of old smelteries

grant.name: Assayer's Touch
grant.text: By holding a metal object, coin or gemstone for 1 minute, you learn exactly what it is made of and how pure it is, which reveals forgeries, counterfeit coins and fake gems.

essences.name: Effigy
essences.theme: A likeness made to suffer instead
essences.description: The essence of the straw figure burned in someone's place. Bearers have a habit of knotting little figures of the people they meet, and when they cast spells, a faint smell of burnt straw lingers.
essences.manifests: the ashes of festival bonfires

grant.name: Stand-In
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes binding a small effigy of yourself from straw, cloth or twigs. While you carry it, the first time you would gain a level of exhaustion, the effigy crumbles to ash and you don't gain that level. You can have only one such effigy at a time.

essences.name: Flotsam
essences.description: The essence of what floats free after the ship goes down. Bearers have a sun-faded, salt-stained look however they dress, they pick up odd useful scraps everywhere they go, and their magic bobs and drifts lazily before it lands.
essences.manifests: the tidelines of shipwreck coasts

grant.name: Washed Up
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you spend 10 minutes searching wreckage, a battlefield, a rubbish heap or a shoreline, you find one mundane item of your choice from the adventuring gear table that costs 2 gp or less, such as a length of rope, a crowbar or a waterskin.

essences.name: Fossil
essences.description: The essence of ancient life written into rock. Bearers become patient and slow to anger, their skin takes on faint banded patterns like layered sediment, and their magic carries the dry, mineral smell of a quarry.
essences.manifests: bone-studded quarry cliffs

grant.name: Stone Memory
grant.text: By touching a bone, a stone or a crafted object for 1 minute, you know roughly how long ago it was formed, made or last part of a living thing, to within a century.

essences.name: Fuse
essences.description: The essence of time trickling away grain by grain. Bearers never seem rushed but are never late, their eyes take on a pale sandy gold, and a faint hiss like falling sand follows their spells.
essences.manifests: desert ruins where sand pours through broken roofs

grant.name: Grains Remaining
grant.text: You know the exact time remaining on every spell, potion and other magical effect with a duration that is affecting you or an object you touch.

essences.name: Gallows
essences.theme: Judgement, last words and the drop
essences.description: Gallows embodies the moment before an ending, when the truth finally comes out. Its bearer has a stillness people find unnerving, a faint rope-burn mark appears around their throat, and their voice carries in silence like a verdict.
essences.manifests: old execution grounds and crossroads gibbets

grant.name: Last Words
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you dies, you hear its final thought spoken aloud as a single sentence in a language you understand.

essences.name: Gargoyle
essences.theme: Stone sentinel watching from the heights
essences.description: The essence of the carved guardian perched on the cathedral roof. Bearers like high places and can sit perfectly still for hours, their skin grows cool and slightly rough like weathered stone, and their magic settles with a sound like grinding gravel.
essences.manifests: the gutter-spouts of ancient cathedral roofs

grant.name: Stone Vigil
grant.text: You can take a long rest sitting or crouching perfectly still instead of sleeping. While you do, you remain aware of your surroundings as if you were awake and keeping watch, though moving or speaking interrupts the rest.

essences.name: Garuda
essences.theme: Storm-riding sun bird, bane of serpents
essences.description: The essence of the great golden bird that rides the storm front and hunts serpents from the sky. Bearers grow fine gold-edged feathers along their forearms, their gaze snaps upward at every shadow overhead, and their magic crackles with the smell of coming rain.
essences.manifests: lightning-struck mountain eyries

grant.name: Serpent-Hunter's Eye
grant.text: You can sense any snake, naga or other serpent-bodied creature within 60 feet of you, even through walls, and you know the direction of the nearest one, though not its exact location.

essences.name: Glass
essences.description: The essence of sand made clear by fire. A bearer's skin takes on a faint glossy sheen, their eyes become clear as polished marbles, and their spells give off a brittle, chiming glitter like sunlight through a window.
essences.manifests: lightning-fused desert dunes

grant.name: Glassworker's Touch
grant.text: You can soften glass with your bare hands, shaping up to 1 pound of it per minute as if it were warm wax; it hardens again when you let go. You can also mend a crack or break in a glass object by running your finger along it.

essences.name: Hydra
essences.description: The essence of the serpent that grows two heads for every one cut away. Bearers' wounds close with puckered pink new flesh that leaves no scar, they can argue both sides of anything, and their magic forks and splits as it leaves their hands.
essences.manifests: fens where rivers split into countless channels

grant.name: Regrowth
grant.text: When you roll Hit Dice to regain hit points, you can reroll any die that shows a 1. In addition, a lost finger, tooth, eye or limb slowly regrows over 30 days.

essences.name: Key
essences.description: The essence of the small thing that opens great doors. Bearers fidget with locks and latches without noticing, doors seem to swing a little easier for them, and their magic turns in the air with a faint metallic click.
essences.manifests: the sealed vaults of forgotten treasuries

grant.name: Matching Lock
grant.text: While you hold a key, you know the direction to the lock it opens, as long as that lock is within 1 mile of you.

essences.name: Kite
essences.description: Kite is the joy of riding the wind while something holds the string. Its bearer seems lighter than they should be, their clothes always stir in a breeze no one else feels, and their magic trails ribbons of pale colour.
essences.manifests: clifftop festival grounds and high windy ridges

grant.name: Glide
grant.text: When you make a long or high jump, you can glide: you travel up to 30 extra feet horizontally before landing, descending 5 feet for every 10 feet you glide, and you take no falling damage from that jump.

essences.name: Labyrinth
essences.theme: Winding passages and the way back
essences.description: The essence of the maze and of the thread that leads out of it. Bearers pause at every junction as if listening, trace winding patterns on tabletops with a fingertip, and their magic coils outward in tight, angular spirals.
essences.manifests: the deepest galleries of minotaur lairs

grant.name: Unwinding Thread
grant.text: You can always retrace, step for step, any route you have walked in the last 7 days, even in darkness or fog, and you know whenever you are walking in a loop.

essences.name: Lantern
essences.theme: A guarded light carried through darkness
essences.description: The essence of the light that is carried, hooded and kept safe. Bearers have a warm amber glint behind their eyes in dark places, they instinctively shield candles from the wind, and their magic glows from within, like a flame behind horn panes.
essences.manifests: the lamp rooms of old lighthouses

grant.name: Hooded Light
grant.text: When you hold a lit lantern, torch or candle, you can hood its glow as a bonus action so that only you can see its light. You see by it normally, but for every other creature the area stays as dark as it would be without it. You can unhood it as a bonus action.

essences.name: Lodestone
essences.theme: Magnetism and the pull of iron
essences.description: The essence of the stone that draws iron and always points north. Bearers feel a faint tug toward forges and armouries, loose nails roll toward their boots, and compass needles twitch as their spells are cast.
essences.manifests: iron-rich caves where compasses spin

grant.name: Iron Pull
grant.text: As an action, you can pull one loose iron or steel object weighing no more than 1 pound that isn't being worn or carried, within 15 feet of you, through the air to your hand.

essences.name: Lullaby
essences.description: The essence of the song hummed over a cradle. A bearer's voice softens and slows, crying children and nervous horses quiet near them, and their magic drifts out in gentle, rocking waves.
essences.manifests: the hushed nurseries of old manor houses

grant.name: Cradle Song
grant.text: As an action, you can hum to a non-hostile beast or a young child within 30 feet of you that can hear you. If it isn't in combat, its fear or distress fades, and it falls asleep within 1 minute if left undisturbed. It wakes normally if harmed or shaken.

essences.name: Mandrake
essences.description: The essence of the man-shaped root that shrieks when pulled from the earth. Bearers smell of damp soil, their fingers grow knotted like roots, and when they cast spells, a thin scream rings at the edge of hearing.
essences.manifests: the soil beneath gallows trees

grant.name: Root-Wise Tongue
grant.text: By tasting a tiny piece of any plant or fungus, you know whether it is poisonous, edible or medicinal, and roughly what effect it has. Tasting it this way never harms you.

essences.name: Marionette
essences.description: The essence of the figure that moves at someone else's will. A bearer's fingers twitch as if plucking strings while they think, their gestures become oddly jointed yet graceful, and their magic flows along faint lines of light.
essences.manifests: the lofts of abandoned puppet theatres

grant.name: Puppeteer's Strings
grant.text: As an action, you can animate a doll, puppet or carved figure no larger than Tiny for up to 1 minute, as long as you concentrate as if on a spell. It moves up to 15 feet on each of your turns at your direction and can make simple gestures or mimic your movements, but it can't attack, activate objects or carry more than 1 pound.

essences.name: Mask
essences.description: The essence of the false face and the person who hides behind it. Bearers become strangely hard to picture once they leave a room, they collect masks the way others collect rings, and their magic leaves a faint lacquered shine in the air.
essences.manifests: the masquerade halls of decadent palaces

grant.name: Forgettable Face
grant.text: While you wear a mask, creatures that see you can later recall the mask in perfect detail, but only vague impressions of your height, build, hair and voice. Magic that reads their memories shows the same blur.

essences.name: Mimic
essences.description: The essence of the chest that bites. Bearers grow unnervingly good at standing still, their palms turn faintly tacky when they are tense, and their magic sticks and clings to whatever it touches.
essences.manifests: the treasure rooms of looted dungeons

grant.name: Adhesive Grip
grant.text: You can make your palms sticky or dry at will. While they are sticky, you have advantage on ability checks and saving throws to keep hold of an object you are holding, or of a rope, ledge or wall you are climbing.

essences.name: Mirage
essences.description: The essence of the oasis that is not there. Bearers seem to waver slightly at the edges when seen from a distance, their voices sound farther off than they are, and their spells ripple like air over hot stone.
essences.manifests: sun-scorched salt flats at midday

grant.name: Heat Shimmer
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature you can see makes a ranged attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to make the air around you waver, imposing disadvantage on that roll.

essences.name: Onslaught
essences.description: The essence of an attack that does not stop once it has begun. Bearers walk as if leaning into a headwind, their heartbeat thuds like a war drum when a fight starts, and their strikes leave faint after-images that blur together.
essences.manifests: breached fortress gates and old siege lines

grant.name: Unbroken Advance
grant.text: Once per short rest, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, you can immediately move up to 10 feet toward another hostile creature you can see. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

essences.name: Pearl
essences.description: The essence of the irritant turned to treasure, layer by patient layer. Bearers have a soft, milky lustre to their skin and nails, they grow calmer the more something bothers them, and their magic gleams with a pale rainbow sheen.
essences.manifests: oyster beds in still lagoons

grant.name: Nacre
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you would become poisoned, you can instead seal the poison away inside you and not become poisoned. At the end of your next short or long rest, you cough it up as a tiny, worthless grey pearl.

essences.name: Perfume
essences.description: The essence of fragrance distilled from blossom and smoke. Bearers always smell faintly of a flower no one can name, they remember places by their scent, and their magic leaves a lingering sweetness in the air.
essences.manifests: night-blooming perfumers' gardens

grant.name: Borrowed Scent
grant.text: As an action, you can give yourself or an object you touch any scent you have smelled before, lasting up to 8 hours. While you wear a borrowed scent, creatures tracking you by smell have disadvantage on checks to do so.

essences.name: Prism
essences.description: The essence of the crystal that breaks white light into colour. A bearer's eyes shift hue with the light, small rainbows scatter wherever they stand in the sun, and their spells flare with bands of vivid colour.
essences.manifests: crystal caverns pierced by sunlight

grant.name: Light Bender
grant.text: As an action, you can take hold of the light from one source within 30 feet of you, such as a torch, a lantern or sunlight through a window, and for up to 1 hour make it shine in a different direction, split into rainbows, or change colour. Its brightness and range don't change.

essences.name: Quicksilver
essences.description: The essence of the metal that flows like water. A bearer's fingertips take on a faint mirrored sheen, they are as hard to pin down in conversation as in a fight, and their magic beads and runs like spilled mercury.
essences.manifests: cinnabar caverns beneath volcanic hills

grant.name: Slip Free
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you are grappled or restrained, you can use your reaction to slip free, ending that condition on yourself.

essences.name: Resonance
essences.description: The essence of the voice that comes back from the canyon wall. A bearer's words repeat faintly a heartbeat after they speak, they have a habit of repeating the last word of other people's sentences, and their spells ring with a hollow, doubled sound.
essences.manifests: deep canyons and empty cathedral naves

grant.name: Lingering Echo
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute listening in silence to recall the sounds of the place you are in. You hear, faint and distant, any one minute of your choice from the last hour in that place, such as voices, footsteps or a struggle.

essences.name: Scarab
essences.theme: Tomb beetle of burial and rebirth
essences.description: The essence of the beetle that rolls the sun across the sky and guards the sealed tomb. A bearer's nails harden into glossy, iridescent shell, they feel at ease underground, and their magic clicks and glints like a beetle's carapace.
essences.manifests: sun-baked valleys of royal tombs

grant.name: Hollow Sense
grant.text: You can sense hollow spaces such as tombs, crypts, burrows and hidden chambers within 30 feet of you through stone, sand or earth. You know their rough size and direction, but not what they contain.

essences.name: Scarecrow
essences.theme: Lonely watcher that wards the fields
essences.description: The essence of the straw figure that stands guard over the harvest. Bearers grow lanky and loose-limbed, smell of dry straw, and draw a wary berth from crows, while their magic rustles like wind through a stubble field.
essences.manifests: lonely fields at harvest's end

grant.name: Field Warden
grant.text: Birds and other Tiny beasts with an Intelligence of 3 or lower won't willingly come within 10 feet of you unless they are magically compelled. You can suppress or resume this effect at will.

essences.name: Shroud
essences.description: The essence of the cloth wound around the dead. Bearers grow pale and quiet, favour layered, wrapped clothing, and their magic hangs about them like a faint grey veil that muffles sound.
essences.manifests: catacombs where the dead lie wrapped

grant.name: Deathlike Trance
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can fall into a deathlike trance for up to 1 hour. You are incapacitated but can still hear, and you appear dead to all outward inspection; a creature that examines you can tell you are alive only with a successful Wisdom (Medicine) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. You can end the trance at any time (no action required).

essences.name: Silk
essences.description: The essence of the thread spun by worm and spider, soft to the touch and stronger than it looks. A bearer's hair grows fine and lustrous, their clothes never seem to wrinkle, and their magic trails gleaming strands that drift in the air before fading.
essences.manifests: the webbed hollows of giant spiders

grant.name: Spun Thread
grant.text: Once per short rest, as an action, you can draw up to 50 feet of fine cord from your fingertips. It functions as silk rope and unravels into dust after 1 hour.

essences.name: Siren
essences.description: The essence of the voice that calls sailors onto the rocks. A bearer's voice takes on a haunting, lilting quality, they hum to themselves near water, and their spells carry a high, sweet note that lingers too long.
essences.manifests: wreck-strewn reefs and sea stacks

grant.name: Carrying Voice
grant.text: As an action, you can speak or sing to one creature you can see within 300 feet of you. Only that creature hears you, as clearly as if you stood beside it, though it can't reply this way.

essences.name: Spore
essences.theme: Hidden fungal networks beneath the ground
essences.description: The essence of the fungal threads that link every root in the forest. Bearers' skin takes on a faint pale speckling, they smell of damp earth after rain, and their spells burst outward in soft clouds of glowing dust.
essences.manifests: the mushroom forests of deep caverns

grant.name: Mycelial Whisper
grant.text: While you touch soil or rotting wood threaded with fungus, you can sense the number and rough size of the creatures that have walked within 100 feet of that spot in the last hour.

essences.name: Tapestry
essences.theme: Woven threads that bind people together
essences.description: The essence of many threads made into a single picture. Bearers see the world in patterns, absent-mindedly braid loose threads from their sleeves, and their magic unspools as shimmering coloured fibres.
essences.manifests: the weaving halls of old guild palaces

grant.name: Threads Between
grant.text: After watching a group of creatures interact for 1 minute, you see faint threads between them: you learn which of them the others defer to, and which two share the strongest bond, whether loyalty, love or hatred.

essences.name: Tidepool
essences.theme: Small worlds left by the tide
essences.description: Tidepool is the hidden life that survives between tides, patient and abundant. Its bearer smells faintly of salt and kelp, their eyes have the sheen of wet stone, and small shells and sea-glass seem to collect in their pockets.
essences.manifests: rocky shores at the lowest spring tides

grant.name: Pool Eyes
grant.text: You can hold your breath for 1 hour, and underwater you can see clearly out to 60 feet even in murky or silty water.

essences.name: Transfiguration
essences.description: The essence of one thing becoming another. A bearer's features drift subtly between meetings, a ripple passes over their skin when they cast a spell, and they often catch themselves idly changing the colour of a fingernail while they think.
essences.manifests: transmutation circles in ruined wizard towers

grant.name: Malleable Features
grant.text: As an action, you can change one cosmetic feature of your body: hair colour or length, eye colour, skin tone, or a pattern of freckles, scars or markings. The change lasts until you undo it. It can't alter your height, build, voice or the shape of your face, so people who know you can still recognise you.

essences.name: Verdict
essences.description: The essence of the final word of a judge. Bearers grow still and level-voiced, people instinctively stand straighter when they enter a room, and their spells fall with the heavy finality of a gavel.
essences.manifests: the benches of ancient courthouses

grant.name: Weighed and Found
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature within 10 feet of you whose face you can see answers a question you asked it, you can learn whether the creature believes its answer is true. It isn't aware that you did so.

essences.name: Vessel
essences.description: The essence of the cup, the urn and the body that holds something greater than itself. Bearers have an echoing hollowness to their voice, and when they drink or cast a spell, a faint glow shows through their skin like light through paper.
essences.manifests: sealed urns in temple undercrofts

grant.name: Held Draught
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you drink a potion, you can hold it inside you instead of letting it take effect. At any point in the next 8 hours, you can release it as a bonus action, gaining its effects as though you had just drunk it. If you don't release it in time, it is lost.

essences.name: Weathervane
essences.theme: Reading the turning of the wind
essences.description: The essence of the iron rooster that swings with every change in the weather. Bearers often turn their faces into the breeze and sniff the air, their joints ache before rain, and their magic spins out in quick, swirling gusts.
essences.manifests: the spires of lonely hilltop barns

grant.name: Turn the Wind
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can turn the wind: for 1 minute, you choose the direction a natural wind blows within 30 feet of you.

essences.name: Wisp
essences.theme: Luring marsh-lights that feed on death
essences.description: The essence of the pale light that leads travellers off the path. Bearers' eyes take on a cold blue-green glimmer in the dark, they feel drawn to sickbeds and battlefields, and their spells float away as drifting, flickering motes.
essences.manifests: fog-bound marshes and bog graves

grant.name: Ebbing Lights
grant.text: You can sense any creature within 60 feet of you that is dying, or that died within the last minute, and you know its location. You perceive it as a faint, guttering glow, even through walls.

essences.name: Abyss
essences.description: Abyss is the depth that has no floor, the hungry dark beneath the world. The bearer's pupils widen until their eyes look almost black and their voice carries a faint echo as if called down a well, and others recognise them by the vertigo they feel when they meet that gaze too long.
essences.manifests: sinkholes that swallowed whole towns

grant.name: Plumbline
grant.text: You always know the exact distance straight down to solid ground beneath you, and the depth of any pit, chasm or body of water you look into, even if you can't see the bottom.

essences.name: Aether
essences.theme: The mana flowing through all things
essences.description: Aether is raw mana, the invisible current that makes Pallimustus a world of magic. The bearer's veins glow faint blue when they concentrate, and Magic Society scholars recognise them instantly and tend to ask whether they would mind being studied.
essences.manifests: the craters of ancient mana well explosions

grant.name: Essence Sense
grant.text: You sense the direction and rough distance of any unabsorbed essence or awakening stone within 300 feet of you.

essences.name: Ancestor
essences.theme: The voices of those who came before
essences.description: Ancestor is the long memory of every generation, carried forward. Its bearer sometimes speaks in phrases from a century ago, their shadow looks briefly like someone else, and old families seek them out to settle disputes about lineage and inheritance.
essences.manifests: family crypts and burial mounds tended for generations

grant.name: Ask the Elders
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes in quiet reflection to ask one question about the history of a place, family or object you are touching. The DM answers truthfully with a short phrase, as long as the answer was known to someone who has died.

essences.name: Astral
