essences.description: Astral is the silvery void between the planes, where thought itself is a road. The bearer's eyes take on a mirror-bright sheen, and anyone who watches them sleep recognises them by the thin silver thread that seems to rise from their chest and vanish into the air.
essences.manifests: the scars of old planar rifts

grant.name: Planar Sense
grant.text: You always know which plane of existence you are on, and you sense the direction of any portal, planar rift or place where the boundary between planes is thin within 1 mile of you.

essences.name: Atlas
essences.theme: The one who carries the map of the world
essences.description: Atlas is the burden and the knowledge of the whole world held at once. Its bearer has broad, steady shoulders and a habit of drawing maps in the dust, and explorers' guilds pay handsomely just to sit and talk with them.
essences.manifests: the summits of the tallest mountains, where all the land can be seen

grant.name: Perfect Map
grant.text: You can perfectly recall any map you have looked at for at least 1 minute and redraw it from memory. You always know the distance and direction to any place you have visited.

essences.name: Aurora
essences.theme: Shimmering lights over the frozen north
essences.description: Aurora is the ribbon of light that dances over the frozen north. The bearer's hair and eyes shimmer with drifting green and violet and their breath steams in faint colours on cold nights, and northern folk recognise them as one blessed by the sky.
essences.manifests: glaciers that swallowed ancient northern cities

grant.name: Sky Curtain
grant.text: As an action, you can make shifting curtains of coloured light ripple across the sky above you, visible for 10 miles, and shape them into a simple pattern or signal. They fade after 10 minutes or when you dismiss them.

essences.name: Banshee
essences.description: Banshee is the wailing spirit that mourns a death before it comes. The bearer's pale hair drifts in a breeze no one else feels, and old families recognise them with dread, for a Banshee bearer weeping at a door is said to foretell a funeral.
essences.manifests: ancestral halls of bloodlines that died out

grant.name: Keening
grant.text: When you finish a long rest, choose up to five willing creatures. Until your next long rest, you know whenever one of them drops to 0 hit points or dies, and which one it was, wherever it is on the same plane.

essences.name: Behemoth
essences.theme: The colossal beast of the first lands
essences.description: Behemoth is the vast land beast whose footsteps pressed out the valleys. The bearer grows broad and heavy-boned and floorboards creak beneath them, and anyone who sees them shoulder a loaded cart out of a ditch recognises the strength of something far bigger.
essences.manifests: bone fields where primordial beasts fell

grant.name: Ground Sense
grant.text: You can feel the ground: you know the location of every Large or larger creature moving across the ground within 300 feet of you.

essences.name: Comet
essences.description: Comet is the fire-tailed wanderer whose return heralds great change. A luminous streak trails behind the bearer's hair when they run, and common folk recognise them as an omen, though they never quite agree of what.
essences.manifests: glassy plains scorched by a comet's fall

grant.name: Comet Trail
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can name a creature you can see. Until your next long rest, you know its direction and distance from you, as if a faint comet trail hung over it.

essences.name: Crown
essences.description: Crown is rule itself, the weight of the right to command that kingdoms are built around. When the bearer speaks with authority a faint circlet of golden light seems to rest on their brow, and courtiers and commoners alike recognise them as someone born, or chosen, to lead.
essences.manifests: the throne rooms of fallen kingdoms

grant.name: Uncrowned Royalty
grant.text: Guards, servants and common folk treat you as a person of noble rank unless shown clear proof otherwise, and you can always secure an audience with a local lord or magistrate within a day.

essences.name: Djinn
essences.description: Djinn is the spirit of smokeless fire that grants wishes and keeps bargains to the letter. The bearer's eyes glow like coals in dim light and fragrant smoke curls from their skin when they are pleased, and traders who recognise them phrase every request very, very carefully.
essences.manifests: brass cities buried by desert storms

grant.name: Heard Wishes
grant.text: Whenever a creature speaks a request, plea or wish directly to you, you understand what it wants, whatever language it speaks.

essences.name: Dream
essences.description: Dream is the realm every sleeper visits and no one remembers. Soft lights drift around the bearer's head while they sleep and their eyes are always a little heavy-lidded, and people who have met them in a dream recognise them on waking, which can make first introductions awkward.
essences.manifests: towns cursed into a sleep they never woke from

grant.name: Dream Message
grant.text: Once per long rest, while you sleep, you can enter the dream of a sleeping creature you know well that is on the same plane and give it a message of up to ten words. It remembers the message when it wakes but can't reply.

essences.name: Epoch
essences.description: Epoch is the great ages of the world, laid down one atop another like layers of rock. Faint bands of colour like sediment show in the bearer's eyes and they speak of centuries as others speak of days, and historians recognise them as living archives.
essences.manifests: excavated cities buried beneath younger cities

grant.name: Glimpse of the Past
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you enter a building or ruin, you can see it for 1 minute as it looked when it was new: its furnishings, colours and layout, but no creatures.

essences.name: Eternity
essences.description: Eternity is the stillness at the end of all clocks, the part of the world that outlasts everything else. The bearer's eyes fade to the grey of old marble and their face settles into a calm, statuesque cast, and acquaintances recognise them years later because they never look a day older.
essences.manifests: the ruins of empires that ruled for a thousand years

grant.name: Unaging
grant.text: You age at one tenth of the normal rate, and magic and curses that would age you have no effect on you.

essences.name: Fate
essences.description: Fate is the great loom on which every life is a single thread. The lines of the bearer's palms shift after every important decision and they are unnervingly calm in moments of chance, and gamblers who recognise them refuse to play dice against them.
essences.manifests: crossroads where the course of empires turned

grant.name: Weal or Woe
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature describes a course of action it means to take within the next hour, you can sense the shape of its fate. The DM tells you whether that course leads to weal, woe, both or neither.

essences.name: Ferryman
essences.theme: The boatman of the final crossing
essences.description: Ferryman is the silent boatman who carries the dead across the last river. Two faint coin-shaped marks appear on the bearer's eyelids and river mist seems to cling to their cloak, and the dying recognise them and often reach for their hand.
essences.manifests: river crossings where whole armies drowned

grant.name: Last Words
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can touch a creature that died within the last minute and ask it one question. Its spirit answers honestly in a word or short phrase, with only what it knew in life.

essences.name: Firmament
essences.theme: The vault of the sky and its stars
essences.description: Firmament is the sky itself, the unchanging dome over every road. Its bearer has faint constellations visible in the dark of their eyes, and sailors and nomads who recognise them treat them as a good sign for any journey.
essences.manifests: high mountain peaks under clear night skies

grant.name: Star Reckoning
grant.text: While you can see the open sky, you always know true north and your exact location on any map you have seen.

essences.name: Genesis
essences.description: Genesis is the moment something first comes from nothing, the world on its first morning. Tiny green shoots and pale crystals briefly sprout wherever the bearer sleeps and their breath smells of rain on new earth, and those who know the signs treat them with the awe due to someone the world is still shaping.
essences.manifests: volcanic islands newly risen from the sea

grant.name: Firstmaking
grant.text: As an action, you can create one tiny, nonmagical natural object that fits in your palm, such as a pebble, a seed, a feather or a mouthful of clean water. It is worthless and plainly mundane, and it vanishes after 1 hour.

essences.name: Gravity
essences.theme: The pull that binds the heavens
essences.description: Gravity is the unseen force that holds the stars in their courses and feet upon the ground. Dust settles around the bearer in neat rings and hanging chains lean slightly toward them, and scholars recognise them by that tilt long before they are introduced.
essences.manifests: the fallen ruins of a city that once floated

grant.name: True Weight
grant.text: You know the exact weight of any object or creature you can see.

essences.name: Griffin
essences.description: Griffin is the half-eagle, half-lion guardian of high eyries and buried gold. The bearer's eyes turn sharp and amber and a ruff of tawny feathers grows at the nape of their neck, and horsemasters recognise them when skittish mounts calm and stand proud at their touch.
essences.manifests: cliff eyries above plundered royal tombs

grant.name: Eagle Sight
grant.text: You can see distant things as clearly as if they were ten times closer, enough to read a banner or recognise a face a mile away.

essences.name: Gun
essences.description: Gun is an otherworldly essence, said to have come into Pallimustus from somewhere beyond the world, carrying the logic of weapons no smith here has ever forged. Its bearer smells faintly of a sharp powder no alchemist can name, and anyone who knows the stories recognises them by the cold pinpoint of light that sits in each pupil like a gunsight.
essences.manifests: battlefields scarred by weapons from beyond the world

grant.name: Rangefinder
grant.text: You always know the exact distance, to the nearest foot, to any creature or object you can see.

essences.name: Hourglass
essences.theme: Time running out, grain by grain
essences.description: Hourglass is time measured out and running low. The bearer hears a faint hiss of falling sand whenever a room is quiet and their eyes turn the colour of pale sand, and those who know them recognise an Hourglass bearer by the simple fact that they are never, ever late.
essences.manifests: clock towers stopped at the hour a city fell

grant.name: Perfect Time
grant.text: You always know the exact time and date, and exactly how much time has passed since any moment you remember.

essences.name: Kitsune
essences.description: Kitsune is the clever fox spirit that gains a tail for every century of mischief. The bearer's eyes take on a fox's amber slant, and those who recognise them notice a shadow with far too many tails flickering behind them in firelight.
essences.manifests: burned shrines of forgotten fox spirits

grant.name: Fox Glamour
grant.text: As an action, you can change the colour of your hair, eyes and skin and the pitch and accent of your voice, until you change them back. The change is an illusion: a creature that touches you, or succeeds on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier, sees through it.

essences.name: Kraken
essences.theme: The many-armed horror of the deep
essences.description: Kraken is the great thing beneath the waves that drags ships down whole. The bearer's fingers grow long and supple with faint sucker rings on the palms, and sailors recognise them at once, some making warding signs and others begging them to come aboard for luck.
essences.manifests: drowned fleets at the bottom of storm straits

grant.name: Kin of the Deep
grant.text: Octopuses, squid and other cephalopods treat you as kin. They never attack you unless magically compelled, and they will lead you to food, shelter or hidden passages in their waters.

essences.name: Legend
essences.description: Legend is a life that becomes a story told by firelight. Tales of the bearer's exploits spread ahead of them, slightly exaggerated, and bards and common folk recognise them from songs they could swear they have heard before.
essences.manifests: the fields of famous last stands

grant.name: Fireside Welcome
grant.text: In any settlement, you can find common folk who will shelter and feed you and up to five companions for a night at no charge, as long as you tell them a tale of your deeds in return.

essences.name: Leviathan
essences.theme: The vast serpent of endless seas
essences.description: Leviathan is the sea serpent so vast that whole fleets have mistaken it for a coastline. The bearer's skin takes on a faint blue-green sheen and they walk with the slow, rolling gait of a deep swimmer, and fishing villages recognise them by the way the tide seems to lean toward them when they stand on the shore.
essences.manifests: harbours flattened by sea serpents of old

grant.name: Deep Tremor
grant.text: While you are touching a body of water, you sense the direction of every Huge or larger creature in that water within 1 mile of you.

essences.name: Leyline
essences.theme: The hidden rivers of mana under the world
essences.description: Leyline is the vast flow of mana beneath the land, the force that makes manifestations and opens astral spaces. Its bearer leaves faint glowing footprints that fade in seconds, and the Magic Society keeps very close track of anyone known to carry it.
essences.manifests: the crossing points of great mana currents, where astral apertures open

grant.name: Mana Sight
grant.text: You can see how dense ambient magic is around you, and you can tell when an area is close to forming a manifestation. You always know the direction of the nearest astral aperture within 1 mile.

essences.name: Lich
essences.description: Lich is the sorcerer who cheated death through sheer, terrible will. The bearer's heartbeat slows to a crawl and a cold blue glow kindles behind their eyes in darkness, and anyone versed in the arcane recognises them and quietly wonders what they are hiding.
essences.manifests: the sealed crypts of necromancer kings

grant.name: Breathless
grant.text: You can stop breathing for up to 1 hour at a time. While you do, you can't be suffocated or drowned, and inhaled poisons and gases have no effect on you.

essences.name: Memory
essences.description: Memory is the world behind every reflection, where everything seen is kept. The bearer's reflection lags a heartbeat behind them, and anyone who notices recognises them by the way that reflection sometimes glances at things the bearer missed.
essences.manifests: the shattered mirror halls of mad sorcerers

grant.name: Reflected Memory
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can look into a reflective surface and ask your reflection about something you saw or heard in the past 24 hours. It truthfully describes one detail you failed to notice.

essences.name: Nova
essences.description: Nova is a star's last blinding moment, when it outshines everything around it before it fades. The bearer's skin seems lit from within whenever they are angry or afraid, and those who see that glow recognise a fire that could be spent all at once.
essences.manifests: glass deserts left by ancient magical blasts

grant.name: Starburst
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you release a silent flash of starlight. Until the end of your next turn, every other creature within 30 feet of you is outlined in faint light and gains no benefit from being invisible or hidden.

essences.name: Oblivion
essences.theme: Forgetting and the erasure of names
essences.description: Oblivion is the forgetting that waits for every name. The bearer's face is strangely hard to hold in the mind, and those who know of Oblivion recognise its bearers by the blank, puzzled look on the faces of people who have just spoken with them.
essences.manifests: ruins of cities whose very names are lost

grant.name: Forgettable
grant.text: A creature that sees you only in passing, or speaks with you for less than a minute, can't recall your face or describe you clearly afterwards. Creatures that know you well are unaffected.

essences.name: Ouroboros
essences.description: Ouroboros is the serpent eating its own tail, the cycle that sustains itself forever. A faint scaled ring encircles the bearer's wrist or throat like a tattoo and they often seem to have lived each moment before, and mystics recognise them as someone whose life has closed into a perfect loop.
essences.manifests: ring-shaped ruins whose builders are forgotten

grant.name: Self-Sustaining
grant.text: You need to eat and drink only once every seven days, though you can still enjoy food as normal.

essences.name: Paradox
essences.description: Paradox is cause and effect tangled into a knot. The bearer finds notes in their own handwriting they don't remember writing and their footprints sometimes appear a moment before they step, and those who recognise the signs find them faintly dizzying to stand beside.
essences.manifests: ruins where a failed time ritual frayed the world

grant.name: Already Packed
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can reach into your pack and pull out one ordinary item worth 1 gp or less that you could plausibly have packed, as if your past self knew you would need it. Deduct its cost from your coin.

essences.name: Phoenix
essences.description: Phoenix is the fire that ends a life and the fire that kindles it again. The bearer runs warm to the touch, their hair glints ember-red at the roots, and people recognise them by the ash that drifts from their shoulders when they are badly hurt, a sign, the stories say, that death will not keep them.
essences.manifests: the ashes of burned cities later rebuilt

grant.name: Rekindle
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you fail a death saving throw, you can reroll it. If the new roll succeeds, harmless flames flicker over your body until you regain consciousness.

essences.name: Primeval
essences.theme: The world before people walked it
essences.description: Primeval is the deep age of the land, older than any name. Its bearer moves with a heavy, unhurried patience, their skin has a faint fossil-like pattern in bright light, and scholars of the ancient world will cross a continent to meet them.
essences.manifests: untouched wilderness that no people have ever settled

grant.name: Part of the Land
grant.text: Beasts treat you as part of the landscape. A beast that isn't hostile to you doesn't flee or raise an alarm because of you, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide from beasts.

essences.name: Prophecy
essences.description: Prophecy is the future spoken aloud before it arrives. The bearer's eyes sometimes go milky white for a heartbeat and they talk in their sleep in verse, and temples recognise them as seers, which draws both pilgrims and enemies.
essences.manifests: the collapsed oracle caves of ancient seers

grant.name: Waking Vision
grant.text: When you finish a long rest, you can ask for a vision: the DM gives you one brief, cryptic but truthful image or phrase about something that will happen in the coming days.

essences.name: Reaper
essences.description: Reaper is death as a harvest: swift, indifferent and certain. The bearer's shadow takes the hooded outline of a figure carrying a scythe and crows follow them through towns, and people who recognise that shadow tend to cross the street rather than share it.
essences.manifests: old battlefields where whole armies were cut down

grant.name: Death Knell
grant.text: You know whenever a creature dies within 120 feet of you, and you know the direction to where it fell.

essences.name: Requiem
essences.theme: The mourning song that grants rest
essences.description: Requiem is the last song sung for the dead, the grief that lets a spirit go. The bearer's voice takes on a low, resonant sorrow and candles gutter when they hum, and mourners across the land recognise them as someone whose singing at a graveside means the dead will truly rest.
essences.manifests: plague cathedrals where the dead were sung to rest

grant.name: Lay to Rest
grant.text: By singing over a corpse for 10 minutes, you lay its spirit to rest: the body can never be raised as undead, and you learn the name the creature bore in life. Magic that restores the dead to life still works on it.

essences.name: Revenant
essences.theme: Vengeance that will not stay buried
essences.description: Revenant is the dead who return for unfinished business. The bearer's skin grows pale and cool and their stare is fixed and unblinking, and anyone who has wronged them recognises the look of someone who will cross any distance to settle a score.
essences.manifests: the unmarked graves of the murdered

grant.name: Unfinished Business
grant.text: You always know the direction to the creature that most recently reduced you to 0 hit points, as long as it is alive and on the same plane of existence.

essences.name: Seraph
essences.theme: Burning holiness of the highest heavens
essences.description: Seraph is the burning, six-winged choir of the highest heavens. The bearer's shadow sometimes shows the faint outline of wings and their voice carries a soft harmony, as though others sing with them, and the devout recognise them at once and often kneel, whether the bearer wants it or not.
essences.manifests: temples where a celestial once descended

grant.name: Heavenly Tongue
grant.text: When you speak, every creature that hears you understands your words as if you spoke its language, though you don't understand its replies unless you share a language.

essences.name: Silence
essences.theme: The stillness after the last sound
essences.description: Silence is the stillness that falls after the last sound has faded. Birds hush when the bearer passes and their laughter comes out as barely a breath, and those who recognise them notice how even a crowded room grows quiet at their approach.
essences.manifests: monasteries of silent orders that vanished overnight

grant.name: Unspoken Words
grant.text: You can mouth words without making a sound, and any creature within 60 feet that can see your face understands them as if you had spoken aloud, provided it shares a language with you.

essences.name: Soul
essences.theme: The undying spark within every life
essences.description: Soul is the self beneath the flesh, the spark that outlasts the body. A warm glow shows faintly around the bearer's heart in darkness, and priests recognise them as someone who looks past faces to what lies beneath.
essences.manifests: altars where great sacrifices were made

grant.name: Soulsight
grant.text: You can tell at a glance whether a creature you can see within 30 feet is possessed, has had its soul stolen or trapped, or has no soul at all.

essences.name: Sphinx
essences.description: Sphinx is the ancient guardian who asks the question no one can answer. The bearer gains a feline stillness and faint golden glyphs along their forearms, and scholars recognise them by their maddening habit of answering questions with questions.
essences.manifests: sealed desert tombs of forgotten dynasties

grant.name: Riddler's Mind
grant.text: You have advantage on Intelligence checks to solve riddles, puzzles, ciphers and puzzle locks.

essences.name: Star
essences.theme: Guiding light of the distant heavens
essences.description: Star is the cold, patient light that guided travellers long before there were roads. The bearer's freckles or scars arrange themselves into constellations that slowly turn with the seasons, and sailors and caravan masters recognise them on sight and count their company as the best of luck.
essences.manifests: the ruins of ancient mountaintop observatories

grant.name: Lodestar
grant.text: Once per long rest, while you can see the night sky, you can name a place where you have stood before and learn the direction to it, though not its distance.

essences.name: Technology
essences.description: Technology is an otherworldly essence, said to come from a world beyond this one where machines do the work of magic. Its bearer gives off a faint electrical hum and fine lines of pale light trace across their fingertips like the workings of some unknown device, so tinkerers and artificers recognise them at once and crowd around with questions.
essences.manifests: the wreckage of impossible machines from beyond the world

grant.name: Alien Intuition
grant.text: By handling a nonmagical mechanical device for 1 minute, you learn what it is for and how to operate it, even if it is of a kind never seen in Pallimustus. You still need any key, tool or check the device requires.

essences.name: Titan
essences.theme: Elder giants who shaped the world
essences.description: Titan is the blood of the primordial giants who raised mountains and dug the seas. The bearer seems taller than they truly are and their voice rumbles like distant rockfall, and giants and their kin recognise the old blood in them the moment they meet.
essences.manifests: the broken stair-cities of ancient giants

grant.name: Old Blood
grant.text: Giants and other creatures of giant kind recognise you as kin of the titans. They treat you as a peer and will always hear you out before fighting, unless you have wronged them or their kin.

essences.name: Unicorn
essences.description: Unicorn is untouched purity, the creature that only the innocent may approach. The bearer's hair turns pale silver and a pearly mark appears on their brow, and horses, children and the gentle-hearted recognise them instinctively and approach without fear.
essences.manifests: sacred groves where unicorns were hunted to the last

grant.name: Purifying Touch
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can touch a creature to end the poisoned condition or one disease affecting it.

essences.name: Wellspring
essences.theme: The source of all fresh water
essences.description: Wellspring is the first spring, the water every river remembers. Its bearer is never thirsty for long, their hands are always cool and damp, and desert peoples greet them with ceremony because water follows them.
essences.manifests: springs that have flowed since before the oldest records

grant.name: Call the Spring
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can touch the ground and call up a spring of clean, drinkable water that flows for 1 hour, producing up to 10 gallons, before it sinks away.

essences.name: Worldtree
essences.theme: The tree whose roots hold the world
essences.description: Worldtree is the great tree of the old stories, whose roots hold up the land and whose branches touch the sky. Its bearer grows a few living leaves in their hair that change with the seasons, and druids and farmers alike bow when they recognise them.
essences.manifests: ancient groves where a single tree outlives every kingdom around it

grant.name: Root Speech
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can touch a living plant and converse with it for 10 minutes as if using speak with plants, limited to that one plant.

essences.name: Wraith
essences.description: Wraith is the restless dead who linger as hollow shadows of themselves. The bearer casts no reflection in mirror, water or polished steel and their outline blurs at the edges in dim light, and anyone who notices the missing reflection recognises them and usually says so nervously.
essences.manifests: haunted manors where whole households died

grant.name: Reflectionless
grant.text: You cast no reflection, and you can't be seen through magic that uses a mirror, pool or other reflective surface to scry on or observe you.

essences.name: Dimension
essences.description: The essence of distance and the space between places. Bearers seem to arrive a moment before they should, and their magic leaves faint creases in the air like folded paper.
essences.manifests: ruined portal arches and the thresholds of astral spaces

grant.name: Fold Step
grant.text: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you can teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

confluences.name: Adrenaline
confluences.theme: The pounding burst of fight or flight
confluences.description: Blood set alight by sudden fear or fury, the heartbeat that turns into explosive speed. Bearers fidget, tap their feet and talk fast, their pulse shows at the throat, and their magic comes in sudden, jolting bursts.

grant.name: Burst
grant.text: Once per short rest, when you make a long jump or a high jump, you can double the distance you cover.

confluences.name: Aegis
confluences.theme: Holy runes on a warded shield
confluences.description: Aegis is protection blessed and bound with magic, the shield wall that is also a prayer. Faint luminous sigils rise on a bearer's arms when danger is near, they always know where they would make their stand, and their magic hangs in the air as a lattice of interlocking light.

grant.name: Raised Aegis
grant.text: Once per short rest, while you are holding a shield, when a creature you can see attacks an ally within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

confluences.name: Albatross
confluences.theme: Mighty wings that ride the gale
confluences.description: The albatross is the strongest flier of the open sea, with wings as wide as three men laid end to end that carry it round the world on the gale without a single beat. Bearers stand tall with broad shoulders and long arms that seem made to be spread wide, they love high and windy places, and their spells arrive with the slow beat of enormous wings.

grant.name: Roc's Wingspan
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you fall, you can use your reaction to spread your arms like wings. You descend at 60 feet per round and land unhurt, and you can bring one willing Medium or smaller creature you are holding down safely with you.

confluences.name: Alchemy
confluences.theme: Distilling, mixing and transmuting matter
confluences.description: Alchemy is the patient art of breaking substances down and joining them anew. Bearers' fingertips are stained odd colours, they smell of sulphur and dried herbs, and their spells bubble and smoke like a flask over a flame.

grant.name: Potion Nose
grant.text: By sniffing an unknown potion or other liquid for 1 minute, you learn what it does, including whether it is poisonous. Sniffing it never exposes you to its effects.

confluences.name: Altar
confluences.theme: Blood spilled on ancient stone
confluences.description: The old sacrificial stone, where a drop of blood buys a sliver of power. Bearers carry small scars on their palms and feel drawn to standing stones and hilltop rocks, and their magic leaves faint rust-red runes glowing on the surfaces it touches.

grant.name: Blood Offering
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute letting a few drops of your blood fall onto bare stone or earth. Before you finish your next long rest, you can add 1d4 to one ability check or saving throw you make, after seeing the roll.

confluences.name: Anchor
confluences.theme: Iron weight that holds against the sea
confluences.description: The anchor that bites into the seabed and will not drag, however hard the storm pulls. Bearers feel unnaturally heavy and steady on their feet, their skin takes a faint tint of rust and salt, and their magic settles with the drag of a chain paying out.

grant.name: Sink Like Stone
grant.text: You can choose to sink in water as if you were made of stone and walk along the bottom at half your walking speed without swimming. While you walk this way, currents and waves can't move you against your will. This doesn't let you breathe underwater.

confluences.name: Angler
confluences.theme: Patient lures and the hidden hook
confluences.description: Angler is the fisher's cunning, the tempting bait that hides a hook beneath still water. A bearer is calm and endlessly patient, has a knack for knowing what others want to hear, and their spells dangle a small glowing light before they strike.

grant.name: Right Bait
grant.text: By watching a beast or monstrosity for 1 minute, you learn what food or bait would tempt it most, and whether it is hungry.

confluences.name: Antlion
confluences.theme: The pit-trap hunter in the sand
confluences.description: A predator that digs a funnel of loose sand and waits at the bottom for prey to slide in. Bearers become patient and still and often sit with their hands buried in sand or soil, and their magic swirls downward in sliding, sandy spirals.

grant.name: Pit Digger
grant.text: You can dig through sand, loose soil and gravel with your bare hands as fast as with a shovel. A pit you dig in such ground is so well hidden that a creature notices it before stepping in only with a successful Wisdom check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier.

confluences.name: Apex
confluences.theme: The predator atop every food chain
confluences.description: Blood at its most concentrated: hunger, the hunt and the kill with nothing else mixed in. Bearers move with a loose, patient economy, their pupils narrow when they are hungry, and their magic leaves a coppery taste in the air.

grant.name: Weakness Scent
grant.text: You can tell whether any creature you can see within 60 feet of you is below half its hit point maximum.

confluences.name: Apothecary
confluences.theme: Herbs, salts and careful remedies
confluences.description: Apothecary is the healer's shop of labelled jars, where roots, minerals and old recipes are ground together into cures. A bearer smells of crushed herbs and chalk, keeps their pockets full of tiny pouches and twists of paper, and their magic sparkles like powder sifted through a sunbeam.

grant.name: Measured Dose
grant.text: As an action, you can drink exactly half of a potion of healing, regaining half the hit points it would normally restore (round down), and stopper the rest to drink later. You can also do this to feed half a dose to another creature.

confluences.name: Arcanum
confluences.theme: Raw magic in its purest form
confluences.description: Arcanum is magic distilled to its essence, the hidden law beneath every spell, rune and fate. A bearer's eyes swirl faintly with shifting runes, their skin prickles near any working of magic, and their spells unfold in layered geometric patterns of pale light.

grant.name: Spell Echo
grant.text: Whenever a spell is cast within 60 feet of you, you feel a faint pressure behind your eyes, even if you can't see or hear the caster. You know the direction the spell came from and the school of magic it belongs to.

confluences.name: Armada
confluences.theme: War fleets under full sail
confluences.description: The armada is a navy under sail, rows of hulls and banners driven by the wind to war. Bearers squint at the horizon out of habit and speak in clipped orders, and their spells unfurl with a crack like a sail filling.

grant.name: Fleet Eye
grant.text: By watching a ship or boat for 1 minute, you learn roughly how many crew it carries, how many weapons it mounts, how heavily it is laden, and whether it is preparing to fight or flee.

confluences.name: Arson
confluences.theme: Fires set in secret, for spite
confluences.description: The fire set for spite, profit or revenge, smouldering unnoticed until it is far too late to stop. Bearers smell faintly of lamp oil and keep a calm smile in any crisis, and their magic catches slowly, then all at once.

grant.name: Slow Burn
grant.text: You can spend 1 minute preparing a flammable nonmagical object you touch, such as a curtain, haystack, cart or pile of kindling, so that it bursts into flame at a moment you choose (no action required) within the next 8 hours, as long as you are within 1 mile of it. You can have only one prepared object at a time.

confluences.name: Arsonist
confluences.theme: Quick fires lit by guilty hands
confluences.description: Arsonist is the crime of fire, the match struck in an alley and the culprit gone before the smoke rises. A bearer smells faintly of lamp oil, their eyes linger on thatch and dry timber, and their magic catches suddenly, like a flame racing along a trail of spilled oil.

grant.name: Read the Ashes
grant.text: By examining a burned place or its ashes for 1 minute, you learn how the fire started (by accident, lightning, magic or a deliberate hand), roughly when it began, and where it was first lit.

confluences.name: Artifice
confluences.theme: Gears, sparks and clever contraptions
confluences.description: Artifice is the spark of invention set loose in springs, gears and wire. Bearers' pockets fill with screws and odd scraps of metal, their fingers are always tinkering, and their spells tick, whirr and click into place like a mechanism.

grant.name: Jury-Rig
grant.text: Once per short rest, you can spend 1 minute fiddling with a broken nonmagical mechanism, such as a lock, crossbow, pulley, clock or pump, to make it work again for 1 hour. After that it breaks down until it is properly repaired.

confluences.name: Ashes
confluences.theme: What remains when fire ends
confluences.description: Ashes are the ending that fire leaves behind: burnt letters, cold pyres and the grey memory of everything destroyed. Bearers carry a smudge of grey on their skin that won't scrub off and the smell of old smoke, and their magic falls in silent, drifting cinders.

grant.name: Ash Reading
grant.text: By sifting a handful of ash for 1 minute, you learn what was burned to make it, such as wood, cloth, paper or flesh, and roughly how long ago. If the ash came from writing, you can also read up to 25 words of what was written.

confluences.name: Ashfall
confluences.theme: Black skies raining ash
confluences.description: Ashfall is the dark curtain that follows a great burning, when the wind carries smoke and cinders across the sky and noon turns to dusk. Bearers' clothes always hold a smear of grey, their voices are husky, and their magic billows out as choking black haze.

grant.name: Ash Cloud
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can exhale a cloud of black ash that fills a 10-foot cube adjacent to you. The area is heavily obscured until the end of your next turn, when the ash settles.

confluences.name: Assassin
confluences.theme: Silent blades and unseen death
confluences.description: Assassin is the quiet art of the killing no one sees coming. Bearers move without wasted motion and rest their eyes on throats and exits out of habit, and their spells strike without a sound, like a knife slipped between ribs.

grant.name: Hushed Steps
grant.text: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can make your footsteps, clothing and gear perfectly silent for 10 minutes. Your voice and your attacks still make noise as normal.

confluences.name: Aura
confluences.theme: The visible glow of living spirit
confluences.description: Aura is the light that every living thing gives off, a halo of vitality that only the gifted can see. A bearer's eyes gleam with faint, shifting colours, they often gaze just past people's heads at something no one else sees, and their spells shimmer in the hues of the living things around them.

grant.name: Life Glow
grant.text: You can see a faint glow of life around living creatures and plants. You know at a glance whether a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is truly alive, rather than undead or a construct, and roughly how old it is.

confluences.name: Aurochs
confluences.theme: Wild cattle of tireless strength
confluences.description: The great wild ox of the ancient grasslands, huge, horned and bred from the strength of the herd. Bearers grow broad through the chest, eat heartily and rarely tire, and their magic rolls out in heavy, steady waves like a herd on the move.

grant.name: Horn Grip
grant.text: You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to grapple, wrestle down or pin a beast, and to hold a beast still by its horns, mane or neck.

confluences.name: Autumn
confluences.theme: The waning year and falling leaves
confluences.description: Autumn is the season of endings, when the wind strips the trees and life draws in for the dark months. Bearers' hair takes on russet and gold tones, a few dry leaves always seem to cling to them, and their magic swirls with the smell of woodsmoke and fallen leaves.

grant.name: Season of Life
grant.text: By touching a living creature or plant for 1 minute, you learn which season of its natural life it is in: spring (young), summer (in its prime), autumn (ageing) or winter (near the end of its natural lifespan). This tells you nothing about injuries, curses or disease.

confluences.name: Avenger
confluences.theme: Righteous vengeance with a raised blade
confluences.description: The avenger takes up arms for the wronged, carrying judgement like a sword and a blood debt that must be paid in full. Bearers have a hard, steady stare and keep a tally of wrongs in knots or notches, and their magic burns with a crimson-edged gold light.

grant.name: Bier Right
grant.text: While you keep watch within 30 feet of the body of a creature that was murdered, if the creature that killed it comes within 30 feet of the body, the corpse's wounds bleed afresh and you know which creature caused it.

confluences.name: Balefire
confluences.theme: Green sorcerous flame of curses
confluences.description: Balefire is the eerie green flame of curses and midnight rites, burning cold over standing stones. Bearers' eyes glint green in firelight, their shadows sometimes flicker the wrong way, and their magic crackles with sickly emerald sparks.

grant.name: Burn the Token
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can burn a lock of hair, a nail clipping or a drop of blood taken from a creature. As it burns, you learn whether that creature is alive or dead, and whether it is within 1 mile of you, within 100 miles, or farther away.

confluences.name: Banner
confluences.theme: Colours flying over the field
confluences.description: Banner is courage lifted high where everyone can see it, a standard snapping in the wind as a sign of hope. A bearer's cloak and hair always seem to stir in a breeze, people instinctively gather around them, and their magic unfurls like bright cloth.

grant.name: Know the Colours
grant.text: You can identify any banner, coat of arms, badge, livery or uniform you see, learning which house, company, guild or order it belongs to, and whether it is being flown in war, in mourning or in surrender.

confluences.name: Barracuda
confluences.theme: The lightning strike beneath the waves
confluences.description: The barracuda hangs motionless in the clear shallows, then strikes faster than the eye can follow. Bearers become sleek and sharp-grinned, utterly still between sudden bursts of motion, and their magic darts out like a silver flash through water.

grant.name: Darting Swimmer
grant.text: You have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

confluences.name: Barrow
confluences.theme: Kin sleeping under the old hill
confluences.description: The burial mound where a bloodline lays its dead, and where those dead keep a long watch in the dark of the stone. Bearers grow still and heavy-footed and smell faintly of cold earth, and their magic rises from the ground like mist off a grave.

grant.name: Grave Stillness
grant.text: As an action, you can slow your breath and heartbeat until you appear dead. While you do so, you are prone and can't move or take actions, but you remain aware of your surroundings. A creature can tell you are alive only with a successful Wisdom (Medicine) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. You can end it as a bonus action.

confluences.name: Bat
confluences.theme: Night wings and whispering echoes
confluences.description: The blood-drinker of the night sky, finding its way through the dark by sound alone. Bearers grow large, sensitive ears and a habit of sleeping late into the day, and their magic flutters out in leathery shadows that chitter faintly.

grant.name: Echo Click
grant.text: As an action, you can click your tongue and listen. You learn the rough size and shape of the space around you within 60 feet, including openings, drops and large obstacles, even in total darkness. The echoes don't reveal creatures.

confluences.name: Battlemage
confluences.theme: Spell and steel in the battle line
confluences.description: The war mage who stands in the shield line, hurling fire with one hand and gripping a blade in the other. Bearers carry themselves like soldiers and smell of smoke and oiled steel, and their magic bursts out in short, disciplined flashes like volleys.

grant.name: Spell-Reader
grant.text: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you casts a spell, you know which spell it is, as long as the spell's level is no higher than your proficiency bonus.

confluences.name: Bayou
confluences.theme: Slow black water teeming with life
confluences.description: The bayou is warm black water under moss-hung trees, loud with frogs and thick with fish after dark. Bearers move unhurriedly and stay cool in sticky heat, their skin smells faintly of river mud, and their magic hums like a night full of crickets.

grant.name: Night Catch
grant.text: With 1 hour of fishing, trapping or groping in the water of any swamp, river, lake or shore, you can catch enough fish, frogs and crayfish to feed yourself and up to four other creatures for a day, without making a check.

confluences.name: Beacon
confluences.theme: Signal fire burning on the heights
confluences.description: Beacon is the great fire kindled on a hilltop or stone tower to warn of danger and guide travellers home. A bearer stands a little straighter on high ground, their eyes hold a steady point of flame, and their magic flares up like a torch touched to dry kindling.

grant.name: Guiding Fire
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can light a campfire or larger fire on a hill, tower or other high ground. Until it goes out or 24 hours pass, you and up to five creatures who watched you light it always know the direction and distance to it while within 10 miles of it.

confluences.name: Beaver
confluences.theme: Builder of dams and ponds
confluences.description: Beaver is the tireless builder that reshapes rivers with mud, stone and felled trees until the land around it turns green. A bearer gets strong front teeth and a habit of fiddling with sticks and pebbles, and their magic piles up in neat, interlocking layers.

grant.name: Dam-Builder
grant.text: With 1 hour of work using mud, stones and branches, you can dam a stream or ditch up to 10 feet wide, raising a pool behind it or turning the water into a new channel. You can also fell a tree up to 1 foot thick in 10 minutes with only your hands and teeth.

confluences.name: Bedrock
confluences.theme: The unmoving stone beneath everything
confluences.description: Bedrock is earth at its deepest and most stubborn, the foundation that holds up mountains and outlasts empires. A bearer becomes heavy-footed and slow to anger, their skin takes a cool grey cast like river stone, and their magic lands with a deep grinding rumble felt more than heard.

grant.name: Immovable
grant.text: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can become as fixed as stone for 1 minute. For the duration, your speed is 0 and you can't be moved, lifted, shoved or knocked prone against your will. You can end the effect early as a bonus action.

confluences.name: Berserker
confluences.theme: Battle rage that shrugs off pain
confluences.description: Berserker is fury fused with the beast's raw strength and the joy of the charge. Bearers' tempers run hot and their eyes redden in a fight, and their spells burst out with a roar and the reek of hot blood.

grant.name: Blood Up
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you are reduced to half your hit point maximum or lower, you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

confluences.name: Birthright
confluences.theme: True blood shining through
confluences.description: Birthright is the old certainty that rightful blood carries its own light and that a true heir cannot stay hidden forever. Bearers stand in a faint, warm glow that strangers mistake for nobility, and their magic shines the clean gold of morning sun.

grant.name: Kinsight
grant.text: By studying the faces of two humanoids for 1 minute, you know whether they are close blood relatives, such as parent and child, siblings, grandparent and grandchild, or first cousins. Mundane disguises don't fool this sense, though magic that changes a creature's appearance does.

confluences.name: Blackguard
confluences.theme: The cruel knight in blood-dark steel
confluences.description: Strength of arms turned to slaughter and terror: the knight who wins by fear. Bearers' armour and blades darken and dull over time and their voice drops to a low rasp, and their magic stains the air around them with a red-black haze.

grant.name: Terrible Example
grant.text: You have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made against a creature that, within the last hour, saw you reduce another creature to 0 hit points.

confluences.name: Blackmail
confluences.theme: Secrets traded for silence
confluences.description: Blackmail is the secret held over someone's head, paid for in coin, favours or obedience until the debt can never be cleared. Bearers collect small facts the way others collect coins and keep careful little notebooks, and their magic spreads like a slow ink stain.

grant.name: Leverage
grant.text: You have advantage on Charisma checks made against a creature whose secret you know, as long as it believes you could reveal that secret.

confluences.name: Blight
confluences.theme: Withering curse on growing things
confluences.description: Blight is life soured by dark magic: the black rot in the wheat, the orchard that dies in a single night, the cursed field where nothing grows. Bearers' fingertips are stained grey, cut flowers wilt quickly in their rooms, and their magic spreads like black veins through a leaf.

grant.name: Withering Touch
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a nonmagical plant, or a 5-foot square of grass, vines, brambles or undergrowth, and make it wither, blacken and crumble over the next minute. This has no effect on plant creatures.

confluences.name: Bloodstone
confluences.theme: The holy gem that stops bleeding
confluences.description: A dark green stone flecked with red, said to hold the blood of the righteous and to close any wound it touches. Bearers' eyes gain small red flecks and their touch is cool and calming, and their healing magic shines a deep green spotted with crimson.

grant.name: Staunching Touch
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a creature that has 0 hit points to stabilise it.

confluences.name: Boar
confluences.theme: Tusk and bristle of the old wood
confluences.description: The wild pig of the deep forest, rooting in the soil, fat on the woodland's plenty and ferocious when cornered. Bearers grow coarse, bristly hair and thick necks and sniff at the ground without thinking, and their magic charges forward in short, stubborn bursts.

grant.name: Rooting Snout
grant.text: You can smell anything buried up to 3 feet deep within 10 feet of you, such as roots, truffles, bones or a hidden cache, and you know where it is.

confluences.name: Bonfire
confluences.theme: Great fires that gather people together
confluences.description: The festival bonfire, built high at midsummer and midwinter, where whole villages gather to feast, dance and keep the cold at bay. Bearers smell of woodsmoke and roasted chestnuts, people drift toward them as toward warmth, and their magic flares in tall, cheerful tongues of flame.

grant.name: Festival Fire
grant.text: A campfire you build burns through the whole night on a single armful of fuel, and you and up to five other creatures who sleep beside it automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold that night.

confluences.name: Breakwater
confluences.theme: The stone wall that breaks waves
confluences.description: The breakwater is the harbour wall that takes the full weight of the sea so the boats behind it can rest. Bearers grow broad and steady, with skin that smells faintly of salt and wet stone, and their spells crash outward like spray off a sea wall.

grant.name: Sea Wall Stance
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature or effect would push you, pull you or knock you prone, you can use your reaction to stay where you are and on your feet.

confluences.name: Brimstone
confluences.theme: Sulphur fumes from the burning deep
confluences.description: Brimstone is the yellow stink of the underworld, fire breathing up through cracks in deep stone. Bearers carry a faint smell of struck matches, a sulphur-yellow ring circles their irises, and their magic leaves crusts of yellow crystal on the stone it touches.

grant.name: Sulphur Nose
grant.text: You can smell flammable or poisonous gases, such as firedamp, marsh gas and volcanic fumes, within 30 feet of you. You also know whether the air in an enclosed space is safe to breathe, and whether an open flame there would ignite it.

confluences.name: Bull
confluences.theme: Hot temper and a headlong charge
confluences.description: The bull is fury with horns: a ton of muscle that paws the ground once and then comes on at a thundering run, flattening whatever stands in its way. A bearer moves in sudden bursts and stops dead, snorts when angry, and their spells come charging across the field and land with a crash of sparks.

grant.name: Running Impact
grant.text: Once per short rest, if you move at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a creature immediately before you try to shove it, you have advantage on the Strength (Athletics) check.

confluences.name: Bulwark
confluences.theme: Standing between harm and others
confluences.description: Bulwark is the wall that does not break, the guard who stands between harm and everyone behind them. Bearers grow broad and immovable, they plant themselves in doorways without thinking, and their spells raise faint grey ramparts of light around the people they guard.

grant.name: Stand In
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is targeted by an attack, you can use your reaction to swap places with it. The attack targets you instead.

confluences.name: Burglar
confluences.theme: Locks, ledges and sleeping houses
confluences.description: Burglar is the knack of getting into places meant to stay shut and out again before anyone wakes. Bearers have soft feet and nimble fingers, they count windows and drainpipes wherever they go, and their spells open as quietly as a latch lifting.

grant.name: Empty House
grant.text: By pressing your ear or palm to a door, wall or window for 1 minute, you learn how many creatures larger than Tiny are in the room beyond it, and whether any of them are asleep.

confluences.name: Burrow
confluences.theme: Snug dens deep in the earth
confluences.description: Burrow is the safe, dark home of badgers, rabbits and moles, dug deep where storms can't reach. A bearer always has a little soil under their fingernails, feels uneasy under an open sky at night, and their magic smells of warm turned earth.

grant.name: Den-Digger
grant.text: In 1 hour, using your hands or a digging tool, you can dig a burrow into soft earth or a bank big enough for you and up to three Medium companions to sleep in. While inside it, you and they are sheltered from rain, snow and wind, and automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold.

confluences.name: Candle
confluences.theme: One small flame against the night
confluences.description: The candle is the one small flame that holds back the dark through the longest night. Bearers have a warm, steady glow in their eyes and smell faintly of beeswax, and their magic gutters and flickers but never quite goes out.

grant.name: Steady Flame
grant.text: A candle, torch, lantern or other nonmagical flame you are holding can't be blown out by wind or put out by rain, spray or dripping water. It can still be smothered, submerged or put out by magic.

confluences.name: Canyon
confluences.theme: Stone carved by wind and water
confluences.description: The deep gorge that wind and river spent ages cutting, layer by coloured layer. Bearers' skin takes on faint bands like layered sandstone, their voice echoes slightly even in the open, and their magic sweeps in long, patient curves.

grant.name: Weathering Touch
grant.text: As an action, you can touch nonmagical stone that no one is wearing or carrying and wear it away as centuries of wind and water would. You can smooth a 1-foot-square face, round off a sharp edge, or carve a groove, handhold or simple mark up to 1 inch deep.

confluences.name: Caravan
confluences.theme: Desert roads travelled by starlight
confluences.description: Caravan is the long line of pack beasts crossing sand and stone by day and steering by the stars at night, bound for the next oasis. A bearer gains a sun-squinted face and a habit of checking the sky, packs everything they own in neat bundles, and their magic jingles like harness bells.

grant.name: Loadmaster
grant.text: When you pack a mount, pack animal, cart or wagon yourself, it can carry half again its normal load, and nothing you have packed comes loose or breaks from rough travel.

confluences.name: Cardsharp
confluences.theme: Cheating hands at the gaming table
confluences.description: The cardsharp turns chance into skill, palming aces and loading dice while smiling across the table. Bearers have nimble fingers that roll coins and shuffle cards without thinking and always sit facing the door, and their spells snap out like a card dealt face up.

grant.name: Loaded Odds
grant.text: You have advantage on ability checks made to play or cheat at cards, dice and other games of chance.

confluences.name: Cat
confluences.theme: Night prowling and nine lives
confluences.description: The cat slips through the night, nimble, curious and impossible to keep down. Bearers move with a silky grace, their eyes catch the light like a cat's, and their magic arrives with a flick of the wrist like a twitching tail.

grant.name: Always Lands
grant.text: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws made to avoid falling, such as from a trapdoor, a collapsing floor or a crumbling ledge. When you do fall and aren't incapacitated, you land on your feet and aren't knocked prone by the fall.

confluences.name: Catalyst
confluences.theme: The spark that speeds every working
confluences.description: The catalyst, the spark of arcane heat that makes any working run faster and burn brighter. Bearers think quickly and drum their fingers impatiently, and their magic catches at once, flaring up from the faintest spark.

grant.name: Quickening
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you attune to a magic item or copy a spell into a spellbook, it takes you half the usual time, and copying the spell costs only half as much in ink and materials.

confluences.name: Cataphract
confluences.theme: The armoured rider and the charge
confluences.description: The cataphract is the heaviest of horsemen, rider and mount alike clad in scale and mail, who can be armed and in the saddle before the trumpet stops sounding. Bearers sit tall and walk with a rider's rolling gait, never seem weighed down by their gear, and their magic comes with the drumming of distant hooves.

grant.name: Quick Buckle
grant.text: You can don or doff any armour in 1 minute, and you can put barding on a mount, or take it off, in half the usual time.

confluences.name: Cauldron
confluences.theme: Simmering pots of herb and spell
confluences.description: The hedge witch's cauldron, bubbling over the hearth with soups, salves and charms that are hard to tell apart. Bearers smell of thyme and woodsmoke and are always trying to feed people, and their magic rises in curls of fragrant steam.

grant.name: Simmered Remedy
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 hour simmering herbs, roots and broth in a pot over a fire to brew one draught. A creature that drinks it as an action regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your proficiency bonus. The draught loses its potency when you finish your next long rest.

confluences.name: Centaur
confluences.theme: Horse strength and the open plains
confluences.description: Centaur is beast and warrior made one, the speed of the wild herd joined to a fighter's strength. A bearer has a long, powerful stride and an ease with horses that borders on kinship, and their spells come with a drumming of hooves.

grant.name: Born in the Saddle
grant.text: You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to stay in the saddle, and mounting or dismounting costs you only 5 feet of movement.

confluences.name: Charity
confluences.theme: Coin given and bread shared freely
confluences.description: Charity is coin and plenty turned to mercy, the open purse and the loaf handed to whoever is hungry. A bearer's pockets always seem to hold a spare copper or crust, beggars greet them by name, and their spells glint like coins tossed into an outstretched hand.

grant.name: Friend of the Poor
grant.text: You have advantage on Charisma checks made to win the trust or help of beggars, orphans, the sick and others living in hardship.

confluences.name: Charlatan
confluences.theme: Confidence tricks and counterfeit wonders
confluences.description: Charlatan is the con artist's craft, the art of selling a miracle that isn't there. Bearers have quick, winning smiles and very clean hands, and their spells come wrapped in more glitter and flourish than they strictly need.

grant.name: False Aura
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute handling a nonmagical object no larger than a chest to give it a false magical aura of a school of your choice for 8 hours. Detect magic and similar magic register the object as magical, though it has no magical properties.

confluences.name: Charnel
confluences.theme: Dead flesh stirred by stolen life
confluences.description: Charnel is the dark art of moving dead flesh with borrowed vitality. Bearers smell faintly of grave soil and old iron, dead insects twitch in their presence, and their spells crawl outward in sickly violet threads that tug at anything lifeless.

grant.name: Dead Man's Voice
grant.text: As an action, you can make a corpse within 30 feet of you twitch, sit up, open its eyes or speak one sentence of your choice in the voice it had in life. It can't leave its place or take any other action.

confluences.name: Cheetah
confluences.theme: The fastest sprint of the hunt
confluences.description: The cheetah is pure speed in the service of hunger, a hunter built to run its prey down in one blinding dash. Bearers grow lean and long-legged with dark tear lines beneath their eyes, and their magic streaks past in a spotted golden blur.

grant.name: Pace the Prey
grant.text: By watching a creature move for a few seconds, you know its fastest speed on land, in water and in the air, and whether you could outrun it.

confluences.name: Cinder
confluences.theme: Embers and ash after the burning
confluences.description: Cinder is what fire leaves behind: coals glowing in the dark and the grey ash of things that are gone. Bearers' fingertips are always smudged black, embers seem to smoulder deep in their irises, and their spells leave drifting flecks of ash.

grant.name: Heat Sight
grant.text: You can see heat. Within 30 feet of you, you see the glowing outlines of warm-blooded creatures, fires, embers and hot objects even in total darkness, though not their details or colours. This doesn't reveal invisible creatures, and you can tell at a glance whether a hearth, a bed or a seat was warm within the last hour.

confluences.name: Clarion
confluences.theme: A clear call at daybreak
confluences.description: Clarion is the bright, ringing call that rouses camps and cities, hope carried on the wind as sound. A bearer's voice has a silvery edge, they wake before everyone else, and their spells ring out like a horn at dawn.

grant.name: Wake the Camp
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can sound a clear, ringing call. Each creature you choose within 60 feet of you that can hear you and is asleep, even from magic such as the sleep spell, wakes up at once.

confluences.name: Clarity
confluences.theme: Water made pure by light
confluences.description: Clarity is truth poured into water, the sunlit spring so clean you can count the pebbles on its bed. A bearer's eyes become startlingly clear and pale, their voice carries no hesitation, and their spells spread outward like light through a glass of water.

grant.name: Ring of Truth
grant.text: When you state something that you believe is true, any creature that hears and understands you knows that you believe it, though not whether it actually is true. You can choose to speak without this effect.

confluences.name: Clipper
confluences.theme: The fastest ship on the sea
confluences.description: The clipper is the sleek ship that races before the wind, built for nothing but speed on open water. Bearers lean into the wind as they walk and hate slow journeys, and their spells cut through the air with the hiss of a hull through spray.

grant.name: Log Line
grant.text: You always know the speed and heading of any ship, boat or vehicle you are aboard, and you can tell to within an hour how long it will take to reach a destination you can see or whose location you know.

confluences.name: Colossus
confluences.theme: Bronze giant standing guard in sunlight
confluences.description: Colossus is the towering statue of a hero cast in bronze and stone, standing over a harbour or city gate with the sun gleaming on its shoulders. A bearer's skin takes a faint metallic sheen at sunrise, they fall into heroic poses when they stand still and know every statue's story, and their magic glints like sunlight on polished bronze.

grant.name: Sculptor's Eye
grant.text: By touching a statue or carved figure for 1 minute, you learn who or what it depicts, roughly when it was made, and whether it is really a petrified creature.

confluences.name: Compass
confluences.theme: The needle that finds the way
confluences.description: Compass is the magnetised needle that turns to a hidden pull, guiding travellers along roads and across trackless land. A bearer tilts their head slightly before choosing a direction, iron filings cling to their sleeves, and their magic swings and settles like a needle coming to rest.

grant.name: Seeking Needle
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can float a needle on water or hang it from a thread and name a specific object you have held for at least 1 minute. For the next hour, the needle points toward that object whenever it is within 1,000 feet of you.

confluences.name: Condottiere
confluences.theme: Captains who sell war by contract
confluences.description: The condottiere is the captain of a hired company, who signs contracts for war, bleeds for whoever pays most and changes sides when the silver runs dry. Bearers keep their weapons sharp and their purses close, judge every stranger's gear and pay at a glance, and their magic clinks and glints like mail and coin.

grant.name: Going Rate
grant.text: By watching an armed humanoid for 1 minute, you learn roughly what it would cost to hire it for a month, and whether it fights mainly for pay, for a cause, or out of loyalty to a person.

confluences.name: Confessor
confluences.theme: Holy light that draws out sins
confluences.description: Confessor is mercy that knows every vice by name, the patient light in which wrongs are spoken aloud and set down. A bearer has a calm, unshockable gaze and a quiet voice that makes people lean closer, and their magic glows a soft, forgiving gold.

grant.name: Unburdening
grant.text: You have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to convince a creature to confess a wrong it has done or to admit something it is ashamed of.

confluences.name: Conjurer
confluences.theme: Stage magic, smoke and a blinding flash
confluences.description: The conjurer is the travelling stage magician whose spells are half real and half sleight of hand, gone in a flash and a puff of smoke before anyone can see how it was done. A bearer's fingertips are freckled with tiny burn marks, they fidget with sparks the way others drum their fingers, and their magic goes off with a pop, a whistle and a bright white flash.

grant.name: Vanishing Flash
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can throw down a pinch of powder that bursts in a blinding white flash. Each other creature within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier or be blinded until the end of its next turn. The flash deals no damage and can't ignite anything.

confluences.name: Conqueror
confluences.theme: Burning ambition and the sacked city
confluences.description: Conqueror is war as a spreading fire, the will to break walls and take whatever lies behind them. A bearer stands like someone used to marching at the head of an army, the smell of smoke clings to their cloak, and their magic lands like a battering ram wrapped in flame.

grant.name: Breach Point
grant.text: By studying a wall, gate, palisade or other fortification from the outside for 10 minutes, you learn its weakest point, the best route of approach to it, and roughly how many defenders it could hold.

confluences.name: Constellation
confluences.theme: Stories written across the night sky
confluences.description: Constellation is the cosmos drawn in starlight across the sky, the patterns sailors and seers have read for ages. A bearer's freckles and scars settle into tiny star-like clusters, they hum softly when gazing upward, and their magic traces bright lines from point to point.

grant.name: Star Sign
grant.text: When you learn the day and hour of a humanoid's birth, you also learn one of its ideals, bonds or flaws, as the DM chooses.

confluences.name: Corsair
confluences.theme: Plunder, rigging and the boarding blade
confluences.description: Corsair is the blade, the rope and the stolen cargo fused into the life of the sea raider. Bearers have a swaggering, rolling walk and a gleam in their eye at the sight of a laden ship, and their spells crack like a boarding line snapping taut.

grant.name: Rigger
grant.text: You can climb ropes, rigging, nets and ladders at your full walking speed, without spending extra movement.

confluences.name: Counterfeit
confluences.theme: False metal cast in secret
confluences.description: Counterfeit is the backroom furnace and the clay mould, where base metal is poured into the shape of honest coins, keys and seals. A bearer's fingertips are stained grey with lead, they notice every seal and stamp they pass, and their spells shine like freshly struck tin.

grant.name: Cast Copy
grant.text: If you press a key, signet ring, seal, badge or coin into clay or wax, you can later spend 1 hour at a fire to cast a copy of it in lead or tin. The copy looks and works like the original, but it is soft and bends or breaks after a few uses, and anyone who examines it closely can tell it is a cast copy.

confluences.name: Covenant
confluences.theme: Sacred pacts sealed in blood
confluences.description: The covenant is a promise made holy, its words written in runes and sealed with blood so that the bond itself keeps watch. Bearers carry a thin pale line across one palm like an old cut, and their magic is written in short lines of glowing script that fade once fulfilled.

grant.name: Threshold Ward
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute marking a doorway, gate, window or tent flap with a drop of your blood and a glowing rune. For the next 8 hours, a fiend, undead or fey creature can't pass through that opening uninvited unless it succeeds on a Charisma saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier. Any creature inside can invite it in by speaking aloud.

confluences.name: Crocodile
confluences.theme: Patient jaws beneath the riverbank mud
confluences.description: An armoured predator of muddy riverbanks, ancient and patient, able to wait months between kills. Bearers develop rough, pebbled skin across their backs, a cold stare and a habit of lying very still, and their magic snaps shut like jaws.

grant.name: Cold Blood
grant.text: You need to eat a full meal only once every 7 days, though you still need water each day.

confluences.name: Crow
confluences.theme: Black wings over the battlefield
confluences.description: The crow is the carrion bird that follows armies, the dark omen circling wherever steel meets steel and settling once the fighting is done. A bearer's hair takes on a blue-black sheen, they hoard small shiny keepsakes from old fights, and their magic arrives in a rush of black feathers and harsh cawing.

grant.name: Carrion Count
grant.text: By spending 10 minutes walking over a place where a battle or killing happened within the last 7 days, you learn roughly how many creatures fought there, how many of them died, and the direction in which the survivors left.

confluences.name: Cuckoo
confluences.theme: Nesting in another's home
confluences.description: Cuckoo is the bird that lays its egg in another's nest and lets strangers raise its young, the art of belonging where you were never invited. A bearer settles into any household as if they had lived there for years, picks up a family's habits and sayings within hours, and their spells chime with a soft, two-note call.

grant.name: Cuckoo in the Nest
grant.text: You have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to convince someone that you belong in a household, camp, ship's crew or guild you are not part of, such as by posing as a servant, a cousin or a new hire.

confluences.name: Cutpurse
confluences.theme: Light fingers in a busy crowd
confluences.description: The cutpurse works the market crush, slicing a purse string and vanishing before the coins are missed. Bearers have restless, clever hands that are always fiddling with something and never stand still in a crowd, and their spells flick out with a glint like a falling coin.

grant.name: Crowd-Runner
grant.text: Moving through the space of a creature that isn't hostile to you, such as the press of a market crowd, doesn't cost you extra movement.

confluences.name: Cutthroat
confluences.theme: A blade in the dark for coin
confluences.description: Murder sold cheap in back alleys, where a slit throat settles any debt. Bearers learn to smile without showing teeth and keep their hands near their belts, and their magic moves in quick, thin flickers like a knife catching lamplight.

grant.name: Hidden Blade
grant.text: You can hide a dagger, or another weapon no larger than a dagger, on your body so well that a creature searching you without magic finds it only with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier.

confluences.name: Dandelion
confluences.theme: Seeds and wishes on the breeze
confluences.description: Dandelion is the humble weed that thrives everywhere and sends its seeds wherever the wind wanders. A bearer's hair has a soft yellow or silvery fluff to it, wildflowers pop up in the cracks around their home, and their spells drift on the air like seed heads before they settle.

grant.name: Wish on the Wind
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can whisper a message of up to 25 words into a dandelion clock, a feather or a pinch of thistledown and blow it into the air. It drifts to one creature you know well within 5 miles of you, arriving within 1 hour, and the creature hears your whispered message as the seed brushes its face. It can't reply this way.

confluences.name: Deadfall
confluences.theme: Snares of balanced stone and log
confluences.description: The hunter's deadfall: a balanced stone, a hair trigger and a sudden, crushing drop. Bearers fidget with bits of string and twig and see a trap in every loose ledge, and their magic triggers with a sharp snap and a patter of falling grit.

grant.name: Rig the Deadfall
grant.text: Once per short rest, you can spend 1 minute rigging loose stones, logs or rubble above a 5-foot square you can see. The first creature other than you to enter the square must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier) or be knocked prone and have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. The deadfall deals no damage, and it collapses harmlessly after 8 hours if it isn't triggered. You can have only one rigged at a time.

confluences.name: Death Knight
confluences.theme: The armoured warrior who would not die
confluences.description: The death knight is a warrior who refused to fall, fighting on in armour long after the grave should have claimed them. Bearers rarely take their armour off, a cold blue spark burns in their eyes beneath a helm, and their magic clangs like steel on a tomb door.

grant.name: Sleep in Steel
grant.text: You can sleep in medium or heavy armour without penalty. When you finish a long rest while wearing it, you regain hit points and Hit Dice and reduce your exhaustion as normal.

confluences.name: Deep Vent
confluences.theme: Boiling springs on the black seabed
confluences.description: The deep vent is a chimney of rock on the seabed, far below any light, that spews boiling black water from the fires under the world. Bearers are always warm and a little steamy, their hair curls in damp air, and their magic bubbles and hisses as it works.

grant.name: Bring to the Boil
grant.text: As an action, you can touch up to 1 gallon of nonmagical liquid that isn't inside a creature and bring it to a rolling boil at once. It then cools at the normal rate.

confluences.name: Delver
confluences.theme: Deep tunnels and the way back up
confluences.description: Delver is the tunnel-crawler's instinct for the deep places of the world and the road back to daylight. Bearers squint in sunlight, they feel the weight of stone overhead in their bones, and their spells glow with the warm, dim light of a lamp in a narrow shaft.

grant.name: Upward Sense
grant.text: While underground, you always know how far below the surface you are and the direction of the nearest passage that leads upward.

confluences.name: Demagogue
confluences.theme: Ruling the mob with stirring lies
confluences.description: The demagogue seizes power by voice alone, swaying crowds with half-truths shouted from the steps. Bearers' voices swell and carry in open air, they gesture as if always standing on a podium, and their spells boom out with the roar of a cheering crowd.

grant.name: Mob Speaker
grant.text: You have advantage on Charisma checks made to sway a crowd of ten or more people at once, such as rousing a mob, winning over a town meeting or shouting down a heckler.

confluences.name: Diabolist
confluences.theme: Fiery pacts with infernal powers
confluences.description: The diabolist is the sorcerer who bargains with devils, trading something precious for power and signing in flame.
