A bearer smells faintly of struck matches, their shadow flickers as if cast by a fire that isn't there, and their spells leave a dusting of yellow sulphur behind.

grant.name: Pact-Sense
grant.text: You can tell at a glance whether a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is bound by a pact to a fiend, an archfey or another otherworldly patron, or has sold or pledged its soul, though not to whom.

confluences.name: Diamond
confluences.theme: Brilliance, vanity and priceless gems
confluences.description: Diamond is the flawless stone, harder than anything and coveted beyond reason, the purest light locked in the earth and the purest greed it inspires. A bearer's eyes take on a cold, glittering clarity, they are drawn to fine things, and their magic scatters into sharp rainbow glints.

grant.name: Dazzling Wealth
grant.text: While you wear jewellery or finery worth at least 50 gp, you have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to impress, flatter or bribe nobles, merchants and officials.

confluences.name: Doom
confluences.theme: Inescapable ruin and the coming reckoning
confluences.description: Doom is the certainty of ruin closing in, a debt of blood and darkness that will be paid in full. A bearer's shadow pools a shade too deep and faintly red, and people who meet their eyes feel a brief, cold certainty that something terrible is on its way.

grant.name: Pronounce Doom
grant.text: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can speak the doom of one creature you can see within 30 feet of you that can hear you. The next time it makes a saving throw within the next minute, it subtracts 1d4 from the roll.

confluences.name: Dragon
confluences.theme: Wyrm majesty, scale and hoard
confluences.description: Dragon is power, pride and the open sky fused into the shape of the great wyrms. A faint sheen of scales shows along the bearer's cheekbones and the backs of their hands, their pupils narrow to slits when they are angry, and their spells arrive with the rush of vast wings.

grant.name: Hoard Sense
grant.text: You can sense any hoard of 100 or more coins, gems or pieces of jewellery within 60 feet of you, even through walls, and you know its direction and roughly how large it is.

confluences.name: Drake
confluences.theme: Wingless wyrm basking on hot stone
confluences.description: A lesser dragon that never took to the air, all scale, heat and hunger, nesting in the hot rock of volcanic slopes. Bearers grow patches of hard scale at their wrists and throat and love to lie on warm stones, and their magic glows like embers under ash.

grant.name: Basking
grant.text: Once per long rest, a short rest you spend lying on stone warmed by the sun or by a fire lasts only 10 minutes for you.

confluences.name: Dreadnought
confluences.theme: Fearless iron on dark seas
confluences.description: The dreadnought is the armoured warship that fears nothing, ploughing through black water toward the enemy. Bearers have a heavy, rolling stride and a jaw like a ship's prow, salt crusts their armour, and their magic booms like a broadside.

grant.name: Keep Her Afloat
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a ship or boat you are aboard is holed or begins to sink, you can will it to stay afloat. For the next hour, it doesn't sink further, giving its crew time to reach shore, make repairs or abandon ship.

confluences.name: Dredger
confluences.theme: Scavenging lost coins from river mud
confluences.description: The dredger wades the riverbanks and harbour mud at low tide, sifting the silt for dropped coins, rings and lost blades and keeping whatever turns up. Bearers smell faintly of river mud and have a magpie's eye for anything that glints, and their magic ripples outward like a footstep in shallow water.

grant.name: Glint in the Silt
grant.text: While you touch mud, silt, wet sand or shallow water, you sense any coin, ring, blade or other metal object buried or sunk within 10 feet of the spot you touch, and you know exactly where it lies.

confluences.name: Drowner
confluences.theme: The thing that pulls swimmers under
confluences.description: The drowner is the quick, dark shape beneath the surface of lonely lakes that seizes a swimmer by the ankle and drags them down before they can cry out. A bearer's hair always looks damp and tangled with river weed, they move with a long, restless stride, and their magic surges up like dark water closing over a head.

grant.name: Drowning Grip
grant.text: While you and another creature are both in water, you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to grapple it and on checks made to stop it escaping your grapple.

confluences.name: Duellist
confluences.theme: Honour, footwork and the single blade
confluences.description: Duellist is the sword and the quick, proud step fused into the art of single combat. Bearers fall into a half-turned fencer's stance without meaning to, they salute before every fight, and their spells flick out with the hiss of a blade cutting air.

grant.name: Measure the Blade
grant.text: After watching a creature make at least one weapon attack, you know whether its attack bonus with that weapon is higher than, lower than or equal to your own best weapon attack bonus.

confluences.name: Dune
confluences.theme: Shifting sand and scorching sun
confluences.description: Dune is the endless desert, its blinding sun and the patient things that survive in it. Bearers' skin bronzes and their eyes narrow against glare, sand turns up in their clothes however often they shake them out, and their spells shimmer like heat rising off stone.

grant.name: Desert-Born
grant.text: You automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme heat, and you need only half as much water each day as normal.

confluences.name: Dust Devil
confluences.theme: Whirling dust on the open road
confluences.description: The little whirlwind that spins across dry roads and fields and is gone before anyone can follow it. Bearers are restless wanderers with sun-cracked lips, a small swirl of dust always eddies at their heels, and their magic twists in tight spirals.

grant.name: Swept Tracks
grant.text: When you move across dust, sand, ash, snow or loose soil, little eddies of wind sweep away your footprints behind you, so you leave no tracks there unless you choose to.

confluences.name: Eagle
confluences.theme: Lord of the high cold sky
confluences.description: The eagle is the great hunting bird that rides the mountain winds, scanning whole valleys for prey from a perch above the clouds. Bearers have wind-whipped hair and a far-ranging, golden-eyed gaze, they feel cramped under low ceilings, and their magic sweeps out on broad, gusting wingbeats.

grant.name: Survey
grant.text: When you spend 10 minutes looking out from a high place, such as a peak, tower, cliff or tall tree, in daylight or bright moonlight, you learn the lay of the land within 5 miles of you: its roads, rivers, settlements and passes, and the easiest route to any place you can see from there.

confluences.name: Eclipse
confluences.theme: Sun and moon held in balance
confluences.description: Eclipse is the rare moment when sun and moon stand in perfect alignment and noon turns to dusk. A bearer's irises darken at the centre inside a thin ring of gold, and their spells dim the light around them while blazing at the edges like a corona.

grant.name: Twilight Eyes
grant.text: Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks, and you can look directly at the sun or any other bright light without discomfort.

confluences.name: Eel
confluences.theme: Lightning coiled in a dark river
confluences.description: The electric eel, a slippery river predator that hunts with lightning stored in its own flesh. Bearers' hair stands slightly on end and small sparks snap when they touch metal, and their magic arcs in quick blue-white crackles through water and air.

grant.name: Static Touch
grant.text: As an action, you can let a harmless static spark jump from your fingertip to a creature or object you touch. It wakes a creature that is asleep, including one put to sleep by the sleep spell, or lights a fuse, a wick or dry tinder.

confluences.name: Enchanter
confluences.theme: Binding magic into made things
confluences.description: Enchanter is rune, raw magic and craft fused into the art of binding power into objects. Bearers' tools hum faintly at their touch, glowing marks crawl along anything they work on, and their spells settle into objects like heat into a horseshoe.

grant.name: Item Lore
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes handling a magic item to learn its properties and how to use them, as if you had cast identify on it.

confluences.name: Envoy
confluences.theme: Messages, treaties and safe passage
confluences.description: Envoy is the art of carrying words between enemies and coming back alive. Bearers have a calm, neutral bearing that puts strangers at ease, and their spells unroll like scrolls sealed with glowing wax.

grant.name: Parley
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you openly approach a group of humanoids under a sign of truce, those that understand you won't attack you until you have spoken for up to 1 minute, unless you or your allies act with hostility first.

confluences.name: Evergreen
confluences.theme: Life that never fades or fails
confluences.description: Evergreen is life at its most stubborn and abundant, the pine that stays green through the deepest winter. A bearer keeps a healthy colour even when starving or wounded, small green shoots spring up where they sleep, and their magic smells of sap and new leaves.

grant.name: Deep Green
grant.text: When you finish a long rest, you regain all of your spent Hit Dice, rather than only half of them.

confluences.name: Evil Eye
confluences.theme: Envious praise that brings misfortune
confluences.description: The evil eye is envy made into a curse, ill luck carried on a covetous glance and a word of false praise. Bearers' eyes are unsettlingly sharp and dark, people touch their charms when they pass, and their magic slides out from the corner of their gaze.

grant.name: Jinx
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature within 30 feet of you that can hear you is about to make an ability check, you can use your reaction to praise it enviously. It makes that check with disadvantage.

confluences.name: Executioner
confluences.theme: Death dealt by duty
confluences.description: The executioner is the hooded figure at the block, the strong arm that brings the law's final ending and carries its weight in silence. Bearers grow quiet and heavy-handed, crowds part for them without knowing why, and their magic falls in single, final strokes.

grant.name: Killer's Mark
grant.text: By studying a humanoid's face and hands for 1 minute, you know whether it has ever killed another humanoid with its own hands.

confluences.name: Eyrie
confluences.theme: High nests on wind-scoured crags
confluences.description: The eagle's nest wedged into a cliff face, where gales howl and the whole land lies spread out below. Bearers grow sharp-featured and still, prefer to perch on ledges and rooftops rather than sit, and their magic stirs a rush of air like beating wings.

grant.name: Startled Wings
grant.text: While you are outdoors, you can spend 1 minute watching the birds around you to learn whether a group of ten or more creatures, or any Large or larger creature, is moving within 1 mile of you, and the direction of the nearest such disturbance.

confluences.name: Faerie
confluences.theme: Fey glamour, mischief and moonlit rings
confluences.description: Faerie is wild growth, moonlight and laughter fused into the mischief of the fey. Bearers' ears grow faintly pointed and their laughter sounds like distant bells, flowers turn to follow them, and their spells glitter with drifting motes of pollen and light.

grant.name: Fey Sight
grant.text: You can sense the presence of fey creatures within 60 feet of you, even if they are invisible or disguised, and you know the direction of the nearest one.

confluences.name: Fairy Gold
confluences.theme: Glamoured coin that turns to leaves
confluences.description: Fairy Gold is the gleaming payment from a stranger in the woods that turns back into leaves, pebbles and dirt by morning. A bearer's smile is just a little too charming, coins seem to wander through their fingers, and their magic sparkles gold before crumbling into dust.

grant.name: Glamoured Coin
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can touch up to ten pebbles, leaves, buttons or copper coins and make them look, feel and ring like gold pieces. They return to their true form at the next dawn, and detect magic reveals them as illusions.

confluences.name: Falconer
confluences.theme: The hunting bird and its keeper
confluences.description: The falconer binds the wild hunger of a bird of prey to patient care, until the killer of the skies returns willingly to a gloved fist. Bearers whistle without thinking, hold one forearm half raised as if for a perch, and their magic flies out and returns to their hand like a hooded hawk.

grant.name: Lure and Fist
grant.text: You have advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks made to calm, train or direct birds. When you whistle, a bird of prey that can hear you and isn't hostile to you comes to land on your arm.

confluences.name: Fallen
confluences.theme: Radiance worn over secret vice
confluences.description: The fallen were once bright and good, and still wear that radiance like a mask over darker appetites. Bearers have an open, trustworthy face and a faint golden sheen that brightens when they lie, and their magic glows a beautiful but slightly tarnished gold.

grant.name: Angel Face
grant.text: You have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to convince others that you are innocent, harmless or acting in good faith.

confluences.name: Familiar
confluences.theme: A spellcaster's bird and borrowed eyes
confluences.description: Familiar is the bond between a spellcaster and a small winged companion, two lives that understand each other without words. Birds and mice perch on a bearer's shoulder without fear, they cock their head like a crow when they listen, and their spells arrive with a flurry of shadowy feathers.

grant.name: Fetch
grant.text: As an action, you can ask a Tiny bird or other Tiny beast that can see you and isn't hostile to you to fetch an object weighing no more than 1 ounce, such as a key, a ring or a folded letter, that you point out within 60 feet of you and that no one is wearing or carrying. It brings the object to your hand as quickly as it can.

confluences.name: Fen
confluences.theme: Bog, reeds and treacherous water
confluences.description: Fen is mud and still water joined into the slow, rich life of the marsh. Bearers smell of peat and reeds, their feet find firm ground where there should be none, and their spells drift in low greenish mist.

grant.name: Bogtrotter
grant.text: Mud, marsh, bog and shallow standing water don't count as difficult terrain for you.

confluences.name: Fever
confluences.theme: Hot blood that keeps life burning
confluences.description: The body's own fire, the burning heat with which living things fight to stay alive. Bearers run hot to the touch, flush easily and rarely need a blanket, and their healing magic feels like a warm sweat breaking.

grant.name: Inner Heat
grant.text: You automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold, and you are comfortable in freezing weather even in light clothing.

confluences.name: Firebird
confluences.theme: Glowing bird whose cry brings morning
confluences.description: The firebird, whose glowing plumage lights the orchard at night and whose warm breath brings frostbitten trees back into blossom. Bearers have a few streaks of flame-coloured hair and are always warm to the touch, and their magic trails sparks like drifting plumes.

grant.name: Rekindling Breath
grant.text: As an action, you can breathe warmly on a plant that is wilted, frostbitten or dying, but not dead for more than a day, and restore it to full health. This has no effect on plant creatures.

confluences.name: Firebrand
confluences.theme: Burning words and roused fists
confluences.description: The agitator with a torch in one hand and a cause in the other, whose fury spreads through a crowd like flame through dry straw. Bearers have a smouldering intensity and a voice that cracks like a whip, and their magic flares up whenever their temper does.

grant.name: Red-Hot Grip
grant.text: As an action, you can heat a nonmagical metal object you are holding, such as a blade, a poker or an iron bar, until it glows red-hot for 1 minute. The heat doesn't harm you and adds no damage to attacks, but the object can burn through rope, cloth or leather in a few seconds, and it sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius.

confluences.name: Firefly
confluences.theme: Small lights in summer darkness
confluences.description: Fireflies are the soft lights of warm nights, life calling to life across a dark meadow. After sunset a faint golden-green glow shows at bearers' temples, children and animals warm to them at once, and their magic rises in drifting points of light.

grant.name: Lightswarm
grant.text: As an action, you can release up to four motes of soft light that drift like fireflies within 60 feet of you. Each sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. As a bonus action, you can move any of them up to 30 feet. They last for 10 minutes or until you dismiss them, and you can't have more than four at once.

confluences.name: Firehawk
confluences.theme: The raptor that spreads the fire
confluences.description: A hawk that snatches burning sticks from wildfires and drops them on dry grass to flush out its prey. Bearers have sharp, sooty-looking features and love the smell of smoke, and their magic swoops in streaks of flame and ash.

grant.name: Smoke on the Wind
grant.text: You can smell smoke up to 5 miles away and know its direction, and you can tell whether it comes from a campfire, a forge, a burning building or a wildfire.

confluences.name: Firestorm
confluences.theme: Scorching winds that feed the flames
confluences.description: The firestorm, a blaze so great that it breathes its own howling wind. Bearers have ember-hot breath and singed eyebrows, loose cloth and hair stream around them, and their magic roars out like a furnace door thrown open.

grant.name: Furnace Gust
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can exhale a blast of scorching wind in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier) or be pushed 10 feet away from you. Unprotected flames in the cone flare high and go out, and loose papers and other light objects are blown away. The gust deals no damage.

confluences.name: Firewater
confluences.theme: Burning liquor and loosened tongues
confluences.description: Firewater is strong drink that burns going down, the spirit of smugglers, card tables and dockside taverns that turns honest folk reckless. Bearers have a warm flush on their cheeks, a grin that invites trouble and a voice that always seems to be calling for another round, and their magic flickers with a pale blue flame like burning brandy.

grant.name: Loose Lips
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature drinks strong liquor that you poured for it, you can loosen its tongue. For the next hour, it has disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) checks and doesn't realise anything unusual happened.

confluences.name: Fireweed
confluences.theme: First green growth after the burn
confluences.description: Fireweed is the bright pink bloom that springs from blackened earth the season after a wildfire, life returning through the ash. A bearer smells of woodsmoke and fresh sap, their hair streaks with soot-black and magenta, and their magic leaves seedlings sprouting where its sparks fall.

grant.name: Green from Ash
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can touch a patch of ash, cinders or freshly burned ground. By the next dawn, a 10-foot square of it sprouts edible greens, shoots and roots, enough to feed up to four Medium creatures for a day.

confluences.name: Firework
confluences.theme: Coloured fire bursting into wonder
confluences.description: The rocket and the starburst, fire coaxed by art into a spectacle of colour and wonder. Bearers love an audience and a good bang, their eyes flash with brief colours when they are excited, and their magic pops and crackles in showers of coloured sparks.

grant.name: Firecracker
grant.text: As an action, you can flick a spark to a point you can see within 60 feet of you, where it bursts in a harmless shower of coloured stars with a crack that can be heard up to 300 feet away. It can't harm or ignite anything.

confluences.name: Flare
confluences.theme: Blinding fire hung in the sky
confluences.description: The sudden white flare that turns night into stark noon over a battlefield or a sinking ship. Bearers have pale, bright eyes that never seem to squint, and their magic flashes white-hot and leaves afterimages swimming in the eye.

grant.name: Hanging Flare
grant.text: Once per short rest, as an action, you can hurl a sputtering ball of white fire to a point you can see within 120 feet of you, where it hangs in the air for 1 minute. It sheds bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet, and it can't harm or ignite anything.

confluences.name: Flicker
confluences.theme: Darting like a candle flame
confluences.description: Flicker is the restless dance of a flame that is never quite where it was a moment ago. A bearer can't keep still, their outline wavers like candlelight when they move fast, and their spells dart and jink through the air before they strike.

grant.name: Leap Back Up
grant.text: Standing up from being prone costs you only 5 feet of movement.

confluences.name: Fog
confluences.theme: Blinding mist rolling in at dusk
confluences.description: Fog is the grey wall that rolls off the water at dusk and swallows roads, ships and sound alike. A bearer's breath mists even on warm days, their clothes are always faintly damp, and their magic seeps out as curling grey vapour.

grant.name: Fog Breath
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can exhale a thick natural fog that fills a 15-foot-radius sphere centred on you. The area is heavily obscured. The fog lasts for 10 minutes, or until a moderate or stronger wind disperses it.

confluences.name: Fool's Gold
confluences.theme: Glittering fakes for the greedy
confluences.description: The pyrite and gilded lead that dazzle the greedy eye and turn out worthless. Bearers have a winning, glinting smile and a fondness for showy jewellery, and their magic glitters with a golden sheen that never quite survives close inspection.

grant.name: Gilding
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a nonmagical object no larger than a shield and give it a gleaming coat of false gold or silver for 1 hour, or until you end it. A creature that handles the object can tell it is fake with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. You can gild only one object at a time.

confluences.name: Footpad
confluences.theme: Robbery and blood on the road
confluences.description: The footpad waits on foot at the dark bend in the lane with a cudgel and a knife, choosing marks by the weight of their purses. Bearers walk light and quick, size up every traveller they pass, and their magic strikes fast and is gone before the dust settles.

grant.name: Purse-Weight
grant.text: By watching a creature walk or ride for 1 minute, you know roughly how much coin and how many valuables it carries, and whether any of them are hidden on its person or in its baggage.

confluences.name: Forge
confluences.theme: Fire, hammer and metal made one
confluences.description: Forge is flame, hammer and iron joined in the endless work of the smithy. Bearers' forearms grow corded and soot-flecked, their voices ring with a hint of struck metal, and their spells land in a shower of sparks with the tang of hot iron.

grant.name: Field Smithy
grant.text: During a short rest, you can repair one broken or damaged nonmagical metal weapon, tool or piece of armour using only a fire and a flat stone, as if you were working in a full smithy with smith's tools.

confluences.name: Fortune
confluences.theme: Luck, chance and the turning wheel
confluences.description: Fortune is the fickle favour of luck itself. Bearers have an infuriating habit of finding dropped coins and landing on their feet, and their spells spin and glitter like a tossed coin catching the light.

grant.name: Lucky Break
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you roll a 1 on a d20 for an attack roll, ability check or saving throw, you can reroll the die. You must use the new roll.

confluences.name: Fountain
confluences.theme: Clear, sunlit water that renews
confluences.description: Fountain is the sparkling spring in the town square, clean water that keeps a people healthy and hopeful. A bearer's eyes are as clear and bright as water in sunlight, any cup they hold stays cool, and their spells sparkle and splash like light dancing on a pool.

grant.name: Clear Spring
grant.text: As an action, you can touch up to 1 gallon of water or another nonmagical drink and make it clean and fresh, removing mud, rot, disease and nonmagical poison from it.

confluences.name: Frog
confluences.theme: Pond life and the mighty leap
confluences.description: Frog is the teeming life of ponds and marshes, spawn becoming tadpole becoming leaping frog every spring. A bearer has slightly damp skin, a wide grin and a deep, croaking laugh, and their spells arrive with a wet splash and a chorus of distant croaks.

grant.name: Standing Leap
grant.text: You can make a long jump or high jump without a running start and still cover your full jumping distance.

confluences.name: Fugitive
confluences.theme: Running by night, leaving no trail
confluences.description: Fugitive is flight under cover of darkness, the hunted one who is always a step ahead and never where they were last seen. A bearer sleeps lightly with their boots on, always knows the nearest way out of a room, and their magic flickers and is gone before anyone can mark where it came from.

grant.name: Cold Trail
grant.text: Creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track you, or a mount you are riding, unless you choose to leave a trail.

confluences.name: Gazelle
confluences.theme: Fleet grace across open grassland
confluences.description: Gazelle is gentle life made quick and light, the grazer that survives by speed and sudden bounds. A bearer grows long-limbed and restless, never sits with their back to an open door, and their magic moves in springing arcs.

grant.name: Springing Stride
grant.text: You need only a 5-foot run-up, rather than 10 feet, to make a running long jump or running high jump, and your running long jump distance increases by 5 feet.

confluences.name: Geode
confluences.theme: Hidden light inside dark stone
confluences.description: A geode is a plain grey stone that cracks open on a hollow full of glittering crystal. Bearers look unremarkable until they smile or cast, when a glint of violet or amber crystal shows in their eyes, and their magic sparkles like broken quartz.

grant.name: Prospector's Touch
grant.text: By laying your palm on bare rock for 1 minute, you learn whether any gems, crystals or veins of precious metal lie within 10 feet of that spot, and roughly what kind they are.

confluences.name: Geyser
confluences.theme: Boiling water bursting from below
confluences.description: The geyser that rumbles under the ground and bursts skyward in a roaring column of scalding steam. Bearers are prone to long silences and sudden outbursts, their skin is always slightly flushed and damp, and their magic hisses and steams as it is cast.

grant.name: Steam Plume
grant.text: Once per short rest, as an action, you can touch a body of water or a container holding at least 1 gallon of water and make it erupt in a roaring plume of steam that fills a 10-foot cube centred on it. The steam heavily obscures its area for 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it. It is hot but harmless.

confluences.name: Ghoul
confluences.theme: Graveyard hunger that feeds on the dead
confluences.description: Death and the dark doubled, with a hunger that crawls out at night to feed on what the grave holds. Bearers grow pale and long-nailed with cold breath and a sunken look, and their magic seeps out in grey, clammy wisps.

grant.name: Grave Nose
grant.text: You can smell dead flesh within 60 feet of you, even through walls, and you know the direction of the nearest source. By sniffing a corpse, you can tell how long ago it died.

confluences.name: Giant
confluences.theme: Storm-crowned giants striding the peaks
confluences.description: The giants of the high crags, who wear storm clouds like cloaks and heave boulders into the gale. Bearers grow broad and weathered, their hair always looks windswept, and their voice rolls like distant rockfall.

grant.name: Giant's Throw
grant.text: Once per short rest, as an action, you can pick up a willing Small or Medium creature within 5 feet of you and throw it to an unoccupied space you can see within 20 feet of you, horizontally or upward onto a ledge. It lands on its feet and takes no damage from the throw.

confluences.name: Glacier
confluences.theme: Slow ice that carves mountains
confluences.description: Glacier is ice that creeps a hand's breadth a year and still grinds mountains into valleys. Bearers grow cold to the touch and impossible to hurry, their breath fogs even in summer, and their spells creak and groan like shifting ice.

grant.name: Freezing Touch
grant.text: As an action, you can touch up to 1 gallon of nonmagical water or other liquid that isn't inside a creature and freeze it solid. It stays frozen for 1 hour, then thaws normally.

confluences.name: Gladiator
confluences.theme: Blood, steel and the roaring crowd
confluences.description: Bloodshed made into a show of strength, where fighters earn their lives blow by blow before a cheering crowd. Bearers collect their scars with pride and stand with their feet planted wide, and their magic flashes like sunlight off a raised blade.

grant.name: Arena Footing
grant.text: You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid being shoved or grappled, and on ability checks made to escape a grapple.

confluences.name: Golem
confluences.theme: Stone made to serve by magic
confluences.description: Golem is the giant of clay or stone given life by words of power, tireless, obedient and terribly strong. A bearer grows heavy-boned and slow to blink, their skin cracks like dry clay when they strain, and their magic glows from within them like runes carved in a stone chest.

grant.name: Maker's Mark
grant.text: By touching a construct, golem or animated object for 1 minute, whether it is active or not, you learn who or what made it, roughly when it was made, and the last command it was given.

confluences.name: Gravedigger
confluences.theme: Patient spade among the dead
confluences.description: The gravedigger tends the last bed of everyone, working the cold earth in the dark hours and keeping its secrets afterwards. Bearers have soil beneath their nails however they scrub, feel at ease in graveyards, and their magic smells of fresh-turned earth.

grant.name: Turned Earth
grant.text: You can tell at a glance whether soil, sand or rubble within 30 feet of you was dug up and filled back in during the last year, such as a grave or a buried cache, and roughly how deep anything buried there lies.

confluences.name: Graverobber
confluences.theme: Midnight spades and stolen grave goods
confluences.description: The graverobber works by moonlight with a muffled spade, prying rings from the dead for coin. Bearers' fingernails stay rimmed with grave dirt however they scrub, they have a magpie's eye for jewellery, and their magic smells of turned earth and old coins.

grant.name: Undisturbed
grant.text: You dig through soil and sand twice as fast as normal. When you fill in a hole, grave or pit you dug, you can make the ground look untouched; a creature can tell the earth was disturbed only with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier.

confluences.name: Gravewarden
confluences.theme: Lantern and blade among the graves
confluences.description: The gravewarden walks the cemetery at night with lantern and blade, keeping the dead at rest and the robbers out. Bearers have a solemn bearing and a stillness that calms mourners, lantern-light burns steadier around them, and their magic rings like iron gates swinging shut.

grant.name: Empty Grave
grant.text: By touching a grave, tomb or coffin, you learn whether a body still lies in it. If one was there and is gone, you also learn whether it was carried away or rose and left on its own.

confluences.name: Grimoire
confluences.theme: Forbidden books read in darkness
confluences.description: The grimoire is the black book of forbidden spells, its secrets written for eyes that work in the dark. Bearers' fingertips grow sensitive and faintly inky, they murmur half-remembered incantations, and their magic rustles like turning pages.

grant.name: Dark Reading
grant.text: You can read writing in total darkness by running your fingertips over the page or surface, as quickly and easily as if you could see it, as long as it is in a language you can read.

confluences.name: Grotto
confluences.theme: Black pools in flooded caves
confluences.description: A grotto is a cave where black water laps at stone and every drip echoes forever. Bearers' skin stays cool and faintly damp, their voices carry a slight echo, and their magic falls like drops from a cave ceiling.

grant.name: Air Pocket
grant.text: While you are underwater or in a flooded cave or tunnel, you always know the direction and rough distance to the nearest pocket of breathable air or place where you can surface, as long as it is within 300 feet of you.

confluences.name: Grudge
confluences.theme: Spite that smoulders for years
confluences.description: A grudge is anger buried and kept warm, a coal of envy and spite fed in secret. Bearers wear a tight, knowing smile and keep tallies and lists, and their magic burns low and hot like a fire banked overnight.

grant.name: Never Forget
grant.text: You never forget the face, voice or name of a creature that has harmed, cheated or insulted you, and you have advantage on checks made to see through that creature's disguises.

confluences.name: Hag
confluences.theme: Crone of cauldrons and cruel bargains
confluences.description: The hag is the crone at the edge of the woods who trades in hair, voices, years and firstborn children, and always gets the better of the deal. Bearers grow long nails and a knowing cackle, and their magic bubbles and reeks like a cauldron left on the fire.

grant.name: Traded Voice
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can shake hands with a willing humanoid and strike a bargain to swap voices with it. For up to 24 hours, each of you speaks with the other's voice, though not with its languages or knowledge. Either of you can end the swap early by spitting on the ground (no action required).

confluences.name: Hare
confluences.theme: Quick feet in the spring fields
confluences.description: Hare is the leaping, bolting life of the meadow, gentle and fertile and always one jump ahead. A bearer has long, restless legs and a twitch of the nose when they're thinking, and their spells zigzag unpredictably across the ground.

grant.name: Bolt
grant.text: Once per short rest, when a creature you can see moves to within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to move up to 5 feet away from it. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

confluences.name: Harpooner
confluences.theme: Barbed iron and the whaler's line
confluences.description: The harpooner stands braced at the bow, waiting for the great beast to surface, then throws iron and line with all their strength. Bearers have rope-scarred palms and powerful shoulders, they coil any cord they touch without thinking, and their spells fly like a harpoon trailing a hissing line.

grant.name: Haul Away
grant.text: You have advantage on Strength checks made to pull a creature or object toward you with a rope, net, chain or line, such as landing a hooked fish, dragging in a harpooned beast or hauling a comrade out of the water.

confluences.name: Harvest
confluences.theme: Reaping what the seasons sowed
confluences.description: Harvest is the year's labour brought to fruit, grain ripening under the sun and bread on the table. Bearers carry a scent of cut hay and warm earth, their hands are calloused and sure, and their spells drift with motes of golden chaff.

grant.name: Ripening Touch
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a healthy living plant that is in season and make its fruit, grain, nuts or seeds ripen at once. Each plant can be ripened this way only once per year.

confluences.name: Haunt
confluences.theme: Restless spirits and lingering echoes
confluences.description: Haunt is grief and emptiness fused into the presence of the restless dead. Rooms grow cold when bearers enter, their reflections lag a moment behind them, and their spells carry faint whispers no one else can place.

grant.name: Ghost Sense
grant.text: You can sense the presence of ghosts, spirits and other incorporeal creatures within 30 feet of you, even if they are invisible or on the Ethereal Plane, though not their exact location.

confluences.name: Headsman
confluences.theme: Judgement delivered with a single stroke
confluences.description: Law and death meeting at the block, where justice is paid in blood. Bearers have steady, heavy hands and a calm that unsettles crowds, and their magic falls in clean, final strokes of black and white.

grant.name: Read the Wound
grant.text: By examining a wound, corpse or bloodstain for 1 minute, you learn what kind of weapon, claw, bite or spell made it, and roughly how long ago.

confluences.name: Heartfire
confluences.theme: Courage kindled in living hearts
confluences.description: The fire of the living heart, the warmth and courage that keep people fighting for their homes and families. Bearers feel feverishly warm and their cheeks are always flushed with health, and their magic pulses with a ruddy glow in time with their heartbeat.

grant.name: Kindle Courage
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can give a rousing shout. Up to three allies within 30 feet of you that can hear you each gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

confluences.name: Hearthlight
confluences.theme: The lamp left burning for travellers
confluences.description: The lamp left burning in a cottage window so that whoever is still out in the dark can find the way home. Bearers have a warm, steady presence that makes strangers feel welcome, and their magic glows with a soft, honey-coloured candlelight.

grant.name: Welcome Sense
grant.text: When you approach a house, inn, farmstead or camp, you know whether you would be welcome there: whether the people inside are friendly, wary or hostile toward strangers like you.

confluences.name: Heartwood
confluences.theme: Living wood shaped into arms
confluences.description: Heartwood is the dark, iron-hard core of an ancient tree, the growing world shaped by magic into staves, clubs and shields. A bearer's skin shows the faint grain of polished wood, they never feel quite at home without a tree in sight, and their spells creak and groan like great boughs in a gale.

grant.name: Gift of the Bough
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes with your hands on a living tree to coax one of its branches into the shape of a club, greatclub, quarterstaff, javelin or wooden shield, which then drops into your hands. It is an ordinary item of its kind, and the tree is unharmed.

confluences.name: Hedgewitch
confluences.theme: Herb charms and cottage spellcraft
confluences.description: Hedgewitch is the quiet magic of the village wise folk, worked with herbs, string, bone and whispered rhymes. A bearer smells of dried lavender and woodsmoke, their pockets fill up with twigs and knotted thread, and their spells come out as rhymed mutters and a flutter of drying leaves.

grant.name: Dream Pillow
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes sewing a small pillow of lavender, hops and rue. A creature that sleeps on it during its next long rest sleeps soundly and free of nightmares, and magic can't enter, shape or read its dreams during that rest, such as the dream spell.

confluences.name: Heliograph
confluences.theme: Sunlight flashing messages across hills
confluences.description: Heliograph is the mirror on the hilltop that catches the sun and flashes news from peak to peak faster than any rider. A bearer is always polishing some buckle or blade, sunlight seems to find them wherever they stand, and their magic arrives in quick, bright flashes.

grant.name: Flash Code
grant.text: While you are in direct sunlight, you can use a mirror, polished shield or bright blade to flash a message of up to 10 words to a creature that can see you within 5 miles. A creature that has spent at least 1 hour learning your code from you understands it; others see only flashes.

confluences.name: Hellhound
confluences.theme: Coal-eyed hound of the night
confluences.description: A hunting beast of smoke and shadow whose breath glows like coals, running its quarry down long after dark. Bearers' eyes catch the light with a red gleam and their breath steams even on warm days, and their magic smells of brimstone.

grant.name: Hellish Bay
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can let out a baying howl. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier or be frightened of you until the end of its next turn.

confluences.name: Hellsteed
confluences.theme: The black steed with burning hooves
confluences.description: The hellsteed is a black horse with a mane of smoke and hooves that strike sparks as it gallops through the dark. Bearers have a restless, stamping energy, their breath steams even on warm nights, and their magic leaves scorched hoofprints behind.

grant.name: Ember Eyes
grant.text: While you are riding a mount, its eyes glow like coals and it can see in darkness within 60 feet of it as if the darkness were dim light.

confluences.name: Hemomancy
confluences.theme: Spellcraft drawn from one's own veins
confluences.description: Hemomancy is the arcane art of blood, where a few drops become ink, focus and window into what has passed. Bearers carry small neat cuts on their fingertips and veins that show faintly dark through the skin, and their spells leave a coppery scent in the air.

grant.name: Blood Memory
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can touch blood that was spilled within the last 24 hours and see a brief vision of the face of whoever or whatever caused it to be spilled.

confluences.name: Henge
confluences.theme: Stone circles aligned to the sky
confluences.description: Henge is the ring of standing stones raised to catch the sunrise on the longest day, where earth, sky and old magic meet. A bearer has an instinct for arranging things in circles and habitually turns to face the dawn, and their magic flows in a slow ring of pale light.

grant.name: Stone Ring
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes setting stones in a ring up to 30 feet across. Until you next finish a long rest, you know whenever a creature larger than Tiny crosses the ring while you are within 1 mile of it, and a faint chime in your head wakes you if you are asleep.

confluences.name: Hex
confluences.theme: Spiteful curses and the evil eye
confluences.description: Hex is magic turned to malice, the muttered curse and the knotted charm left on a rival's doorstep. A bearer's eyes take on a faint mismatched tint, they knot threads and hair without thinking, and their magic crawls across its target in a dark tracery of runes.

grant.name: Curse-Wise
grant.text: You have advantage on saving throws against curses, such as the bestow curse spell or the curse of a cursed magic item. By touching an object for 1 minute, you can tell whether it carries a curse, though not what the curse does.

confluences.name: Hibernation
confluences.theme: The long sleep through winter
confluences.description: Hibernation is life curled up in the dark, slow-hearted and patient, waiting for spring. Bearers grow drowsy and a little heavier in cold weather, yawn often and contentedly, and their magic settles over things like a thick winter blanket.

grant.name: Den Sleep
grant.text: You can fall asleep within 1 minute anywhere, however cold, noisy or uncomfortable it is. When you do, you can choose a time to wake, and you wake at that time fully alert unless something wakes you first.

confluences.name: Highwayman
confluences.theme: Robbery on the open road
confluences.description: The highwayman waits where the road bends, blade ready, to relieve travellers of their purses. Bearers carry a whiff of horse and dust and always know which way a road runs, and their spells come with the clatter of hooves and the jingle of stolen coin.

grant.name: Road Reader
grant.text: By studying a stretch of road or trail for 1 minute, you learn how many riders, wagons and people on foot have passed along it in the last 24 hours, which way they were heading, and whether any wagon among them was heavily loaded.

confluences.name: Hot Spring
confluences.theme: Steaming mineral pools over buried fire
confluences.description: Hot Spring is water warmed by the fire deep in the earth, rising steaming and mineral-rich through the rock. A bearer's skin always feels warm and faintly flushed, their hair curls in damp air, and their magic rises with a hiss of steam and a smell of sulphur.

grant.name: Mineral Soak
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you finish a short rest spent soaking in a natural hot spring, or in hot water with a handful of salt, clay or crushed minerals stirred in, you reduce your exhaustion level by 1.

confluences.name: Hound
confluences.theme: The pack that runs prey down
confluences.description: The hunt given legs: baying, tireless and never far behind. Bearers grow lean and long-limbed and lope instead of walking when they are eager, and their magic streaks out ahead of them like a pack let off the leash.

grant.name: Run It Down
grant.text: During a chase, you can take the Dash action a number of additional times equal to your proficiency bonus before you risk gaining exhaustion from it.

confluences.name: Huckster
confluences.theme: Loud bargains and quick-tongued trade
confluences.description: The huckster sells anything to anyone, crying wares down the street and swearing every price is a bargain. Bearers have a loud, cheerful voice that carries over any market and can't stop haggling, and their spells come with the jingle of coins and a merchant's call.

grant.name: Ring True
grant.text: By tapping, flicking or biting a coin, gem, bell or other object of metal or stone and listening for a moment, you know whether it is counterfeit or flawed and roughly what it is worth.

confluences.name: Hunter's Moon
confluences.theme: The autumn moon of the great hunt
confluences.description: The full moon after harvest, when the beasts are fat and the nights are long enough to kill what will feed a village through winter. Bearers grow restless as the seasons turn and come alive after nightfall, and their magic glows a pale, ripe orange like the rising moon.

grant.name: Lay of the Land
grant.text: When you spend at least 1 hour outdoors at night, you learn what kinds of beasts hunt or graze within 1 mile of you, and where their main trails, dens and watering places are.

confluences.name: Hurricane
confluences.theme: The sky's fury at its peak
confluences.description: The hurricane is wind at its most concentrated, a vast spinning storm that roars across sea and land. Bearers' hair never lies flat and a breeze stirs wherever they stand, and their spells howl out in spinning bands of wind around a calm, quiet eye.

grant.name: Howling Gust
grant.text: As an action, you can send a sudden gust of wind out in a 15-foot cone. Candles and other small unprotected flames in the area go out, loose papers and leaves scatter, unattended objects weighing 1 pound or less are pushed 10 feet, and nonmagical fog, smoke and gas there disperse. Creatures are unaffected.

confluences.name: Ill Wind
confluences.theme: Cold whispers on a night wind
confluences.description: Ill Wind is the cold gust that slams shutters at midnight and carries bad news faster than any rider. A bearer's cloak stirs when the air is still, candles gutter as they pass, and their spells arrive on a sudden chilling draught.

grant.name: Borne on the Wind
grant.text: Once per long rest, while you are outdoors, you can whisper a message of up to 25 words into the wind and name a creature you have met. If that creature is outdoors within 1 mile of you, a chill breeze carries your words to it as a whisper at its ear. It can't reply the same way.

confluences.name: Illumination
confluences.theme: Light that lays secrets bare
confluences.description: Light held so close and so bright that nothing written, hidden or scraped away can escape it. Bearers peer at the world like a scholar bent over a lamp, their eyes catch firelight like polished brass, and their magic shines with a clean, searching glow.

grant.name: Revealing Flame
grant.text: When you hold a page, map, letter or other written surface up to a flame you lit, any invisible, erased, scraped-away or overwritten writing on it shows faintly for as long as you hold it there. This doesn't reveal writing hidden by a spell.

confluences.name: Infernal
confluences.theme: Devil's bargains and binding debts
confluences.description: Infernal is sin and debt fused into the cold logic of the devil's bargain. Bearers smell faintly of brimstone and sealing wax, their smiles are sharp and perfectly courteous, and their spells burn in the dull red of a contract's seal.

grant.name: Fine Print
grant.text: When you read a contract, oath, treaty or other written agreement, you automatically notice any hidden clause, loophole or trick in its wording.

confluences.name: Inferno
confluences.theme: Fire at its most consuming
confluences.description: Fire distilled to its purest and hungriest, the blaze that devours everything it touches. Bearers run hot to the touch, their eyes glow like coals in the dark, and every spell they cast crackles and leaves scorch marks hanging on the air.

grant.name: Flame Sense
grant.text: You sense every fire within 300 feet of you, from a candle flame to a burning building, even through walls, and you know the direction and rough size of each one.

confluences.name: Inheritance
confluences.theme: Greedy heirs and contested fortunes
confluences.description: Inheritance is what passes down the bloodline with the family home: land, heirlooms, debts, and the greed of every cousin who wants a share. Bearers have an eye for silver spoons and old portraits, remember everyone's family tree, and their magic glints like a signet ring pressed into warm wax.

grant.name: Rightful Heir
grant.text: By handling an heirloom, piece of jewellery, deed or other object that has passed down a family for 1 minute, you learn the name of the family it belongs to and whether its rightful heir is still alive.

confluences.name: Jackdaw
confluences.theme: Chattering thief of shiny things
confluences.description: The jackdaw is the small, quick-eyed crow that chatters on the chimney pots and steals anything that glitters while everyone looks the other way. Bearers develop a pale grey ring around their eyes, a fondness for glittering trinkets and a chattering laugh, and their spells flash past in quick grey and black darts.

grant.name: Distraction
grant.text: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you can chatter, whistle or caper to distract one creature within 30 feet of you that can see or hear you. The next Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check made against that creature before the end of your next turn has advantage.

confluences.name: Jailbreak
confluences.theme: Tunnels, false walls and great escapes
confluences.description: The patient escape: the tunnel scratched out behind a loose stone and the dash for the wall at the change of the guard. Bearers can never sit long in a closed room without eyeing the exits, their fingertips are callused and scraped, and their magic leaves a fine grit on everything it touches.

grant.name: Spoon and Patience
grant.text: You can dig through earth, sand, gravel and crumbling mortar with your bare hands or any small improvised tool, such as a spoon or a belt buckle, as fast as a labourer with a pick and shovel.

confluences.name: Justice
confluences.theme: Law, judgement and the sworn sword
confluences.description: Justice is unbending resolve sworn to see wrongs judged and punished. Bearers stand straight and speak plainly, liars grow uneasy under their level gaze, and their spells fall like a judge's gavel, sharp and final.

grant.name: Letter of the Law
grant.text: After spending 1 hour in a settlement, you know its laws, who holds the authority to judge there, and the usual penalties for common crimes.

confluences.name: Karmic
confluences.theme: Every deed weighed and returned
confluences.description: Karmic is the world's ledger written in glyphs of power, where every deed is weighed and paid back in kind. Bearers feel a small, satisfied tug whenever a wrong is repaid, and their spells show as interlocking runes that tip like scales before they settle.

grant.name: Returned in Kind
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature you can see deals damage to you, you can use your reaction to mark it. The next attack roll or ability check you make against it before the end of your next turn has advantage.

confluences.name: Kelpie
confluences.theme: Shapeshifting water horse of lonely lochs
confluences.description: The kelpie is the wild loch-horse that wears a gentle shape and gallops its riders into the deep. Bearers keep a damp, weed-tangled mane of hair however long they sit by the fire, their footsteps ring like hooves on wet stone, and their spells drip and stream like a horse shaking off a river.

grant.name: Water Steed
grant.text: Any horse, pony, mule or similar mount you are riding can swim at a speed equal to its walking speed, and it never refuses to enter water or panics while swimming.

confluences.name: Kiln
confluences.theme: Clay baked hard by fire
confluences.description: Kiln is the patient heat that turns soft clay into brick and pottery that lasts a thousand years. A bearer's hands are always warm and dry and leave faint scorch marks on damp cloth, and their spells glow with the dull orange of a firing chamber.

grant.name: Firing Touch
grant.text: As an action, you can touch up to 1 cubic foot of wet clay, mud or mortar and bake it instantly as hard as fired brick or pottery, keeping whatever shape it had. The heat can't harm a creature or set anything else alight.

confluences.name: Kingfisher
confluences.theme: A bright flash over the river
confluences.description: Kingfisher is a streak of jewel colour above still water, the swift dive that ends with a catch. A bearer's hair and eyes take on a hint of iridescent blue and orange, they sit motionless before moving all at once, and their spells dart like a bird striking water.

grant.name: Clean Dive
grant.text: You take no damage from falling or diving into water at least 5 feet deep from a height of up to 100 feet, and you enter the water with no splash and barely a sound.

confluences.name: Kingpin
confluences.theme: The crime lord's iron grip
confluences.description: The kingpin rules the city's underside, where muscle, money and secrets all answer to one hand. Bearers dress well and speak softly, heavy rings gleam on their thick fingers, thugs make way for them without knowing why, and their magic arrives with a menacing calm.

grant.name: Underworld Ties
grant.text: In any town or city, you can find a fence, smuggler, forger or thug for hire within 1 hour of asking around, and you learn who runs the local criminal underworld.

confluences.name: Knight-Errant
confluences.theme: Wandering champion of a shining cause
confluences.description: The knight-errant rides the open roads in search of wrongs to right and worthy foes to face, honour carried at a gallop. A bearer sits tall even on foot, keeps their word to the letter, and their magic charges forward in bright, pennant-like streaks.

grant.name: Thrown Gauntlet
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can formally challenge a creature that can see and understand you to single combat. If it accepts, its allies don't attack you, and yours don't attack it, until one of you yields or falls, unless either side breaks the challenge first. A creature with no sense of honour can simply refuse.

confluences.name: Lamprey
confluences.theme: Jawless mouths that drink the living
confluences.description: The lamprey is the eel-like fish with a round sucking mouth ringed in teeth, which fastens onto larger fish and drinks from them as they swim. Bearers have a pale, slippery look and a faint ring of tiny pale scars around their lips, never seem thirsty, and their magic latches on in tight red rings.

grant.name: Blood Drinker
grant.text: You can slake your thirst on fresh blood. A pint of blood from a beast that you killed within the last hour counts as a full day's water for you, and drinking it never gives you a disease.

confluences.name: Landslide
confluences.theme: The mountainside on the move
confluences.description: Landslide is earth that has lost its patience all at once, rock and soil pouring downhill faster than anyone can run. A bearer moves in sudden lurching bursts after long stillness, small stones skitter away from their feet, and their magic arrives with the rattling roar of falling scree.

grant.name: Ride the Slide
grant.text: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against falling rocks, rockslides and cave-ins, and on ability checks made to keep your footing on scree, rubble or a crumbling ledge.

confluences.name: Leech
confluences.theme: The unfelt bite of the marsh
confluences.description: The leech is the patient bloodsucker of still and stagnant water, clinging so gently that its host never feels it feed. Bearers grow soft-handed, cool and faintly damp to the touch, and their magic latches on and drains slowly.

grant.name: Unfelt Bite
grant.text: You have advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to take an object from a creature's person, or to plant one on it, without it noticing.

confluences.name: Legerdemain
confluences.theme: Sleight of hand meets real sorcery
confluences.description: Legerdemain is quick hands touched with genuine magic, the trick in which the coin truly does vanish. A bearer's fingers are never still, small objects seem to flow across their knuckles, and their spells appear with a flourish and a snap.

grant.name: Sleeve Space
grant.text: As an action, you can make one nonmagical object weighing no more than 1 pound that you are holding vanish into a fold of space, and as an action you can draw it back out of thin air into your free hand. You can store only one object this way at a time, and it drops at your feet if you fall unconscious or die.

confluences.name: Lifeblood
confluences.theme: A strong heart with blood to spare
confluences.description: Vitality doubled and fed by the green strength of growing things: a heart that beats slow, deep and tireless. Bearers have ruddy cheeks and warm hands, regain their colour quickly after hardship, and their healing magic flows like a warm pulse.

grant.name: Share the Blood
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute touching a willing creature and expend one of your Hit Dice. Roll it: the creature regains hit points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).

confluences.name: Lifeline
confluences.theme: A rope thrown in hope
confluences.description: Lifeline is rescue at speed, the quick hands and true throw that pull someone back from the edge. A bearer keeps a coil of rope always within reach, ties flawless knots without looking, and their magic lashes out in bright, taut lines.

grant.name: Thrown Line
grant.text: You can throw a rope, chain or line so that its end lands exactly where you choose within 60 feet of you, and a willing creature there catches it automatically. You have advantage on Strength checks made to haul up or hold onto a creature on the other end of a rope you are holding.

confluences.name: Lighthouse
confluences.theme: A beam over black water
confluences.description: The lighthouse stands on the rocks through storm and night, one light warning ships away from death. Bearers keep a steady, watchful gaze, their eyes reflect a bright pinpoint in the dark, and their magic sweeps out in a turning beam.

grant.name: Safe Passage
grant.text: You have advantage on ability checks made to steer, pilot or navigate a boat or ship at night, in fog, or through rocks, reefs and shoals.

confluences.name: Lion
confluences.theme: Sun-maned hunter and king of beasts
confluences.description: The predator crowned by the sun, proud and golden, ruling its plain by right of tooth and claw. Bearers grow a heavy mane of tawny hair and love to doze in warm sunlight, and their magic blazes in gold and amber.

grant.name: King of Beasts
grant.text: You have advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks made to make a hostile or frightened beast back down, stop attacking or let you pass.

confluences.name: Locust
confluences.theme: Ravenous swarms riding the wind
confluences.description: Locust is greed given wings: the plenty of the fields stripped bare by a hungry cloud on the wind. A bearer's eyes take on a dry green-gold sheen, they are always nibbling something, and their spells arrive with a whirring rasp like a thousand wings.

grant.name: Strip the Fields
grant.text: You can safely eat grass, leaves, bark, straw and other tough raw plant matter, and 2 pounds of it counts as a full day's food for you.

confluences.name: Longship
confluences.theme: Fast oars, torches and the coastal raid
confluences.description: The longship is the lean raiding vessel that comes in fast on oar and sail, runs up the beach, burns the village and is gone before the alarm bells stop ringing. A bearer has salt-cracked lips and a rower's rolling stride, they keep time with their fingers without noticing, and their magic comes in hard and fast like a torch flung onto a thatched roof.

grant.name: Ramming Speed
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can call a hard rowing beat for up to 1 hour. A rowing boat, longship or galley you are aboard that is rowed to your beat moves at twice its normal speed for the duration, and its rowers don't tire from the effort.

confluences.name: Lure
confluences.theme: False light in deep water
confluences.description: Lure is deceit that glows, the dangling light of the deep that draws curious things toward hungry jaws. A bearer's fingertips glimmer faintly in the dark, they are as patient as any fisher, and their spells bob and beckon before they strike.

grant.name: Lure Light
grant.text: As an action, you can make a soft light glow at your fingertip or at a point you can see within 30 feet of you for up to 10 minutes, shedding dim light in a 5-foot radius. Fish and other beasts with an Intelligence of 2 or lower that see it, aren't hostile to you and aren't in combat drift toward it out of curiosity and linger near it while it lasts, unless they are frightened or harmed.

confluences.name: Lycan
confluences.theme: The beast waiting beneath human skin
confluences.description: A predator's blood bent by transforming magic into the old curse and gift of the shapechanger. Bearers grow coarse body hair and dark, hard nails, turn restless under a full moon, and their spells flicker with the shapes of jaws and claws.

grant.name: Half-Shift
grant.text: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you can let your face lengthen toward a muzzle for 10 minutes. For the duration, you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track creatures by scent.

confluences.name: Magpie
confluences.theme: Quick thieving eye for treasure
confluences.description: Magpie is greed with quick wings, the bright-eyed thief that can't resist anything that glints. A bearer's eyes flick to every shiny thing in a room, their pockets fill with buttons and rings, and their spells flash with a sharp black-and-white shimmer.

grant.name: Glitter Eye
grant.text: By looking over a room, a pile of loot or a merchant's stall for 1 minute, you know which single object in it is the most valuable, though not exactly what it is worth.

confluences.name: Mammoth
confluences.theme: Shaggy giant out of the deep past
confluences.description: A great beast out of deep time, patient, enduring and impossible to stop once it moves. Bearers grow broad-shouldered and heavy and walk with a slow rolling gait, and their magic lands with a deep weight that makes the ground hum.

grant.name: Long Memory
grant.text: You never forget a face you have seen or a voice you have heard, and you can retrace any route you have travelled on foot within the last year without getting lost.

confluences.name: Mangrove
confluences.theme: Roots that hold back the tide
confluences.description: Mangrove is the tangled coastal forest that stands firm against waves and storm surges, sheltering fish and birds among its roots. A bearer's toes grip the ground like roots, their skin carries a faint briny smell, and their spells arrive as a web of twisting roots and a slap of seawater.

grant.name: Root Bridge
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute coaxing the roots, branches or reeds of living plants at the water's edge to knot together into a rough bridge up to 20 feet long and 3 feet wide across water, mud or a gap. It holds up to 1,000 pounds and unravels after 1 hour.

confluences.name: Manhunt
confluences.theme: The hue and cry after a wrongdoer
confluences.description: The manhunt is justice given a voice, the shout of 'stop, thief' that sets a whole town running after a culprit like hounds after a scent. Bearers have voices that cut through any crowd and a habit of marking faces, and their magic rings out like an alarm bell.

grant.name: Raise the Hue
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you see a creature commit a crime, you can shout out against it. For the next 10 minutes, commoners who heard you and aren't that creature's friends or allies try to block, follow or point it out, and afterwards they tell you truthfully which way it went. They won't fight it unless it attacks them.

confluences.name: Mariner
confluences.theme: Salt, rope and the open sea
confluences.description: Mariner is the sailor's whole craft distilled into one essence: knotted rope, salt wind and endless water. Bearers walk with a rolling gait on dry land, their skin weathers to sun-browned leather, and their spells snap and billow like canvas catching a gale.

grant.name: Sea-Taster
grant.text: By tasting seawater, you learn the direction and rough distance to the nearest coast, and whether a reef, sandbar or shoal lies within 1 mile of you.

confluences.name: Marksman
confluences.theme: Patient aim and the distant mark
confluences.description: Marksman is the patient eye fused with the long wait for the perfect shot. Bearers have a habitual squint and an unnervingly steady breath, they judge distances without thinking, and their spells fly straight and true like a shaft loosed in still air.

grant.name: Second Shot
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you miss with a ranged weapon attack, you can reroll the attack roll. You must use the new roll.

confluences.name: Martyr
confluences.theme: Bearing others' pain as one's own
confluences.description: Martyr is grief and mercy fused into the will to suffer so that others need not. Bearers' faces grow calm and a little careworn, other people's bruises sometimes bloom faintly on their own skin, and their spells glow with a soft, sorrowful rose light.

grant.name: Take Their Pain
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can touch a willing creature and take one condition from it onto yourself: blinded, deafened, frightened or poisoned. The condition ends on that creature and affects you for its remaining duration.

confluences.name: Meadow
confluences.theme: Sunlit grass and wildflowers on good earth
confluences.description: The meadow is rich soil turned golden and green under the summer sun, humming with bees and thick with flowers. A bearer's hair takes on a golden tinge, they turn their face toward the sun without thinking, and their magic opens like petals catching the morning light.

grant.name: Good Earth
grant.text: By touching soil for 1 minute, you learn whether it is fertile, salted, poisoned, blighted or cursed, and which crops or wild plants would grow best in it.

confluences.name: Menagerie
confluences.theme: Kinship with every kind of beast
confluences.description: Menagerie is the wild many gathered into one: fang, feather, hoof and fur. Bearers' features take on hints of different beasts from day to day, animals watch them with curious recognition, and their spells take the ghostly shapes of running, flying and prowling creatures.

grant.name: Beast Tongue
grant.text: You can convey and understand simple ideas, such as danger, food, friend, follow or go away, with any beast through sounds, posture and gesture.

confluences.name: Menhir
confluences.theme: Runed standing stones that hum in wind
confluences.description: The ancient standing stone, carved with runes and singing faintly whenever the wind passes over it. Bearers develop pale grey markings like weathered runes on their skin, and their spells come with a low hum, like wind across the lip of a stone.

grant.name: Speaking Stone
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a stone no smaller than your fist and speak a message of up to 25 words into it. The next time a creature other than you touches the stone within the next 10 days, the stone repeats the message aloud once in your voice, then falls silent. You can have only one speaking stone at a time.

confluences.name: Mercenary
confluences.theme: A sword for sale to anyone
confluences.description: The mercenary fights for whoever pays best, blade and bargain fused into a single trade. Bearers count coins without looking and keep their gear well oiled but plain, and their magic flares with the dull gleam of gold on steel.

grant.name: Sellsword
grant.text: Within 1 hour of arriving in a settlement, you learn who there is hiring guards, escorts or soldiers and what they pay. When you spend downtime working as a guard, bodyguard or soldier, you earn twice the normal wage.

confluences.name: Merrow
confluences.theme: Sea-folk blood in coastal families
confluences.description: The merrow is the sea-maiden of the old coastal bloodlines, kin by blood to fishing families and by magic to the deep, who pulls drowning sailors from the waves. Bearers have green-tinged hair that always looks damp, salt-grey eyes and a faint web between their fingers, and their magic rises like a swell lifting a body to the surface.

grant.name: Breath of the Deep
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a creature that is drowning or suffocating and draw the water, smoke or dust from its lungs. It can breathe normally again at once, and if it has 0 hit points, it becomes stable.

confluences.name: Meteor
confluences.theme: A falling star's blazing streak
confluences.description: The shooting star that tears across the night in a blaze of light and is gone before the wish is finished. Bearers move in sudden bursts and are never still for long, and their magic leaves a fading streak of white-gold light behind it.

grant.name: Streak
grant.text: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you can dart up to 10 feet in a straight line, leaving a trail of harmless sparks. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

confluences.name: Miasma
confluences.theme: Foul vapours rising from deep places
confluences.description: The bad air of mines, sewers and sunken marshes, where greed digs too deep and vermin thrive. Bearers have a sharp, wrinkling nose and a sallow cast to their skin, and their magic leaves a faint yellow, sulphurous haze.

grant.name: Foul Breath
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can exhale a sickly yellow vapour that fills a 10-foot cube next to you, then disperses at the end of your turn. Each creature in it that needs to breathe must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

confluences.name: Minotaur
confluences.theme: The bull-headed brute of the maze
confluences.description: Beast strength penned in stone corridors: horned, furious and impossible to hold back. Bearers grow thick necks and heavy brows and snort when angry, and their magic charges in straight lines like a bull down a passage.

grant.name: Battering Brow
grant.text: You have advantage on Strength checks made to break down doors, gates, barricades and walls.

confluences.name: Miser
confluences.theme: Buried coin and the jealous heart
confluences.description: The miser who buries gold under the floorboards and digs it up at night to count it. Bearers have dirt under their nails however often they wash, count things under their breath, and their magic glints dully, like coins in fresh soil.

grant.name: Penny Pincher
grant.text: You always know exactly how much money you are carrying, and you feel it at once if anyone takes even a single coin from your purse, pockets or pack.

confluences.name: Missive
confluences.theme: Written words that fly on the wind
confluences.description: The missive is the letter that writes itself into the sky, swift magic carried on the wind to someone far away. Scraps of paper flutter around the bearer even indoors, their fingers are always inked, and their spells leave trails of glowing script that blow away like leaves.

grant.name: Paper Bird
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute writing a message of up to 25 words on a scrap of paper and folding it into a bird while naming a creature you have met. The bird flies at a speed of 60 feet to that creature, lands in its hand and unfolds into an ordinary letter. If the creature isn't within 1 mile of you, the bird crumbles to ash instead.

confluences.name: Monolith
confluences.theme: Ancient carved stone that never changes
confluences.description: Monolith is the rune-carved standing stone that has stood on the hill since before memory, holding its shape against wind, rain and every spell thrown at it. A bearer grows still and deliberate, faint grey glyphs surface on their skin when they concentrate, and their magic hums like a struck stone.

grant.name: Unchanging
grant.text: You have advantage on saving throws against being petrified, against effects that would change your shape, such as polymorph, and against magic that would alter or erase your memories.

confluences.name: Monsoon
confluences.theme: The rains that wake the land
confluences.description: Monsoon is the seasonal deluge that ends the dry months and makes everything grow at once. A bearer always smells of wet earth before a storm, their hair curls in damp air, and their magic falls in warm, heavy drops.

grant.name: Call the Rains
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can call down a warm, steady rain in a 30-foot radius centred on a point you can see within 60 feet of you. It falls for 10 minutes, puts out unprotected flames such as candles, torches and campfires, fills open containers and waters plants, and has no other effect.

confluences.name: Moonlight
confluences.theme: Silver light that reveals secrets
confluences.description: Moonlight is light borrowed in the darkness, silver and cool, showing what daylight misses. Bearers' skin takes on a pale lustre at night, their hair silvers at the ends, and their magic washes over things in a soft, revealing glow.

grant.name: Moon Letters
grant.text: Light that you shed or carry, such as a torch, a lantern or a light spell, reveals writing, marks and symbols within 10 feet that were made invisible by invisible ink or by magic, so you can read them for as long as the light falls on them. This doesn't reveal magical traps such as a glyph of warding.

confluences.name: Moth
confluences.theme: Night wings drawn to the flame
confluences.description: The moth flits through the dark, restless and quick, always pulled toward the light. Bearers have soft, dusty-looking hair and large dark eyes, they fidget near candles, and their magic scatters like powder from beating wings.

grant.name: Drawn to Light
grant.text: You can sense the direction of every flame and other source of light within 300 feet of you, even through walls or around corners, though not exactly how far away each one is.

confluences.name: Motherlode
confluences.theme: Greed for the riches underground
confluences.description: Motherlode is the gleaming seam of gold or silver that drives prospectors mad with longing. A bearer's eyes linger on every rock face, they can't resist pocketing pretty pebbles, and their magic sparkles with flecks of ore.

grant.name: Stone Purse
grant.text: As an action, you can press up to 100 coins, gems or pieces of jewellery into bare natural rock you touch, where they sink out of sight without leaving a mark. Only you can draw them back out, as an action, by touching the same spot. Breaking the rock apart exposes them. You can have only one such cache at a time.

confluences.name: Mudlark
confluences.theme: Scavenging riverbanks at low tide
confluences.description: The mudlark wades the stinking river mud when the tide goes out, picking lost coins, nails and rings from the silt. Bearers always have a little mud on their boots and under their nails and can't help glancing at the ground, and their spells ooze and gleam like wet silt.

grant.name: Low Tide Pickings
grant.text: Once per day, when you spend 1 hour searching a riverbank, shoreline, harbour or sewer outflow, you find either 1d10 silver pieces' worth of coins and scrap or one mundane item of your choice worth no more than 1 gp.

confluences.name: Mycelium
confluences.theme: The hidden web that feeds on death
confluences.description: Mycelium is the pale web beneath the forest floor that turns the dead back into living soil. Bearers smell of damp earth and mushrooms, fine white threads show beneath their fingernails, and their spells leave small rings of toadstools behind.

grant.name: Return to Soil
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a corpse or a heap of dead plant matter no larger than Medium and set fungus to work on it. Over the next hour it rots away into rich, crumbly soil, leaving only metal, stone and other inorganic objects behind. This has no effect on undead or on remains protected by magic.

confluences.name: Mystic
confluences.theme: Inner discipline and flowing power
