confluences.description: Mystic is the discipline of body and spirit brought into one flowing current. Bearers breathe slowly and move with unhurried grace, and their spells unfold from a single still point, like ripples spreading across a pond.

grant.name: Inner Stillness
grant.text: Once per long rest, at the start of your turn, you can end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.

confluences.name: Naiad
confluences.theme: Spirit of springs, streams and lilies
confluences.description: The naiad is the bright spirit that lives in a spring or stream, dancing over the lily pads and keeping the water sweet and full of life. A bearer has large, dark, liquid eyes and sleek hair that always looks damp, they step lightly as if the ground might give way, and their spells ripple outward like rings on a still pond.

grant.name: Lily Step
grant.text: Once per short rest, when you move on your turn, you can cross up to 30 feet of calm water as if it were solid ground. If you are still on the water at the end of your turn, you sink.

confluences.name: Nightjar
confluences.theme: The ground bird with the hidden voice
confluences.description: The nightjar is the mottled bird that nests on bare earth among stones and heather, invisible by day, and fills the night with a churring song no one can find the source of. Bearers have bark-brown freckles and wide, dark eyes, they sit very still on the ground when they are thinking, and their magic purrs and whirs from somewhere just out of sight.

grant.name: Thrown Voice
grant.text: You can make your voice, or any other sound you could make yourself, seem to come from a point you can see within 30 feet of you. A creature that hears it can tell where the sound really comes from only with a successful Wisdom check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

confluences.name: Nightmare
confluences.theme: Terrors that ride the sleeping
confluences.description: The nightmare is the dread that comes with sleep, a dark dream sent to sit on the sleeper's chest until dawn. Bearers have shadowed eyes and rarely remember their own dreams, and their magic flickers with half-glimpsed shapes that vanish when looked at directly.

grant.name: Plant a Dread
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can whisper to a sleeping creature for 1 minute without waking it, shaping its dreams into a nightmare about one person, place or thing you name. When it wakes, it feels a strong, unreasoning dread of that subject until it finishes its next long rest, and it avoids that subject if it easily can.

confluences.name: Nightshade
confluences.theme: Deadly blooms of the night garden
confluences.description: Nightshade is the dark berry and the drooping purple flower, life that grows in shadow and soothes or kills depending on the dose. Bearers turn pale with wide, dark pupils and keep dried berries in their pockets, and their magic smells sweet and faintly sickly.

grant.name: Sleeping Draught
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes preparing a sleeping draught from wild plants and berries. A creature that drinks it, or eats or drinks something it is mixed into, must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier) or fall unconscious for 1 hour. It wakes if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake. The draught loses its potency after 24 hours.

confluences.name: Nix
confluences.theme: The river spirit that claims its due
confluences.description: The nix is the spirit of dark millponds and deep river bends, which old folk say must be paid one drowned life a year. Bearers' hair always looks damp and tangled with weed, they smell faintly of cold river water, and their magic swirls in murky green-black eddies.

grant.name: Muddy the Water
grant.text: As an action, you can make a 10-foot cube of water within 30 feet of you murky and opaque, or make murky water in such a cube clear. The change lasts for 1 hour.

confluences.name: Oak
confluences.theme: Mighty strength of the ancient tree
confluences.description: Oak is strength that grows slowly and holds forever, the great tree that shelters the village and bears the weight of centuries. A bearer has thick, sturdy limbs, rough knots of muscle across their shoulders and a deep, unhurried voice, and their spells land with the creak and weight of a falling trunk.

grant.name: Bear the Load
grant.text: You have advantage on Strength checks made to lift, hold up or brace something heavy, such as a portcullis, a fallen tree, a stuck cart or a collapsing beam.

confluences.name: Ocean
confluences.theme: The deep, endless sea itself
confluences.description: The ocean is water at its vastest, tides, depths and salt without end. Bearers carry the sound of distant surf in their breathing and their eyes shift between green, grey and blue with the weather, and their spells roll out in slow, heavy swells.

grant.name: Still the Waves
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can calm natural water within 100 feet of you for 10 minutes. Waves flatten, currents slow and rough water becomes calm water for swimming and steering boats.

confluences.name: Ogre
confluences.theme: Brutish strength and endless appetite
confluences.description: Ogre is greed and gluttony backed by a big fist, the brute who eats a village's harvest and comes back for more. A bearer is always hungry, eats loudly and grows heavier in the jaw and shoulders, and their magic thuds into place like a club on a tavern table.

grant.name: Shakedown
grant.text: You have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made to make a creature hand over food, drink, coin or goods to you.

confluences.name: Oracle
confluences.theme: Seeing the shape of what comes
confluences.description: Oracle is the seer's gift, where portents, night watches and patient sight join into a glimpse of what is to come. Bearers' eyes take on a distant, milky sheen when they concentrate, and their spells leave fleeting images of moments that have not happened yet.

grant.name: Augury
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute reading smoke, birds or scattered bones and ask about a specific course of action you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The DM tells you whether it is likely to bring good results, bad results, both, or neither.

confluences.name: Orca
confluences.theme: The pod hunter of cold seas
confluences.description: The orca is the strongest hunter in the sea, a killer that hunts in family pods calling to one another across the cold dark. Bearers grow broad-shouldered and sleek with stark black and white patches in their hair, and their magic surges in heavy, rolling waves.

grant.name: Pod Call
grant.text: While you are underwater, you can speak as clearly as you can on land, and creatures of your choice within 120 feet of you that share a language with you hear and understand you.

confluences.name: Ordeal
confluences.theme: Trial by fire and water
confluences.description: The ordeal is the old judgement by hot iron and cold water, where the accused carried a burning bar or was plunged into the river so that the truth would show itself. Bearers have steady, scarred hands and an unflinching stare, and their magic glows like iron drawn red from the coals and hisses like it meeting water.

grant.name: Unflinching
grant.text: You have advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to endure pain without crying out, letting go or giving in, such as gripping a burning brand, holding on through a wound or resisting torture.

confluences.name: Otter
confluences.theme: Playful, slippery swimmer of rivers
confluences.description: The otter is quickness in water, a sleek, playful hunter that twists out of any grip. Bearers grow lithe and supple and their hair sheds water the moment they leave a river, and their spells slide and tumble like an otter down a mudbank.

grant.name: Otter's Twist
grant.text: While you are wet or standing in water, you have advantage on ability checks made to escape a grapple, a net or bonds.

confluences.name: Outrider
confluences.theme: Scouting ahead of armies by night
confluences.description: The outrider rides ahead of the army in the dark, counting enemy campfires and slipping back with word before dawn. Bearers are lean, saddle-weathered and alert, and their magic darts out and returns like a scout's signal.

grant.name: Count the Fires
grant.text: You have advantage on ability checks made to judge an army, warband, caravan or raiding party from its camp or its tracks, such as how many there are, how they are armed and mounted, how long ago they passed and where they were heading.

confluences.name: Ox
confluences.theme: Patient strength that turns the furrow
confluences.description: Ox is the great draught beast that pulls the plough from dawn to dusk, slow, gentle and immensely strong. A bearer thickens through the neck and shoulders, grows calm and unhurried, and their magic plods forward with a heavy, steady weight.

grant.name: Draught Strength
grant.text: You can pull a cart, sledge or plough as well as a draft horse can, and you can spend up to 12 hours a day hauling, digging or ploughing without risking exhaustion from the labour.

confluences.name: Pathfinder
confluences.theme: Glowing signs along the road
confluences.description: Pathfinder is guiding magic set to the open road, the traveller who marks the way so others can follow. A bearer's fingertips glow faintly when they point, they never stay put for long, and their spells leave a short-lived trail of bright sigils.

grant.name: Trail Sigils
grant.text: You can start or stop leaving a trail of small glowing sigils on the ground, walls and trees you pass, with no action required. Each sigil lasts 24 hours and is visible only to you and up to six creatures you chose when you started the trail.

confluences.name: Peacock
confluences.theme: Pride in a dazzling display
confluences.description: The peacock is vanity given wings: the shrieking bird that spreads a fan of glittering eyes to be admired. Bearers dress to be looked at, their hair gains a blue-green sheen, and their magic opens in a shimmering fan of iridescent light.

grant.name: Dazzling Display
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can flare your cloak, fan or plumage in a dazzling display. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier or be fascinated until the end of its next turn: it can't take reactions and has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

confluences.name: Pelican
confluences.theme: Feeding the brood from one's own heart
confluences.description: In old heraldry the pelican wounds its own breast to feed its young on its blood beside the water, the image of mercy that gives until it hurts. Bearers are protective and generous to a fault, often bear a small red mark over the heart, and their magic flows like warm, clear water.

grant.name: Heart's Feast
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can let a few drops of your blood fall into the mouth or the cup of water of another creature. That creature counts as having eaten and drunk a full day's food and water.

confluences.name: Peregrine
confluences.theme: The stooping falcon's blinding dive
confluences.description: The peregrine is the fastest hunter under the sky, a wandering falcon that folds its wings and plunges to snatch prey out of the air. Bearers have sharp eyes and quicker hands, and their magic falls on its target like a stooping bird.

grant.name: Talon Catch
grant.text: Once per short rest, when a nonmagical object that no one is holding falls or is tossed within 5 feet of you, such as a dropped key or a falling potion, you can use your reaction to catch it if you have a hand free. You can't catch an object that is part of an attack, such as an arrow or a thrown weapon.

confluences.name: Pestilence
confluences.theme: Plague, vermin and creeping rot
confluences.description: Pestilence is decay and teeming vermin fused into the contagion that empties cities. Bearers take on a sallow cast and a faint sweet smell of rot, flies drift lazily around them, and their spells spread in greenish, buzzing clouds.

grant.name: Carrier
grant.text: You can tell by sight whether a creature within 30 feet of you carries a disease. Once per long rest, by touching a sick or poisoned creature, you learn what the disease or poison is, how it spreads, and roughly where or when it was caught.

confluences.name: Phantasm
confluences.theme: Illusions, doubles and false sights
confluences.description: Phantasm is light bent into things that are not there. Bearers always seem slightly out of focus at the edge of vision, and their spells are trailed by shimmering doubles that fade a heartbeat after the real thing.

grant.name: Phantom Double
grant.text: Once per short rest, as an action, you can create a motionless, silent illusion of yourself in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you. It lasts for 10 minutes or until a creature touches it. A creature that studies it can tell it is false with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

confluences.name: Philtre
confluences.theme: Sweet potions of stolen hearts
confluences.description: The philtre is the love potion of village wise women and court poisoners alike, brewed from honey, petals and a hair of the one who wants to be loved. Bearers' voices are warm and coaxing, they smell faintly of roses and honey, and their spells shimmer with a sweet, rosy glow like wine held up to candlelight.

grant.name: Love Philtre
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes brewing a sweet-scented philtre from flowers, honey and a hair of your own. A humanoid that drinks the whole dose within the next 8 hours must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier or be charmed by you for 1 hour. The effect ends early if you or your companions harm it, and when it ends, the creature knows it was enchanted.

confluences.name: Piper
confluences.theme: Enchanted tunes that lead vermin
confluences.description: Piper is a bewitching melody carried on the wind, the trickster whose tune leads rats and worse wherever it pleases. A bearer whistles constantly without noticing, rats and mice pause to watch them pass, and their spells sound a thin, haunting note.

grant.name: Vermin Tune
grant.text: As an action, you can begin playing a tune on a pipe, whistle or other wind instrument, or by whistling. For as long as you keep playing, up to 10 minutes, rats, mice, roaches and other Tiny vermin within 60 feet of you that hear it stop what they are doing and follow you at a distance. They don't fight for you or obey other commands, and swarms aren't affected.

confluences.name: Pit Fighter
confluences.theme: Blood, sawdust and wagers in the pit
confluences.description: The pit fighter bleeds in a ring of packed earth for the coin of a shouting, betting crowd, and wins any way they can. Bearers carry knotted scars and grit under their nails, they size up every opponent's purse as well as their reach, and their magic kicks up a spray of dust and sawdust.

grant.name: Dirt in the Eyes
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can fling a handful of dirt, sand or grit at a creature within 5 feet of you that has eyes. It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier or be blinded until the start of your next turn.

confluences.name: Poacher
confluences.theme: Snares set on a lord's land
confluences.description: Poacher is the quick-fingered thief of the forest, taking game from lands that others claim as theirs. A bearer moves lightly through woodland with pockets full of cord and wire, always keeps one ear open for the gamekeeper, and their spells snap shut like a well-set snare.

grant.name: Full Pot
grant.text: You can set a working snare from a few feet of cord in 1 minute. If you spend 1 hour setting snares before a long rest in the wild, by morning you have caught enough small game to feed yourself and one other creature for a day.

confluences.name: Prairie
confluences.theme: Endless grass bending in the wind
confluences.description: Prairie is the wide grassland where the wind runs in waves across the grass from one horizon to the other. A bearer's skin weathers to a sun-browned tan, they feel cramped indoors, and their magic ripples outward like wind through a field of grain.

grant.name: Grass Reader
grant.text: You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track creatures across grassland, farmland, scrub or moor, and when you find such tracks you know roughly how many hours ago they were made.

confluences.name: Prosperity
confluences.theme: Thriving, sheltered and well-tended life
confluences.description: Prosperity is life growing safely behind strong walls: fields green, wounds mended and households flourishing. Bearers have a healthy, well-fed glow, plants and animals thrive in their care, and their spells shine with the gold-green light of a ripening field.

grant.name: Flourish
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you regains hit points, you can use your reaction to increase the hit points it regains by your proficiency bonus.

confluences.name: Pyre
confluences.theme: Cleansing fire that ends and begins
confluences.description: Pyre is the funeral flame that consumes what has ended so that something new can begin. Bearers smell of cedar smoke and ash, their gaze is steady and solemn, and their spells burn white at the heart and leave clean ash behind.

grant.name: Purging Flame
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can burn a poison or sickness out of your body. You take 1d4 fire damage, which can't be reduced in any way, and you end either the poisoned condition or one disease affecting you.

confluences.name: Pyromancer
confluences.theme: Fire studied and commanded like language
confluences.description: The arcane mastery of flame, where fire is studied, written and commanded like a language. Bearers have soot-darkened fingertips and smell of struck flint, and sigils of glowing ember trace themselves in the air whenever they cast.

grant.name: Fire Script
grant.text: As an action, you can trace burning letters or symbols in the air with your fingertip. Up to 25 words hang where you wrote them for up to 1 minute, shedding dim light in a 5-foot radius, then crumble into harmless smoke. They can't ignite anything.

confluences.name: Quartz
confluences.theme: Clear crystal grown in plain stone
confluences.description: Quartz is the clear rock crystal that grows in the cracks of dull grey stone, letting light pass straight through solid rock. A bearer looks ordinary until the light catches them, when their eyes glint like cut crystal, and their magic breaks out of plain stone in clear, glassy shards.

grant.name: Stone Window
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can touch a stone wall, floor or door no more than 1 foot thick and make a patch of it up to 1 foot across as clear as crystal for 1 minute. Light and sight pass through the patch in both directions, but it stays as solid as stone.

confluences.name: Quickening
confluences.theme: Sudden hope and swift recovery
confluences.description: Quickening is the first stir of new life and the rush of strength that returns to a body that refuses to give up. A bearer's cuts and bruises fade a little faster than they should, they spring out of sleep wide awake, and their spells pulse with a bright rhythm like a racing heartbeat.

grant.name: Rally
grant.text: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can spend one of your Hit Dice to regain hit points as if you had spent it during a short rest.

confluences.name: Rainbow
confluences.theme: Bright promise after the storm
confluences.description: Rainbow is sunlight meeting rain in the open sky, the sign that the worst of the storm is over. A bearer's hair and eyes show a faint shifting sheen of colour after rain, they lift the mood of anyone near them, and their magic arcs in bands of soft colour.

grant.name: After the Storm
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you finish a short rest, you and up to five creatures that rested with you each gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. They last until you finish a long rest.

confluences.name: Rainmaker
confluences.theme: Calling rain from an empty sky
confluences.description: The rainmaker coaxes water out of the wind with chant and drum, and can turn a downpour aside as easily as call it. Bearers smell of wet earth before a storm, clouds seem to drift after them, and their spells come with a fine, cool mist that beads on skin and steel.

grant.name: Dry Circle
grant.text: Rain, sleet, snow and spray part around you: they never fall on you or on anything within 5 feet of you unless you allow it, so you and those beside you can stay dry, keep a fire lit or read a map in the worst downpour.

confluences.name: Ram
confluences.theme: Horn, momentum and the shattered gate
confluences.description: The mountain ram and the battering ram alike, all hard skull and headlong weight. Bearers carry themselves head down and shoulders forward, their brows grow heavy, and their magic lands with a dull thud like a beam meeting a gate.

grant.name: Barge Through
grant.text: Once per short rest, after you have moved at least 10 feet in a straight line on your turn, you can barge through the space of one hostile creature that is your size or smaller and carry on moving. Moving through its space this way doesn't cost you extra movement.

confluences.name: Rampart
confluences.theme: Earthworks raised to hold the line
confluences.description: Rampart is the bank of packed earth and stone that soldiers throw up overnight to hold a line against a siege. A bearer is broad in the shoulders and calloused in the palms, they size up every field for where to dig in, and their magic rises around them like a wall of churned soil.

grant.name: Dig In
grant.text: Using a shovel, a pick or your bare hands, you can dig a trench or raise a chest-high bank of earth 10 feet long in 10 minutes, provided the ground is soft enough to dig. Alone, you work as fast as a crew of six labourers.

confluences.name: Rapids
confluences.theme: White water racing over rocks
confluences.description: The roaring stretch of river where water tears over stone faster than any boat can steer. Bearers move in sudden, sure bursts, their eyes take on the grey-green of churning water, and their magic arrives with a rushing sound like a weir.

grant.name: Read the River
grant.text: By watching a stretch of river or stream for 1 minute, you learn the safest place to cross it and the safest route to navigate it, and where any hidden rocks, snags, falls and whirlpools lie within 300 feet of you.

confluences.name: Raven
confluences.theme: Black wings carrying omens
confluences.description: The raven is the dark bird of omens and secrets, a messenger between the open sky and hidden things. Bearers have glossy black hair with a blue sheen, a sharp sidelong gaze and a fondness for shiny trinkets, and their magic flies from them in shadowy feathers.

grant.name: Raven's Eye
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can call a crow or raven, if one is within 1 mile of you; it arrives within a few minutes. For up to 1 minute after it arrives, you can see through its eyes and direct where it flies, as long as it stays within 300 feet of you. While you do, you can't see your own surroundings.

confluences.name: Reaver
confluences.theme: Sea raiders hungry for plunder
confluences.description: The reaver comes over the grey water to burn, loot and row home heavy with plunder. Bearers grow thick-armed and salt-weathered and can't pass a fine thing without weighing it in their hand, and their spells come with the smell of tar and the splash of oars.

grant.name: Muffled Oars
grant.text: Any boat you row or steer moves in silence: its oars, hull and rigging make no sound, though voices and other noises aboard carry as normal.

confluences.name: Reef
confluences.theme: Living coral sheltering the sea's young
confluences.description: Reef is the teeming garden of the shallow sea, a living wall where countless small things are sheltered and mended. A bearer's skin carries faint coral-pink and turquoise mottling, tiny shells catch in their hair, and their spells shimmer like sunlight through clear water full of darting fish.

grant.name: Nursery Waters
grant.text: When you spend Hit Dice to regain hit points during a short rest while you are at least waist-deep in natural sea, lake or river water, you regain additional hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

confluences.name: Refuge
confluences.theme: Safe haven for the hunted and hurt
confluences.description: Refuge is the open door and the strong arm that carries the wounded out of harm's way, hope given the strength to protect. A bearer has a calm, steady presence that settles frightened children, they always know where the nearest shelter is, and their magic glows with a warm light like a lit window on a cold night.

grant.name: Carry the Fallen
grant.text: You can move at your full speed while carrying or dragging a creature of your size or smaller that is unconscious or willing.

confluences.name: Revelry
confluences.theme: Feasting, laughter and the long night
confluences.description: Revelry is the feast, the joke and the overflowing cup joined in one glad roar. Bearers laugh easily and loudly and are never short of a drinking partner, and their spells crackle with the warm colours of festival lanterns.

grant.name: Tavern Talk
grant.text: Once per long rest, after spending at least 1 hour drinking, dancing or swapping stories with locals in a tavern, market or festival, you learn one true and useful rumour about the area.

confluences.name: Riot
confluences.theme: Mob fury and burning streets
confluences.description: Envy and hunger set alight: the crowd that becomes a mob, and the mob that tears down what it cannot have. Bearers grow loud and quick to anger and their voices carry over any crowd, and their magic spreads like torches passed from hand to hand.

grant.name: Boiling Point
grant.text: By watching a crowd for 1 minute, you know how close it is to turning violent, what would most likely set it off, and who its loudest voices are.

confluences.name: Riptide
confluences.theme: Hidden currents that pull seaward
confluences.description: The riptide is the fast, hidden current that drags swimmers out to sea while the surface looks calm. Bearers have restless, sea-grey eyes and a pull to their presence that draws people in, and their spells streak outward and snap back like a wave drawing off the sand.

grant.name: Go With the Flow
grant.text: While you swim or float with a current, tide or river flow, you move at twice your swimming speed and never tire from swimming.

confluences.name: Robber Baron
confluences.theme: Stone keeps that bleed travellers dry
confluences.description: The robber baron rules from a stone keep above the river or the pass, taking tolls by force and holding travellers for ransom. Bearers carry themselves like lords of their own little hill, eye every passer-by as a source of income, and their magic falls into place like a portcullis slamming shut.

grant.name: Ransom Price
grant.text: By talking with a humanoid for 1 minute, you learn roughly how much ransom its family, lord, guild or comrades would pay to get it back alive, and who would most likely pay it.

confluences.name: Roc
confluences.theme: Giant raptor of the high crags
confluences.description: A bird of prey so vast it nests on mountain peaks and carries off oxen: the hunger of the sky anchored in stone. Bearers develop hooked, powerful fingers and a fierce grip and love high, windy places, and their magic sweeps down like the shadow of enormous wings.

grant.name: Great Talons
grant.text: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag or lift.

confluences.name: Rumour
confluences.theme: Whispers that spread on the wind
confluences.description: Rumour is the whisper that flies from ear to ear, growing with every telling until no one remembers where it began. Bearers speak softly and love to lean in close, their words seem to echo faintly after they stop, and their spells hiss like many voices murmuring at once.

grant.name: Word Gets Around
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can whisper a rumour of no more than one sentence to a creature in a settlement no larger than a town. Within 24 hours, most people there have heard it, though nobody remembers who said it first. Hearing it doesn't make anyone believe it.

confluences.name: Runeblade
confluences.theme: Steel carved with living runes
confluences.description: Runeblade is war made arcane, the weapon and its wielder bound together by marks of power. A bearer's weapons hum faintly in their grip, matching runes rise on their skin in battle, and their magic flares along edges and blades.

grant.name: Bound Blade
grant.text: During a long rest, you can carve your rune into one weapon, ending the bond with any weapon you bound before. You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid being disarmed of that weapon, and while it is out of your possession, you know its direction and distance as long as it is within 1 mile of you.

confluences.name: Sacred Spring
confluences.theme: Clear water rising from holy ground
confluences.description: The sacred spring bubbles up clear and cold from the rock where pilgrims leave ribbons and bathe away their fears. Bearers have a calm, rinsed look, as if they had just washed in cold water, people feel steadier in their company, and their magic wells up in clear, sparkling ripples.

grant.name: Spring Bathing
grant.text: Once per long rest, after you bathe for 10 minutes in a natural spring, stream or lake, you have advantage on the next saving throw you make against being charmed or frightened before you finish your next long rest.

confluences.name: Sage
confluences.theme: Learning, letters and patient study
confluences.description: Sage is the scholar's lifelong devotion to the written word and everything it preserves. Bearers squint from long nights of reading, ink and dust gather on their sleeves, and their spells form in the air as lines of glowing script.

grant.name: Scholar's Eye
grant.text: When you see writing you can't read, you know what language and script it is in, roughly how old it is, and its general purpose, such as a contract, a prayer, a letter or a recipe.

confluences.name: Salamander
confluences.theme: The beast that lives in flame
confluences.description: The salamander is the lizard born in the heart of the fire, feeding it and fed by it, as hungry as the flames it swims through. Bearers have restless hands and always-warm skin, eat quickly and often, and their magic leaps and spreads in crackling orange waves.

grant.name: Feed the Flame
grant.text: As an action, you can make a nonmagical fire within 30 feet of you spread 5 feet in a direction of your choice, as long as there is something there for it to burn, or make it die back by 5 feet.

confluences.name: Salmon
confluences.theme: The long swim home upstream
confluences.description: Salmon is the river journey that ends where life began, strength spent against the current for the sake of what comes next. A bearer's skin flushes silver-pink when wet, they feel the pull of rivers in their chest, and their magic surges forward in leaping bursts.

grant.name: Upstream Run
grant.text: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour. For the duration, natural currents can't move you against your will, and you can swim up rapids and waterfalls no more than 10 feet high as if they were calm water.

confluences.name: Sanctity
confluences.theme: Holy light and sworn devotion
confluences.description: Sanctity is light sworn to a holy purpose and tempered with mercy. Bearers carry a hush like the inside of a temple, candles burn steadier near them, and their spells shine with a clean white radiance that smells faintly of incense.

grant.name: Blessed Water
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes praying over a flask of clean water to turn it into a flask of holy water.

confluences.name: Sapper
confluences.theme: Tunnels dug beneath enemy walls
confluences.description: The sapper digs by lamplight under castle walls, waging war in the dark and the dirt. Bearers have broad shoulders and earth ground into their knuckles, they cock their heads to listen to floors, and their magic sounds like distant picks striking rock.

grant.name: Countermine
grant.text: By pressing your ear to the ground or to a stone wall for 1 minute, you can hear any digging, tunnelling or burrowing within 300 feet of you. You learn its direction and whether it is coming closer.

confluences.name: Scandal
confluences.theme: Whispers that spread like fire
confluences.description: Scandal is the juicy secret that catches on the wind and burns through a town by nightfall. A bearer always seems to have heard something, their laugh is sharp and knowing, and their magic leaves a faint murmur of whispering voices hanging in the air.

grant.name: Wagging Tongues
grant.text: In a crowded room, tavern, market or festival, you can pick out one conversation within 60 feet of you and follow it as clearly as if you stood beside the speakers, as long as they aren't deliberately whispering.

confluences.name: Scorched Earth
confluences.theme: Burn everything the enemy could use
confluences.description: Scorched earth is war at its most ruthless: the army that burns the fields, the bridges and the villages behind it and leaves nothing but smoke and ashes. Bearers have soot-dark eyes and a grim, unhurried calm, their cloaks always smell of smoke, and when their magic flares, shadows lean away from it.

grant.name: Smoke-Sighted
grant.text: Smoke, soot, ash and the haze of burning don't obscure your vision: you see through them as if the air were clear, and they never make your eyes water.

confluences.name: Scryer
confluences.theme: Visions glimpsed in still water
confluences.description: Scryer is the seeing pool, where light, water and magic show what lies far away. A bearer's eyes take on a watery, mirrored sheen, they can't pass a puddle without glancing in, and their spells ripple as though cast across a pond's surface.

grant.name: Pool Glimpse
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can gaze into still water for 1 minute while picturing a creature you know well that is on the same plane as you. You see a brief, silent glimpse of its surroundings, enough to tell whether it is indoors or outdoors, whether it is alone, and what the light and weather are like there. The creature feels a faint chill but doesn't learn why.

confluences.name: Scrying Pool
confluences.theme: Dark water that remembers faces
confluences.description: A scrying pool is still black water where secrets surface as reflections. Bearers' eyes take on the dark sheen of deep water, they linger over wells and puddles, and their magic ripples outward in silent rings.

grant.name: Water's Memory
grant.text: By gazing into a still pool, well, basin or cup of water for 1 minute, you see the face of the last creature that looked into it or drank from it within the past day.

confluences.name: Sea Knight
confluences.theme: Shining armour on a heaving deck
confluences.description: The sea knight is the sworn champion of a coast or a fleet, who fights in bright steel on rolling decks and leaps into the waves to save the drowning without stopping to unbuckle. A bearer is unshaken by foul weather and salt spray, their armour always seems freshly polished, and their spells sweep out like sunlight flashing off a wave.

grant.name: Steel in the Surf
grant.text: Wearing armour doesn't hinder your swimming: you can swim in medium or heavy armour as easily as in light clothing, and you can swim at your full speed while holding a weapon or shield.

confluences.name: Sea Witch
confluences.theme: Drowned bargains and salt-water charms
confluences.description: Sea Witch is magic sold at a price beneath the waves, the dealer in charms who always takes something in return. A bearer's hair hangs damp and tangled with weed, their nails take on the sheen of shell, and their spells coil out like ink in water.

grant.name: Breath for a Voice
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can touch a willing creature, which can be you, and strike a bargain. For the next hour, it can breathe water as well as air, but it loses its voice: until the hour ends, it can't speak, sing or cast spells with verbal components.

confluences.name: Selkie
confluences.theme: Seal skin shed for human shape
confluences.description: The selkie lives between two shapes, a seal in the cold sea and a person on the shore, and always longs for the one it is not wearing. Bearers have large, dark, wet-looking eyes, a voice that sounds sweetest near the surf and a habit of keeping one favourite cloak close, and their magic glistens like sealskin.

grant.name: Borrowed Sealskin
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute wrapping yourself tightly in a cloak, blanket or hide. For the next hour, you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, you can hold your breath for the whole hour, and swimming in freezing water doesn't cause you exhaustion.

confluences.name: Serendipity
confluences.theme: Fate's lucky turns along the way
confluences.description: Serendipity is fate and chance working hand in hand, the happy accident that leads exactly where it should. A bearer finds lost coins, bumps into old friends in strange towns, and their magic sparkles with tiny tumbling glints like flipped coins.

grant.name: Happy Accident
grant.text: Once per long rest, while you are searching for a particular person, object or place, you can trust to luck. Within the next hour, chance puts a useful clue in your path, such as a dropped note, a talkative stranger or a half-hidden track, as determined by the DM.

confluences.name: Shade
confluences.theme: A shadow that runs on its own
confluences.description: The shade is the shadow that slips loose from its owner and goes running off on errands of its own, quick and silent and full of secrets. Bearers' shadows seem a moment late to follow them and sometimes point the wrong way, and their magic leaves cold, dark smudges in the air.

grant.name: Loosed Shadow
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can send your shadow sliding away from you across the ground and walls for up to 1 minute. On each of your turns it moves up to 30 feet as you direct, it can slip under doors and through cracks, and it must stay within 60 feet of you. You see and hear from its position, but while you do, you are blinded and deafened with regard to your own surroundings. It can't affect anything, and it ends early if bright light falls on it.

confluences.name: Shadowstep
confluences.theme: Darting from shadow to shadow
confluences.description: Shadowstep is darkness used as a road, a quick slip from one patch of shadow to the next faster than an eye can follow. Bearers move with a flicker and their outlines blur at the edges in dim light, and their magic strikes from wherever the shadows are deepest.

grant.name: Step Through Shadow
grant.text: Once per long rest, as a bonus action while you are in dim light or darkness, you can step into the shadows and reappear in an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of you that is also in dim light or darkness.

confluences.name: Shallows
confluences.theme: Sunlit water clear to the bed
confluences.description: Shallows is sea and river at their brightest, sunlight reaching through clear water to the sand and stones below. A bearer's eyes shift colour like light on a stream bed, they wade in at every chance, and their spells ripple with dappled, wavering light.

grant.name: Glass Water
grant.text: When you look into natural water in daylight or other bright light, you see through its surface as if it were clear glass, without glare or ripples, down to a depth of 60 feet.

confluences.name: Shapeshifter
confluences.theme: Flesh that runs in borrowed forms
confluences.description: The shapeshifter is the beast hidden under the skin, a hunter whose body remembers claws and pads and can call them back in a moment. Bearers have quick, animal reflexes and nails that grow back sharp overnight, and their magic ripples over them like rising fur.

grant.name: Beast Claws
grant.text: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can turn your hands and feet into hooked claws for 10 minutes. For the duration, you have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, though you can't climb upside down across ceilings.

confluences.name: Shark
confluences.theme: Hunger drawn by blood in water
confluences.description: The shark is the sea's endless hunger, drawn across miles of open water by a single drop of blood. Bearers grow restless when they keep still, their teeth come in a little too sharp, and their magic circles its target in tightening loops.

grant.name: Blood in the Water
grant.text: While you are in a body of water, you can smell any blood spilled into it within the last hour from up to 1 mile away, and you know the direction of its source.

confluences.name: Shotfirer
confluences.theme: Charges, short fuses and running clear
confluences.description: The shotfirer is the miner trusted to pack the blasting charge into the rock face, light the fuse and run before it goes. A bearer's clothes carry a whiff of sulphur, their ears ring faintly after loud noises, and their magic goes off with a sharp crack and a puff of grit.

grant.name: Blast-Wise
grant.text: You have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to find, and on Dexterity checks made to disarm, traps that use fire, explosives, pits or falling stone.

confluences.name: Shrike
confluences.theme: The butcher bird and its thorny larder
confluences.description: A small, savage songbird that hunts from the wind and hangs its kills on thorns, bloodshed carried on a pretty tune. Bearers have quick, darting glances and a slightly hooked nose, whistle without noticing, and their magic flicks out in grey and black wingbeats.

grant.name: Lure Call
grant.text: You can mimic the calls and cries of birds, rodents and other small animals perfectly. A creature that hears the sound can tell it is an imitation only with a successful Wisdom check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

confluences.name: Silhouette
confluences.theme: Shadows shaped against the light
confluences.description: The silhouette is darkness given shape by a single light behind it, the figure in the window and the shape on the tent wall. Bearers cast shadows a shade too deep that sometimes linger after they move, and their magic shows as stark black outlines against a glow.

grant.name: Shadow Play
grant.text: As an action, you can reshape the shadow cast by you, or by an object you touch, into any outline you like, such as a monster, a beckoning figure or a few words of writing. It lasts for up to 1 minute or until you change it, and moves as you direct, but it can't leave the surface it falls on or affect anything.

confluences.name: Sirocco
confluences.theme: Hot wind from distant lands
confluences.description: Sirocco is the scorching wind that crosses deserts and seas, carrying dust, heat and the smell of faraway places. A bearer's skin is wind-burned and their eyes narrowed against grit, a warm breeze seems to follow them indoors, and their spells come as gusts of hot, dusty air.

grant.name: Taste the Wind
grant.text: By facing into the wind for 1 minute, you learn what lies upwind of you within 5 miles: open water, desert, forest, swamp, mountains, a settlement, or a large herd or army.

confluences.name: Skald
confluences.theme: Warrior poet of runes and saga
confluences.description: Skald is battle remembered in song, the warrior whose verses carry rune-magic and the deeds of heroes. A bearer's voice deepens into a rolling chant when they are stirred, they keep count of every fight in verse, and their spells boom like a war drum under a sung refrain.

grant.name: Saga-Lore
grant.text: You have advantage on Intelligence (History) checks made to recall battles, wars, famous warriors and legendary weapons. By handling a weapon or shield for 1 minute, you know roughly how many battles it has seen.

confluences.name: Sky Lantern
confluences.theme: Small lights rising into the night
confluences.description: Sky Lantern is hope set adrift, the paper lantern carried up on the wind until it joins the stars. A bearer gives off a faint warmth like a candle behind paper, loves high places and open nights, and their magic drifts upward in glowing motes.

grant.name: Lofted Parcel
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can tie an object weighing no more than 1 pound, such as a rope's end, a key or a letter, to a lit paper lantern and release it. The lantern rises and drifts, even against the wind, to a point you can see within 1 mile of you, then sinks gently to rest there.

confluences.name: Skyfire
confluences.theme: Lightning splitting the stormy sky
confluences.description: The lightning that blazes out of the storm clouds and lights the whole land for a single heartbeat. Bearers' hair crackles with static and the air around them smells of rain and hot metal, and their magic arrives in jagged, branching flashes.

grant.name: Lightning Flash
grant.text: Once per short rest, as an action, you can release a silent flash of white light. For an instant, everything within 60 feet of you is lit as if by bright light, and you remember what you saw as a perfectly detailed still image. The flash doesn't reveal invisible creatures or pierce magical darkness.

confluences.name: Skylark
confluences.theme: Joyful song rising with the dawn
confluences.description: Skylark is the small bird that sings as it climbs into the morning sky, hope and life poured out in song. A bearer wakes before dawn already humming, has a clear and carrying voice, and their spells rise with a bright trill of birdsong.

grant.name: Morning Song
grant.text: When you finish a long rest at dawn and greet the sunrise with a song, you have advantage on the first ability check and the first saving throw you make before noon.

confluences.name: Slander
confluences.theme: Poisoned whispers carried after dark
confluences.description: Slander is the lie spoken softly at night and passed from ear to ear until a whole town believes it. A bearer's voice drops to a silky murmur without trying, people lean close to hear them, and their spells sound like many voices whispering at once.

grant.name: Seed of Doubt
grant.text: Once per long rest, after you speak privately with a creature for at least 10 minutes about someone it knows, you can plant a doubt. Unless the creature succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier, it distrusts that person for the next 24 hours: it won't share secrets with them, lend them anything or follow their advice.

confluences.name: Slayer
confluences.theme: Hunting the monsters that hunt people
confluences.description: Slayer is the hunter's craft turned on the beasts and horrors that prey on people. Bearers collect trophies and scars in equal measure, their eyes go straight to claws, fangs and soft spots, and their spells strike with the whistle of a well-aimed shaft.

grant.name: Know Your Prey
grant.text: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you can study a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The DM tells you one of its damage vulnerabilities, resistances or immunities, or that it has none.

confluences.name: Sorcerer King
confluences.theme: Ruthless rule through arcane might
confluences.description: Sorcerer King is power hungry for more power, a throne claimed and held by sorcery and pride. A bearer carries themselves as though everyone else is late to kneel, their voice gains a cold resonance, and their spells take the shape of chains and crowns.

grant.name: Usurper's Claim
grant.text: When you attune to a magic item, you can do so even if another creature is already attuned to it, as long as you have held the item throughout the short rest. That creature's attunement to the item ends when yours begins, and it knows that its attunement was broken.

confluences.name: Sorcery
confluences.theme: Magic burning in the bloodline
confluences.description: Power that was never learned but born, hot in the veins and passed down from some fiery ancestor. Bearers' veins glow faintly when they cast and their skin is always warm, and their spells crackle with sparks that smell of hot iron.

grant.name: Burning Focus
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you fail a saving throw to maintain concentration on a spell, you can reroll it. You must use the new roll.

confluences.name: Sovereign
confluences.theme: Rightful rule and unbending dignity
confluences.description: Sovereign is command, pride and authority fused into the bearing of one born to rule. Bearers stand as though crowned even when bareheaded, servants step aside for them unasked, and their spells unfold with a stately purple-gold gleam.

grant.name: Hold Court
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can call for silence. Each humanoid within 60 feet of you that can hear and understand you and isn't hostile to you stops talking and listens to you speak for up to 1 minute, unless it is harmed or threatened in that time.

confluences.name: Spawning
confluences.theme: The fierce run back upriver
confluences.description: Spawning is the salmon run: silver bodies fighting upstream past bears and falls to the waters where their line began, so that new life can follow. Bearers carry a stubborn, homeward vigour and a faint silver-red sheen on their skin, and their magic surges in rhythmic pulses like fish leaping a weir.

grant.name: Upstream
grant.text: Swimming against a current costs you no extra movement, and you have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid being swept away by rapids, floodwater or an undertow.

confluences.name: Spelunker
confluences.theme: Ropes, lamps and the descent below
confluences.description: The spelunker lowers into the dark on a rope and raw nerve, squeezing through gaps no one else would try. Bearers grow wiry and flexible, always seem to have a coil of cord on them, and their magic unspools from them like a line paying out into a shaft.

grant.name: Slip Knot
grant.text: Knots you tie never slip or come undone by accident. As an action, while holding a rope you knotted, you can give it a sharp flick to make one of its knots untie itself, as long as the knot is within 100 feet of you. This lets you pull your rope down after you descend it.

confluences.name: Spice
confluences.theme: Fiery flavours and the merchants' road
confluences.description: The pepper, saffron and cinnamon carried across the world, worth more than gold and the cause of fortunes and wars alike. Bearers carry a warm, pungent scent and have a palate no cook can fool, and their magic drifts in coloured motes like spice dust in sunlight.

grant.name: Spice Road
grant.text: By tasting a dish or drink, or by smelling a creature's breath, you learn the main ingredients of the dish or drink, or what the creature last ate, and the region or market its spices came from.

confluences.name: Squall
confluences.theme: Sudden wind heavy with rain
confluences.description: The squall is the dark line of wind and rain that races across the water and strikes all at once, then passes as quickly as it came. Bearers smell of rain on hot ground and their moods shift like weather, they always seem to be glancing at the sky, and their spells sweep in on a sudden gust heavy with drops.

grant.name: Wind on the Skin
grant.text: By standing outdoors and tasting the wind for 1 minute, you know what the natural weather will be where you are for the next 24 hours, including when rain, wind, fog or storms will arrive and how severe they will be.

confluences.name: Stag
confluences.theme: Antlered prey that outruns the hunt
confluences.description: The stag is the proud red deer of the old forests, hunted by lords and wolves alike, which grows new antlers every spring and runs until the hounds give up. Bearers grow long-legged and alert, lift their heads sharply at any odd sound, and their magic bounds away in long, leaping arcs.

grant.name: Hunted Sense
grant.text: When you finish a short or long rest in the wilderness, you know whether any creature hostile to you followed your trail or watched your camp during that rest, though not what it was or where it is now.

confluences.name: Steam
confluences.theme: Water boiled into rising mist
confluences.description: Steam is water lifted by heat, the hiss of the kettle and the white clouds that hang over hot springs. A bearer's breath fogs even on warm days, their skin always feels slightly damp and warm, and their spells arrive wrapped in rolling clouds of vapour.

grant.name: Steam Open
grant.text: As an action, you can breathe a puff of steam onto a sealed letter, a wax seal, a glued joint or a pasted label and soften it so that it can be opened, and later resealed, without leaving any trace.

confluences.name: Stormcaller
confluences.theme: Lightning summoned from an open sky
confluences.description: Stormcaller is the old art of calling lightning out of the heavens and bending the weather to one's will. A bearer's hair lifts and crackles before a storm, a smell of rain follows them indoors, and their spells flash with forked blue light and a mutter of distant thunder.

grant.name: Call the Weather
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes calling to the sky while in the open air. Over the next 10 minutes, the natural weather within 1 mile of you shifts one step toward or away from a storm (clear, cloudy, rain, thunderstorm). It stays that way for 1 hour, then returns to what it would otherwise have been.

confluences.name: Strix
confluences.theme: Night bird of blood and witchcraft
confluences.description: The strix is the shrieking night owl of old tales, half bird and half witch, that drinks blood and carries ill omens on silent wings. Bearers become round-eyed night owls with a taste for rare meat, and their magic drifts around them like loose grey feathers.

grant.name: Night Shriek
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can let out a piercing owl-witch shriek. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you that can hear it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier or be deafened for 1 minute.

confluences.name: Summer
confluences.theme: Long days, ripe fields, warm nights
confluences.description: High summer, when the sun lingers, the fields swell with grain and every living thing grows fat and golden. Bearers tan easily and freckle gold, smell of cut hay and warm fruit, and their magic glows with the slanting amber light of a late afternoon.

grant.name: Long Evening
grant.text: Once per long rest, when the sun sets while you are outdoors, you can hold back the dusk. For up to 1 hour, the area within 60 feet of you stays lit as if by late-afternoon sunlight and as warm as a summer evening. This light doesn't count as sunlight for creatures harmed by it, and it ends early if you leave the area.

confluences.name: Summit
confluences.theme: High peaks and thin cold air
confluences.description: Summit is the mountaineer's restless urge to climb until there is nowhere higher to go. Bearers have wind-burned cheeks and steady hands, they always drift to the highest point in a room, and their spells crack sharp and cold like the air above the snowline.

grant.name: Mountain-Born
grant.text: You are acclimatised to high altitude, and you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb natural cliffs, rock faces and ice.

confluences.name: Sunbeam
confluences.theme: Light leaping faster than thought
confluences.description: Sunbeam is pure light in motion, the shaft of sun that crosses a room before anyone sees it move. A bearer's skin is warm to the touch and dusted faintly gold, they always drift toward windows, and their magic flashes from place to place in straight bright lines.

grant.name: Glance Reader
grant.text: You read ten times faster than normal: you can take in a page of text at a glance and read a whole book in an hour.

confluences.name: Sunflower
confluences.theme: Turning always toward the sun
confluences.description: Sunflower is growth that drinks the light, the tall bright bloom that follows the sun across the sky. A bearer's skin takes on a warm golden glow in daylight, they turn their face to the sun without thinking, and their spells open outward in rings of golden petals.

grant.name: Sun-Fed
grant.text: On any day you spend at least 4 hours in direct sunlight, you don't need to eat. You still need water.

confluences.name: Sunstone
confluences.theme: Stone that drinks and holds sunlight
confluences.description: Sunstone is the golden crystal that soaks up daylight and glows with it long after dark. A bearer's skin keeps a warm sunlit glow even in winter, their pupils shine faintly amber at night, and their magic radiates in slow golden pulses.

grant.name: Stored Sunlight
grant.text: Once per long rest, after a stone or crystal you carry has sat in direct sunlight for 1 hour, you can use an action to release the light from it. For 1 minute, it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. This light counts as sunlight for Sunlight Sensitivity and similar traits, but it isn't strong enough to harm creatures that are hurt by sunlight.

confluences.name: Swallow
confluences.theme: Swift wings that always return
confluences.description: The swallow crosses seas and continents every autumn and still finds its way back to the same eaves each spring. Bearers have a quick, darting walk and a restless love of the road, they always know which way home lies, and their spells swoop and dart like birds skimming a summer field.

grant.name: Homing Heart
grant.text: At the end of a long rest, you can choose the place where you are. Until you choose a new place, you always know the direction and rough distance to it while you are on the same plane of existence.

confluences.name: Sylph
confluences.theme: Spirit of the drifting air
confluences.description: Sylph is magic woven into the wind until it becomes a spirit, light as breath and never still. A bearer moves as if weightless, loose hair and cloth flutter around them even indoors, and their spells swirl like a small whirlwind.

grant.name: Featherlight
grant.text: As a bonus action, you can make your body almost weightless, or return it to normal. While weightless, you can cross thin ice, crusted snow, a rotten floor or a taut net without breaking through or sinking, but you have disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws to avoid being pushed, shoved or knocked prone, and you fall no more slowly than normal.

confluences.name: Syndicate
confluences.theme: Organised crime and the honour of thieves
confluences.description: Syndicate is vice grown into an empire: the guilds, rackets and quiet debts that run a city after dark. A bearer picks up a cool, appraising stare and a habit of sitting with their back to the wall, and their magic moves like a passed coin, sliding unseen from hand to hand.

grant.name: Chalk Marks
grant.text: You can read the secret chalk marks and scratches that thieves, beggars and smugglers leave on walls, doors and gateposts. By studying a building's marks for 1 minute, you learn whether it is watched, guarded, an easy mark, or under some gang's protection, and you can leave such marks yourself.

confluences.name: Teahouse
confluences.theme: Steam, leaves and quiet hospitality
confluences.description: The teahouse is the warm room where the kettle is always on, where strangers sit down together and the hot cup makes friends of them. Bearers smell of steeped leaves and woodsmoke, their hands are always warm around a cup, and their magic curls upward in fragrant, gentle steam.

grant.name: Over Tea
grant.text: When you share a pot of tea or another hot drink with a creature for at least 10 minutes, you have advantage on Charisma checks made to interact with it for the next hour. It doesn't realise anything unusual happened.

confluences.name: Temper
confluences.theme: Steel hardened by flame and quench
confluences.description: Temper is the smith's secret of plunging red-hot steel into cold water, the hard, springy strength that only fire and water together can give. A bearer's skin has the faint blue-grey sheen of tempered metal, they keep a cool head in a hot fight, and their magic hisses like a blade dropped into the quench barrel.

grant.name: Tempered Steel
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a nonmagical metal weapon or piece of metal armour you are holding or wearing would be damaged, corroded or destroyed, such as by a rust monster's touch or a black pudding's acid, you can choose for it to be unharmed.

confluences.name: Tempest
confluences.theme: Storm, thunder and driving rain
confluences.description: Tempest is the living storm, all howling wind, lashing rain and forked lightning. A bearer's hair lifts and crackles with static, the air smells of coming rain wherever they go, and their spells boom like thunder close overhead.

grant.name: Eye of the Storm
grant.text: Natural wind, rain and hail never push you or knock you prone, and you can see and hear through a natural storm as clearly as on a still day.

confluences.name: Temptation
confluences.theme: Every vice, offered with a smile
confluences.description: Temptation is sin at its purest, the soft voice that offers each person exactly what they should refuse. Bearers become quietly magnetic, with a knowing smile and a scent like warm spice and spilled wine, and their spells shimmer with a gilded, honeyed glow.

grant.name: Everyone's Price
grant.text: Once per long rest, after talking with a creature for at least 10 minutes, you learn the one thing it currently wants most that could be offered to it as a bribe or temptation, such as gold, fame, revenge, a person or a secret.

confluences.name: Thieftaker
confluences.theme: Hunting thieves for the bounty
confluences.description: Thieftaker is justice with a price on it, the hard-handed catcher of criminals who works for the reward as much as the law. A bearer has a hunter's patience and a merchant's eye, keeps lists of names and faces, and their magic closes around its target like a shackle of light.

grant.name: Stolen Goods
grant.text: By handling an object for 1 minute, you learn whether it has been stolen within the last year and, if it has, roughly how long ago.

confluences.name: Thistledown
confluences.theme: Seeds and wishes on the breeze
confluences.description: Thistledown is life carried on the wind, the drifting seed that travels far and takes root wherever it lands. A bearer seems to weigh a little less than they should, pale fluff gathers on their clothes, and their magic scatters into soft, floating motes.

grant.name: Take Root Anywhere
grant.text: Seeds and cuttings that you plant take root and thrive in any ground, even sand, salted earth, ash or a crack in bare rock, as long as they get a little water and light.

confluences.name: Thunderbolt
confluences.theme: Lightning striking from the storm
confluences.description: The thunderbolt is fire hurled down from the storm faster than any eye can follow, gone before the thunder rolls. A bearer's hair lifts and crackles before bad weather, they move in sudden jolts, and their spells strike in jagged white forks with a sharp smell of scorched air.

grant.name: Lightning-Wise
grant.text: You have advantage on saving throws against effects that deal lightning or thunder damage, and your skin prickles a moment before natural lightning strikes within 100 feet of you.

confluences.name: Tick
confluences.theme: The bloodsucker that won't let go
confluences.description: Hunger doubled and soured by greed into the patient parasite that buries its head in a host and drinks until it is fat: the bloodsucker, the moneylender, the guest who never leaves. Bearers have cool, damp hands, a grip that is hard to shake off and a soft unblinking gaze, and their magic clings and pulls in thin red threads.

grant.name: Hanger-On
grant.text: You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to keep hold of a creature you are clinging to, or to stay on a mount or a moving vehicle.

confluences.name: Tidewarden
confluences.theme: Guardian who commands the waves
confluences.description: Tidewarden is the strength of the sea held in check by magic, the guardian who stands at the shore and tells the waves to be still. A bearer smells faintly of salt, stands steady on any deck, and their spells rise and fall like a slow swell.

grant.name: Sea Wall
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action while you are within 30 feet of a body of water at least 10 feet across, you can raise a wall of water up to 10 feet long, 10 feet high and 1 foot thick at a point you can see within 30 feet of you. It lasts for 1 minute. It is opaque, a creature moving through it treats it as difficult terrain, and ranged weapon attacks that pass through it have disadvantage.

confluences.name: Torchbearer
confluences.theme: The first light into darkness
confluences.description: The one who carries the torch at the head of the column and holds back the dark with fire and nerve. Bearers stand tall in the face of fear, their gaze has a steady, fiery gleam, and their magic blazes outward like a torch swept in an arc.

grant.name: Ward of Flame
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action while you hold a lit torch or other open flame, you can sweep it in a blazing arc. For 1 minute, a beast or undead can't willingly move within 5 feet of you unless it succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier), which it makes the first time it tries. The ward ends early if your flame goes out.

confluences.name: Trench
confluences.theme: The crushing dark of the sea floor
confluences.description: Trench is the black, cold weight of the deepest ocean and the strange life that thrives in it. Bearers' eyes grow large and glassy, their skin gives off a faint glow in total darkness, and their spells pulse with the slow blue light of deep-sea things.

grant.name: Pressure Sense
grant.text: While you are submerged, you sense the direction and rough size of every creature moving in the water within 60 feet of you, even in total darkness, though not exactly where it is.

confluences.name: Troll
confluences.theme: Stone-grey hunger that keeps mending
confluences.description: Ravenous vitality rooted in cold stone: the brute that heals from anything and gnaws on whatever it finds. Bearers grow thick-knuckled with a grey cast to their skin, their wounds scab over with a gritty crust, and their magic smells of wet rock and raw meat.

grant.name: Knitting Flesh
grant.text: When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points and it shows a 1 or 2, you can reroll it. You must use the new roll. In addition, a lost tooth, nail or finger slowly regrows within a month.

confluences.name: Troubadour
confluences.theme: Song, story and the open road
confluences.description: Troubadour is the wandering performer's art, carrying songs and stories from town to town. Bearers hum constantly and remember every tune they hear, and their spells arrive with a ripple of music, as if a lute had been plucked somewhere nearby.

grant.name: Encore
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you fail a Charisma (Performance) check, you can reroll it. You must use the new roll.

confluences.name: Truffle
confluences.theme: Buried delicacies and a greedy nose
confluences.description: Truffle is the rare, costly fungus hidden among tree roots, sniffed out by greedy snouts and sold for its weight in silver. A bearer develops a keen and rather indulgent nose and an appetite for rich food, and their magic carries a musky smell of damp forest soil.

grant.name: Gourmet's Luck
grant.text: In any settlement, you can always find the best meal and the finest lodging available there, and you pay only the price of modest ones for them.

confluences.name: Tsunami
confluences.theme: The sea rising with crushing force
confluences.description: The tsunami is the ocean's full strength, the wall of water that rises without warning and sweeps everything before it. Bearers carry a heavy, rolling stillness and the water in nearby cups trembles when they are angry, and their spells surge outward like a breaking wave.

grant.name: Rising Wave
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can strike a body of water you are standing in or next to and send a wave rolling out in a 15-foot cone. Each Medium or smaller creature in the water within the cone must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be pushed 10 feet away from you. Small boats in the area rock hard but don't capsize.

confluences.name: Tyrant
confluences.theme: Wrathful rule and a crown of fear
confluences.description: Tyrant is power seized in anger and held through pride, the ruler whose temper is the only law. A bearer's voice takes on a hard edge that makes servants flinch, their eyes smoulder red when they are crossed, and their spells arrive like a fist slammed on a table.

grant.name: Kneel
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can bark a one-word command, such as kneel, halt, silence or leave, at one humanoid within 30 feet of you that can hear and understand you and isn't hostile to you. Unless it succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier, it obeys on its next turn as best it can. The command can't make it harm itself or anyone else.

confluences.name: Undercity
confluences.theme: Sewers, smugglers and the city below
confluences.description: The undercity is the maze of sewers, drains, flooded cellars and smugglers' tunnels beneath every great city, where stolen goods move and those who hide from the law go to ground. A bearer smells faintly of damp brick, walks with their head slightly bowed as if under a low ceiling, and their magic trickles and drips like water running through dark tunnels.

grant.name: Under the Streets
grant.text: While you are in the sewers, drains, cellars, catacombs or tunnels beneath a settlement, you always know which street or building is above you, and the direction to the nearest way up to the surface.

confluences.name: Undertow
confluences.theme: What the dark water takes
confluences.description: The undertow is the hidden pull beneath calm water that drags swimmers down and keeps what it takes in the cold and the dark. Bearers have a heavy, unblinking calm and hems that never quite dry, and their magic tugs downward like a current around the ankles.

grant.name: Sunken Sense
grant.text: While you touch a body of water, you know the direction and rough depth of every corpse, and of every sunken object larger than a chest, within 300 feet of you in that water.

confluences.name: Undine
confluences.theme: Spirit of living, shaping water
confluences.description: Undine is magic poured into water until it moves with a will of its own, the spirit of fountains, springs and pools. A bearer's skin is always cool and faintly dewy, their hair drifts as if underwater, and their spells flow and pour like liquid.

grant.name: Water-Shaping
grant.text: As an action, you can choose an area of nonmagical water no larger than a 5-foot cube within 30 feet of you and make it flow in a direction you choose, rise into a simple shape such as a column or arch, or change its colour or cloudiness. The effect lasts up to 1 hour or until you use this trait again. The water can't hold up weight or move with enough force to harm a creature.

confluences.name: Vampire
confluences.theme: Undying thirst under the moon
confluences.description: Vampire is blood and endless hunger awakened under the night sky. Bearers grow pale with lips a shade too red, their canines lengthen slightly, and their spells flicker with a crimson light that seems to drink the warmth from the air.

grant.name: Blood Taste
grant.text: By tasting a drop of a creature's blood, you learn its creature type and whether it is diseased, poisoned or cursed.

confluences.name: Vanity
confluences.theme: Gleaming pride in one's own reflection
confluences.description: Vanity is pride that shines, the love of one's own glow polished until it dazzles. A bearer is always immaculate, catches their reflection in every surface, and their magic sparkles a little more than it needs to.

grant.name: Never a Hair Out of Place
grant.text: Dirt, blood, soot and mud slide off your skin and clothes within a minute, and you always look freshly groomed. You have advantage on Charisma checks made to talk your way into a ball, court, private club or other exclusive gathering.

confluences.name: Vault
confluences.theme: Sealed stone chambers and buried wards
confluences.description: A vault is a sealed chamber under the stone, its door bound with wards and its secrets kept in the dark. Bearers grow quiet and close-mouthed, faint lines like carved runes surface on their palms, and their magic closes around its target with the soft thud of a heavy door.

grant.name: Vault Seal
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a door, lid, chest or coffin and mark it with an invisible sigil. You know the moment it is opened, as long as you are within 1 mile of it. You can have only one such sigil at a time; marking something new ends the old one.

confluences.name: Velocity
confluences.theme: Pure speed, faster than thought
confluences.description: Velocity is swiftness at its purest, the blur of motion that arrives before its own sound. Bearers can't sit still, talk fast, walk faster and always look windswept, and their spells streak out leaving a faint afterimage.

grant.name: Sudden Sprint
grant.text: Once per short rest, you can take the Dash action as a bonus action.

confluences.name: Vendetta
confluences.theme: A grudge that burns down generations
confluences.description: Vengeance upon vengeance, lit by an anger that never quite goes out. Bearers carry a slow heat behind the eyes and remember every slight done to their kin, and their magic burns a deeper red the longer they hold a grudge.

grant.name: Sworn Enemy
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can swear vengeance on a creature that has harmed you or your kin and whose face you have seen. For the next 24 hours, while that creature is within 1 mile of you and on the same plane of existence, you know the direction to it.

confluences.name: Veteran
confluences.theme: Scarred survivor of many battles
confluences.description: The veteran is the soldier who has bled on a dozen fields and walked off every one, strength proven by scars rather than songs. Bearers collect scars that heal pale and fast and sleep soundly on the eve of battle, and their magic strikes with a blunt, practised economy.

grant.name: Seen Worse
grant.text: Once per long rest, when a creature scores a critical hit against you, you can turn it into a normal hit (no action required).

confluences.name: Viper
confluences.theme: Venom hidden behind a smile
confluences.description: The viper is treachery given fangs: the smiling ally, the poisoned word, the strike from the grass that comes before anyone thinks to look down. Bearers develop slitted pupils, a soft voice and a taste for double meanings, and their magic hisses and coils before it lashes out.

grant.name: Forked Tongue
grant.text: When you speak aloud, you can weave a hidden message of up to ten words into what you say. One creature of your choice that can hear you and shares a language with you understands the hidden message; everyone else hears only your ordinary words.

confluences.name: Vital Spark
confluences.theme: The jolt that restarts a heart
confluences.description: The vital spark is the quick flash of fire that leaps from flint to tinder and from one living heart to another, the jolt that brings the fallen back. Bearers fidget and twitch with nervous energy, their touch gives a small warm sting, and their magic crackles from hand to hand in quick golden sparks.

grant.name: Jolt
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can touch a creature that has 0 hit points and is stable, sending a warm spark through its chest. It regains 1 hit point and wakes up.

confluences.name: Volcano
confluences.theme: Molten fury beneath the stone
confluences.description: Volcano is the earth's buried fire breaking loose with overwhelming force. Bearers feel as heavy and warm as banked coals, thin cracks of orange light show in their skin when they lose their temper, and their spells rumble and hiss like a mountain about to burst.

grant.name: Banked Heat
grant.text: As an action, you can touch a stone no larger than 1 foot across and make it glow with a dull red heat for 8 hours. It warms a campsite like a fire and cooks food placed on it, but it gives off no flame or smoke and can't harm a creature. You can have only one such stone at a time.

confluences.name: Vulture
confluences.theme: Circling greed over the fallen
confluences.description: The vulture waits on the high air for the fighting to end, then drops to strip the dead of everything they had. Bearers grow hunch-shouldered and unnervingly calm around corpses, and their magic circles slowly overhead before it descends.

grant.name: Bone-Picker
grant.text: When you spend 10 minutes searching a dead body, or the dead on a battlefield no larger than a 30-foot square, you find every coin, gem and other valuable they carry, including any sewn into clothing, hidden in boots or swallowed.

confluences.name: Warhorn
confluences.theme: The horn that calls the charge
confluences.description: The warhorn is the call of an army, a single blast that carries courage across a battlefield. Bearers have a deep, carrying voice that cuts through any din and often wear a horn at the hip, and their spells boom out with a low, brassy note.

grant.name: Sound the Rally
grant.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can sound a horn or bellow a war cry. Each ally within 60 feet of you that can hear it and is frightened can immediately repeat its saving throw against the effect frightening it, if that effect allows one.

confluences.name: Warlord
confluences.theme: Command amid the clash of battle
confluences.description: Warlord is the instinct to lead soldiers through blood and chaos and bring them home victorious. Bearers stand as if surveying a field from a hilltop, their voices cut through clamour like a war horn, and their spells flare in the shapes of banners and spearpoints.

grant.name: Battle Order
grant.text: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can shout an order to one ally within 60 feet of you that can hear you. It can immediately use its reaction to move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

confluences.name: Warpaint
confluences.theme: Blood-red marks for battle
